    1: using System;
    2: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    3: 
    4: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Neighbors.Operators
    5: {
    6:     /// <summary>
    7:     /// Supplies validation and deterministic tie handling for
    8:     /// Neighbor relationship comparers.
    9:     /// </summary>
   10:     public abstract class NeighborComparerBase :
   11:         INeighborComparer
   12:     {
   13:         public int Compare(
   14:             IBaseObject subject,
   15:             INeighborRelationship left,
   16:             INeighborRelationship right)
   17:         {
   18:             if (subject == null)
   19:             {
   20:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   21:                     nameof(subject));
   22:             }
   23: 
   24:             if (left == null)
   25:             {
   26:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   27:                     nameof(left));
   28:             }
   29: 
   30:             if (right == null)
   31:             {
   32:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   33:                     nameof(right));
   34:             }
   35: 
   36:             var compared =
   37:                 CompareCore(
   38:                     subject,
   39:                     left,
   40:                     right);
   41: 
   42:             if (compared != 0)
   43:             {
   44:                 return compared;
   45:             }
   46: 
   47:             compared = string.Compare(
   48:                 left.Membership,
   49:                 right.Membership,
   50:                 StringComparison.Ordinal);
   51: 
   52:             if (compared != 0)
   53:             {
   54:                 return compared;
   55:             }
   56: 
   57:             return left.Neighbor.Id.CompareTo(
   58:                 right.Neighbor.Id);
   59:         }
   60: 
   61:         protected abstract int CompareCore(
   62:             IBaseObject subject,
   63:             INeighborRelationship left,
   64:             INeighborRelationship right);
   65:     }
   66: }

    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    4: 
    5: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Neighbors.Operators
    6: {
    7:     /// <summary>
    8:     /// Applies a deterministic sequence of Neighbor sequence
    9:     /// operators. Each stage receives the prior stage snapshot.
   10:     /// </summary>
   11:     public abstract class NeighborCompositeOperatorBase :
   12:         NeighborSequenceOperatorBase
   13:     {
   14:         private readonly IReadOnlyList<INeighborSequenceOperator>
   15:             _operators;
   16: 
   17:         protected NeighborCompositeOperatorBase(
   18:             IReadOnlyList<INeighborSequenceOperator> operators)
   19:         {
   20:             if (operators == null)
   21:             {
   22:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   23:                     nameof(operators));
   24:             }
   25: 
   26:             var snapshot =
   27:                 new INeighborSequenceOperator[operators.Count];
   28: 
   29:             for (var index = 0;
   30:                  index < operators.Count;
   31:                  index++)
   32:             {
   33:                 snapshot[index] =
   34:                     operators[index] ??
   35:                     throw new ArgumentException(
   36:                         "Neighbor operator pipelines cannot contain null stages.",
   37:                         nameof(operators));
   38:             }
   39: 
   40:             _operators = snapshot;
   41:         }
   42: 
   43:         protected sealed override
   44:             IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship> ApplyCore(
   45:                 IBaseObject subject,
   46:                 IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship> relationships)
   47:         {
   48:             var current =
   49:                 relationships;
   50: 
   51:             for (var index = 0;
   52:                  index < _operators.Count;
   53:                  index++)

   55:                 current =
   56:                     _operators[index].Apply(
   57:                         subject,
   58:                         current);
   59:             }
   60: 
   61:             return current;
   62:         }
   63:     }
   64: }

   31:                 new List<INeighborRelationship>();
   32: 
   33:             for (var index = 0;
   34:                  index < relationships.Count;
   35:                  index++)
   36:             {
   37:                 var relationship =
   38:                     relationships[index];
   39: 
   40:                 if (_predicate.Includes(
   41:                         subject,
   42:                         relationship))
   43:                 {
   44:                     result.Add(
   45:                         relationship);
   46:                 }
   47:             }
   48: 
   49:             return Snapshot(
   50:                 result);
   51:         }
   52:     }
   53: }

   22:             }

   25:             {
   26:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   27:                     nameof(relationships));
   28:             }
   29: 
   30:             return ApplyCore(
   31:                 subject,
   32:                 relationships);
   33:         }
   34: 
   35:         protected abstract TResult ApplyCore(
   36:             IBaseObject subject,
   37:             IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship> relationships);

   39: }

FILE: Builders\WildsEngine.Core\Neighbors\Operators\Base\NeighborOrderOperatorBase.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    4: 
    5: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Neighbors.Operators
    6: {
    7:     /// <summary>
    8:     /// Orders a copied relationship snapshot through a reusable
    9:     /// comparer and never mutates the source sequence.
   10:     /// </summary>
   11:     public abstract class NeighborOrderOperatorBase :
   12:         NeighborSequenceOperatorBase
   13:     {
   14:         private readonly INeighborComparer _comparer;
   15: 
   16:         protected NeighborOrderOperatorBase(
   17:             INeighborComparer comparer)
   18:         {
   19:             _comparer =
   20:                 comparer ??
   21:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   22:                     nameof(comparer));
   23:         }
   24: 
   25:         protected sealed override
   26:             IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship> ApplyCore(
   27:                 IBaseObject subject,
   28:                 IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship> relationships)
   29:         {
   30:             var result =
   31:                 new List<INeighborRelationship>(
   32:                     relationships.Count);
   33: 
   34:             for (var index = 0;
   35:                  index < relationships.Count;
   36:                  index++)
   37:             {
   38:                 result.Add(
   39:                     relationships[index]);
   40:             }
   41: 
   42:             result.Sort(
   43:                 (left, right) =>
   44:                     _comparer.Compare(
   45:                         subject,
   46:                         left,
   47:                         right));
   48: 
   49:             return Snapshot(
   50:                 result);
   51:         }
   52:     }
   53: }

    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    4: 
    5: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Neighbors.Operators
    6: {
    7:     /// <summary>
    8:     /// Base class for bounded, snapshot-safe Neighbor sampling.
    9:     /// </summary>
   10:     public abstract class NeighborSamplerBase :
   11:         NeighborSequenceOperatorBase,
   12:         INeighborSampler
   13:     {
   14:         protected NeighborSamplerBase(
   15:             int count)
   16:         {
   17:             if (count < 0)
   18:             {
   19:                 throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
   20:                     nameof(count),
   21:                     count,
   22:                     "Neighbor sample count cannot be negative.");
   23:             }
   24: 
   25:             Count = count;
   26:         }
   27: 
   28:         public int Count { get; }
   29: 
   30:         protected sealed override
   31:             IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship> ApplyCore(
   32:                 IBaseObject subject,
   33:                 IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship> relationships)
   34:         {
   35:             if (Count == 0 ||
   36:                 relationships.Count == 0)
   37:             {
   38:                 return Empty();
   39:             }
   40: 
   41:             var boundedCount =
   42:                 Math.Min(
   43:                     Count,
   44:                     relationships.Count);
   45: 
   46:             return SampleCore(
   47:                 subject,
   48:                 relationships,
   49:                 boundedCount);
   50:         }
   51: 
   52:         protected abstract IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship>
   53:             SampleCore(
   54:                 IBaseObject subject,
   55:                 IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship> relationships,
   56:                 int count);
   57:     }
   58: }

  145:     public static class WildsQslCertification
  146:     {
  147:         private const string SuiteFileName =
  148:             "qsl_core_statement_testing.json";
  149: 
  150:         private const string ReportFileName =
  151:             "wilds_qsl_core_statement_testing_output.json";
  152: 
  153:         private static readonly List<string> Passed =
  154:             new List<string>();
  155: 
  156:         public static async Task<WildsQslCertificationReport> RunAllAsync()
  157:         {
  158:             Passed.Clear();
  159: 
  160:             var suitePath =
  161:                 Path.Combine(
  162:                     AppContext.BaseDirectory,
  163:                     "Certification",
  164:                     SuiteFileName);
  165: 
  166:             var suite =
  167:                 LoadSuite(
  168:                     suitePath);
  169: 
  170:             var qslEngine =
  171:                 CreateQslEngine();
  172: 
  173:             var component =
  174:                 CreateComponent(
  175:                     "certification.qsl.core");
  176: 
  177:             using var wildsEngine =
  178:                 CreateWildsEngine(
  179:                     component);
  180: 
  181:             Assert(
  182:                 wildsEngine.Initialize(),
  183:                 "WildsEngine initialization should succeed.");
  184: 
  185:             var executor =
  186:                 new WildsQslExecutor(
  187:                     qslEngine,
  188:                     wildsEngine);
  189: 
  190:             var report =
  191:                 new WildsQslCertificationReport();
  192: 
  193:             TestLog.Write(
  194:                 "=== Wilds / QSL Core Certification ===");
  195: 
  196:             TestLog.State(
  197:                 "Route: QSL source -> WildsEngine -> " +
  198:                 "Pulse -> WorkUnit -> Wilds/QSL integration -> " +
  199:                 "QSL -> WorkUnit result -> Moment -> " +
  200:                 "Timeline -> Epoch");
  201: 
  202:             TestLog.State(
  203:                 "Suite: " +
  204:                 suitePath);
  205: 
  206:             TestLog.State(
  207:                 "Tests: " +
  208:                 suite.Tests.Count);
  209: 
  210:             Console.WriteLine();
  211: 
  212:             for (
  213:                 var index = 0;
  214:                 index < suite.Tests.Count;
  215:                 index++)
  216:             {
  217:                 var test =
  218:                     suite.Tests[index];
  219: 
  220:                 var result =
  221:                     await ExecuteTestAsync(
  222:                             executor,
  223:                             wildsEngine,
  224:                             test)
  225:                         .ConfigureAwait(false);
  226: 
  227:                 report.Results.Add(
  228:                     result);
  229: 
  230:                 switch (result.Status)
  231:                 {
  232:                     case WildsQslCertificationStatus.Passed:
  233:                         report.Passed++;
  234:                         Passed.Add(
  235:                             CreateTestName(
  236:                                 index,
  237:                                 test));
  238:                         break;
  239: 
  240:                     case WildsQslCertificationStatus.MissingDependency:
  241:                         report.MissingDependencies++;
  242:                         break;
  243: 
  244:                     case WildsQslCertificationStatus.Failed:
  245:                         report.Failed++;
  246:                         break;
  247: 
  248:                     default:
  249:                         throw new InvalidOperationException(
  250:                             "Unknown certification status: " +
  251:                             result.Status);
  252:                 }
  253: 
  254:                 if (result.MomentOutcome ==
  255:                     MomentOutcome.Completed.ToString())
  256:                 {
  257:                     report.CompletedMoments++;
  258:                 }
  259: 
  260:                 if (result.MomentOutcome ==
  261:                     MomentOutcome.Failed.ToString())
  262:                 {
  263:                     report.FailedMoments++;
  264:                 }
  265: 
  266:                 Console.Write(
  267:                     result.Status switch
  268:                     {
  269:                         WildsQslCertificationStatus.Passed => ".",
  270:                         WildsQslCertificationStatus.MissingDependency => "M",
  271:                         WildsQslCertificationStatus.Failed => "F",
  272:                         _ => "?"
  273:                     });
  274: 
  275:                 if ((index + 1) % 50 == 0)
  276:                 {
  277:                     Console.WriteLine();
  278:                 }
  279:             }
  280: 
  281:             if (suite.Tests.Count % 50 != 0)
  282:             {
  283:                 Console.WriteLine();
  284:             }
  285: 
  286:             report.Total =
  287:                 report.Results.Count;
  288: 
  289:             report.TimelineMoments =
  290:                 wildsEngine.Timeline.Count;
  291: 
  292:             report.EpochTimelines =
  293:                 wildsEngine.Epoch.Timelines.Count;
  294: 
  295:             ValidateCompleteHistory(
  296:                 suite,
  297:                 wildsEngine);
  298: 
  299:             WriteSummary(
  300:                 report);
  301: 
  302:             if (report.Failed > 0)
  303:             {
  304:                 WriteFailures(
  305:                     report.Results);
  306:             }
  307: 
  308:             if (report.MissingDependencies > 0)
  309:             {
  310:                 WriteMissingDependencies(
  311:                     report.Results);
  312:             }
  313: 
  314:             WriteReport(
  315:                 report);
  316: 
  317:             Assert(
  318:                 report.Total ==
  319:                 suite.Tests.Count,
  320:                 "Certification report must contain one result " +
  321:                 "for every suite case.");
  322: 
  323:             Assert(
  324:                 report.Total ==
  325:                 report.Passed +
  326:                 report.Failed +
  327:                 report.MissingDependencies,
  328:                 "Every certification result must be accounted for " +
  329:                 "as passed, failed, or missing a dependency.");
  330: 
  331:             Assert(
  332:                 report.IsCertified,
  333:                 "Wilds / QSL core certification requires every " +
  334:                 "core case to pass with no missing dependencies.");
  335: 
  336:             TestLog.Write(
  337:                 "Wilds / QSL core certification completed: " +
  338:                 report.Passed +
  339:                 "/" +
  340:                 report.Total +
  341:                 " cases passed.");
  342: 
  343:             TestLog.State(
  344:                 "Certification status: " +
  345:                 GetCertificationStatus(
  346:                     report));
  347: 
  348:             TestLog.State(
  349:                 "Missing Dependencies: " +
  350:                 report.MissingDependencies);
  351: 
  352:             TestLog.State(
  353:                 "Completed Moments: " +
  354:                 report.CompletedMoments);
  355: 
  356:             TestLog.State(
  357:                 "Failed Moments: " +
  358:                 report.FailedMoments);
  359: 
  360:             TestLog.State(
  361:                 "Timeline Moments: " +
  362:                 report.TimelineMoments);
  363: 
  364:             TestLog.State(
  365:                 "Epoch Timelines: " +
  366:                 report.EpochTimelines);
  367: 
  368:             return report;
  369:         }
  370: 
  371:         private static WildsQslCertificationSuite LoadSuite(
  372:             string suitePath)
  373:         {
  374:             if (!File.Exists(
  375:                     suitePath))
  376:             {
  377:                 throw new FileNotFoundException(
  378:                     "Wilds / QSL certification suite " +
  379:                     "was not found.",
  380:                     suitePath);
  381:             }
  382: 
  383:             try
  384:             {
  385:                 var json =
  386:                     File.ReadAllText(
  387:                         suitePath);
  388: 
  389:                 var suite =
  390:                     JsonSerializer.Deserialize
  391:                         <WildsQslCertificationSuite>(
  392:                             json,
  393:                             new JsonSerializerOptions
  394:                             {
  395:                                 PropertyNameCaseInsensitive =
  396:                                     true
  397:                             });
  398: 
  399:                 if (suite == null)
  400:                 {
  401:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  402:                         "Certification suite deserialized to null.");
  403:                 }
  404: 
  405:                 if (suite.Tests.Count == 0)
  406:                 {
  407:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  408:                         "Certification suite contains no tests.");
  409:                 }
  410: 
  411:                 return suite;
  412:             }
  413:             catch (Exception exception)
  414:                 when (exception is not FileNotFoundException)
  415:             {
  416:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  417:                     "Certification suite could not be loaded.",
  418:                     exception);
  419:             }
  420:         }
  421: 
  422:         private static async Task<WildsQslCertificationResult>
  423:             ExecuteTestAsync(
  424:                 WildsQslExecutor executor,
  425:                 global::WildsEngine.Core.WildsEngine wildsEngine,
  426:                 WildsQslCertificationTest test)
  427:         {
  428:             var expectsError =
  429:                 string.Equals(
  430:                     test.Category,
  431:                     "Error",
  432:                     StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
  433: 
  434:             var timelineBefore =
  435:                 wildsEngine.Timeline.Count;
  436: 
  437:             IMoment moment;
  438: 
  439:             try
  440:             {
  441:                 /*
  442:                  * This is the important certification boundary.
  443:                  *
  444:                  * The adapter submits the QSL source through
  445:                  * WildsEngine.ExecuteAsync.
  446:                  *
  447:                  * Wilds owns the Pulse and WorkUnit lifecycle.
  448:                  * QSL performs delegated computation while the
  449:                  * WorkUnit is processing.
  450:                  *
  451:                  * The QSL result returns to Wilds before Wilds
  452:                  * completes the WorkUnit and resolves the terminal
  453:                  * Moment.
  454:                  */
  455:                 moment =
  456:                     await executor.ExecuteAsync(
  457:                             test.Statement)
  458:                         .ConfigureAwait(false);
  459:             }
  460:             catch (Exception exception)
  461:             {
  462:                 /*
  463:                  * WildsEngine.ExecuteAsync must convert delegated
  464:                  * processing failures into failed WorkUnits and
  465:                  * failed Moments.
  466:                  *
  467:                  * An exception escaping this route means Wilds
  468:                  * did not resolve the request into honest temporal
  469:                  * history.
  470:                  */
  471:                 return new WildsQslCertificationResult
  472:                 {
  473:                     Category =
  474:                         test.Category,
  475: 
  476:                     Statement =
  477:                         test.Statement,
  478: 
  479:                     Expected =
  480:                         test.Expected,
  481: 
  482:                     Output =
  483:                         string.Empty,
  484: 
  485:                     Dependency =
  486:                         test.Dependency,
  487: 
  488:                     Status =
  489:                         WildsQslCertificationStatus.Failed,
  490: 
  491:                     Passed =
  492:                         false,
  493: 
  494:                     QslSucceeded =
  495:                         false,
  496: 
  497:                     EnteredWilds =
  498:                         true,
  499: 
  500:                     MomentCompleted =
  501:                         false,
  502: 
  503:                     TimelineRecorded =
  504:                         false,
  505: 
  506:                     EpochRecorded =
  507:                         false,
  508: 
  509:                     MomentOutcome =
  510:                         string.Empty,
  511: 
  512:                     ParseFailed =
  513:                         false,
  514: 
  515:                     EvaluationFailed =
  516:                         false,
  517: 
  518:                     ParserDiagnostics =
  519:                         Array.Empty<string>(),
  520: 
  521:                     RuntimeDiagnostics =
  522:                         Array.Empty<string>(),
  523: 
  524:                     Exception =
  525:                         exception.GetType().Name +
  526:                         ": " +
  527:                         exception.Message
  528:                 };
  529:             }
  530: 
  531:             var timelineAfter =
  532:                 wildsEngine.Timeline.Count;
  533: 
  534:             var timelineRecorded =
  535:                 timelineAfter ==
  536:                 timelineBefore + 1 &&
  537:                 timelineAfter > 0 &&
  538:                 ReferenceEquals(
  539:                     moment,
  540:                     wildsEngine.Timeline
  541:                         .Moments[timelineAfter - 1]);
  542: 
  543:             var epochRecorded =
  544:                 wildsEngine.Epoch.Count == 1 &&
  545:                 wildsEngine.Epoch.Timelines.Count == 1 &&
  546:                 ReferenceEquals(
  547:                     wildsEngine.Timeline,
  548:                     wildsEngine.Epoch.Timelines[0]) &&
  549:                 wildsEngine.Epoch
  550:                     .Timelines[0]
  551:                     .Moments
  552:                     .Count ==
  553:                 timelineAfter &&
  554:                 ReferenceEquals(
  555:                     moment,
  556:                     wildsEngine.Epoch
  557:                         .Timelines[0]
  558:                         .Moments[timelineAfter - 1]);
  559: 
  560:             if (moment.Outcome ==
  561:                 MomentOutcome.Completed)
  562:             {
  563:                 return CreateCompletedResult(
  564:                     test,
  565:                     moment,
  566:                     expectsError,
  567:                     timelineRecorded,
  568:                     epochRecorded);
  569:             }
  570: 
  571:             if (moment.Outcome ==
  572:                     MomentOutcome.Failed &&
  573:                 moment.Exception is
  574:                     WildsQslExecutionException qslException)
  575:             {
  576:                 return CreateFailedQslResult(
  577:                     test,
  578:                     moment,
  579:                     qslException,
  580:                     expectsError,
  581:                     timelineRecorded,
  582:                     epochRecorded);
  583:             }
  584: 
  585:             return CreateUnexpectedResult(
  586:                 test,
  587:                 moment,
  588:                 timelineRecorded,
  589:                 epochRecorded);
  590:         }
  591: 
  592:         private static WildsQslCertificationResult CreateCompletedResult(
  593:             WildsQslCertificationTest test,
  594:             IMoment moment,
  595:             bool expectsError,
  596:             bool timelineRecorded,
  597:             bool epochRecorded)
  598:         {
  599:             var output =
  600:                 FormatValue(
  601:                     moment.Result);
  602: 
  603:             var passed =
  604:                 !expectsError &&
  605:                 moment.Exception == null &&
  606:                 moment.WorkUnitIds.Count == 1 &&
  607:                 timelineRecorded &&
  608:                 epochRecorded &&
  609:                 string.Equals(
  610:                     output,
  611:                     test.Expected,
  612:                     StringComparison.Ordinal);
  613: 
  614:             return new WildsQslCertificationResult
  615:             {
  616:                 Category =
  617:                     test.Category,
  618: 
  619:                 Statement =
  620:                     test.Statement,
  621: 
  622:                 Expected =
  623:                     test.Expected,
  624: 
  625:                 Output =
  626:                     output,
  627: 
  628:                 Dependency =
  629:                     test.Dependency,
  630: 
  631:                 Status =
  632:                     ClassifyResult(
  633:                         test,
  634:                         passed,
  635:                         dependencyMissing: false),
  636: 
  637:                 Passed =
  638:                     passed,
  639: 
  640:                 QslSucceeded =
  641:                     true,
  642: 
  643:                 EnteredWilds =
  644:                     true,
  645: 
  646:                 MomentCompleted =
  647:                     true,
  648: 
  649:                 TimelineRecorded =
  650:                     timelineRecorded,
  651: 
  652:                 EpochRecorded =
  653:                     epochRecorded,
  654: 
  655:                 MomentOutcome =
  656:                     moment.Outcome.ToString(),
  657: 
  658:                 ParseFailed =
  659:                     false,
  660: 
  661:                 EvaluationFailed =
  662:                     false,
  663: 
  664:                 ParserDiagnostics =
  665:                     Array.Empty<string>(),
  666: 
  667:                 RuntimeDiagnostics =
  668:                     Array.Empty<string>(),
  669: 
  670:                 Exception =
  671:                     null
  672:             };
  673:         }
  674: 
  675:         private static WildsQslCertificationResult CreateFailedQslResult(
  676:             WildsQslCertificationTest test,
  677:             IMoment moment,
  678:             WildsQslExecutionException qslException,
  679:             bool expectsError,
  680:             bool timelineRecorded,
  681:             bool epochRecorded)
  682:         {
  683:             var processingResult =
  684:                 qslException.Result;
  685: 
  686:             var parserDiagnostics =
  687:                 CopyParserDiagnostics(
  688:                     processingResult);
  689: 
  690:             var runtimeDiagnostics =
  691:                 CopyRuntimeDiagnostics(
  692:                     processingResult);
  693: 
  694:             var dependencyMissing =
  695:                 IsDeclaredDependencyMissing(
  696:                     test,
  697:                     runtimeDiagnostics);
  698: 
  699:             var passed =
  700:                 expectsError &&
  701:                 !processingResult.Succeeded &&
  702:                 moment.Result == null &&
  703:                 moment.WorkUnitIds.Count == 1 &&
  704:                 timelineRecorded &&
  705:                 epochRecorded;
  706: 
  707:             return new WildsQslCertificationResult
  708:             {
  709:                 Category =
  710:                     test.Category,
  711: 
  712:                 Statement =
  713:                     test.Statement,
  714: 
  715:                 Expected =
  716:                     test.Expected,
  717: 
  718:                 Output =
  719:                     FormatValue(
  720:                         processingResult.Value),
  721: 
  722:                 Dependency =
  723:                     test.Dependency,
  724: 
  725:                 Status =
  726:                     ClassifyResult(
  727:                         test,
  728:                         passed,
  729:                         dependencyMissing),
  730: 
  731:                 Passed =
  732:                     passed &&
  733:                     !dependencyMissing,
  734: 
  735:                 QslSucceeded =
  736:                     processingResult.Succeeded,
  737: 
  738:                 EnteredWilds =
  739:                     true,
  740: 
  741:                 MomentCompleted =
  742:                     false,
  743: 
  744:                 TimelineRecorded =
  745:                     timelineRecorded,
  746: 
  747:                 EpochRecorded =
  748:                     epochRecorded,
  749: 
  750:                 MomentOutcome =
  751:                     moment.Outcome.ToString(),
  752: 
  753:                 ParseFailed =
  754:                     processingResult.ParseFailed,
  755: 
  756:                 EvaluationFailed =
  757:                     processingResult.EvaluationFailed,
  758: 
  759:                 ParserDiagnostics =
  760:                     parserDiagnostics,
  761: 
  762:                 RuntimeDiagnostics =
  763:                     runtimeDiagnostics,
  764: 
  765:                 Exception =
  766:                     processingResult.Exception?.Message ??
  767:                     qslException.Message
  768:             };
  769:         }

  838:         private static void ValidateCompleteHistory(
  839:             WildsQslCertificationSuite suite,
  840:             global::WildsEngine.Core.WildsEngine wildsEngine)
  841:         {
  842:             Assert(
  843:                 wildsEngine.Timeline.Count ==
  844:                 suite.Tests.Count,
  845:                 "Wilds Timeline must contain exactly one " +
  846:                 "Moment per certification statement.");
  847: 
  848:             Assert(
  849:                 wildsEngine.Epoch.Count == 1,
  850:                 "The isolated certification Epoch must " +
  851:                 "contain exactly one Timeline.");
  852: 
  853:             Assert(
  854:                 wildsEngine.Epoch.Timelines.Count == 1,
  855:                 "The certification Epoch Timeline collection " +
  856:                 "must contain exactly one Timeline.");
  857: 
  858:             Assert(
  859:                 ReferenceEquals(
  860:                     wildsEngine.Timeline,
  861:                     wildsEngine.Epoch.Timelines[0]),
  862:                 "The Epoch must retain the engine Timeline.");
  863: 
  864:             Assert(
  865:                 wildsEngine.Epoch
  866:                     .Timelines[0]
  867:                     .Moments
  868:                     .Count ==
  869:                 suite.Tests.Count,
  870:                 "The Epoch must expose the complete " +
  871:                 "certification Moment history.");
  872:         }
  873: 
  874:         private static string[] CopyParserDiagnostics(
  875:             QslProcessingResult processingResult)
  876:         {
  877:             var diagnostics =
  878:                 new string[
  879:                     processingResult
  880:                         .ParserDiagnostics
  881:                         .Count
  882:                 ];
  883: 
  884:             for (
  885:                 var index = 0;
  886:                 index < diagnostics.Length;
  887:                 index++)
  888:             {
  889:                 diagnostics[index] =
  890:                     processingResult
  891:                         .ParserDiagnostics[index];
  892:             }
  893: 
  894:             return diagnostics;
  895:         }
  896: 
  897:         private static string[] CopyRuntimeDiagnostics(
  898:             QslProcessingResult processingResult)
  899:         {
  900:             var diagnostics =
  901:                 new string[
  902:                     processingResult
  903:                         .RuntimeDiagnostics
  904:                         .Count
  905:                 ];
  906: 
  907:             for (
  908:                 var index = 0;
  909:                 index < diagnostics.Length;
  910:                 index++)
  911:             {
  912:                 var entry =
  913:                     processingResult
  914:                         .RuntimeDiagnostics[index];
  915: 
  916:                 diagnostics[index] =
  917:                     "[" +
  918:                     entry.EntryType +
  919:                     "] " +
  920:                     entry.Source +
  921:                     ": " +
  922:                     entry.Message;
  923:             }
  924: 
  925:             return diagnostics;
  926:         }
  927: 
  928:         private static string FormatValue(
  929:             object? value)
  930:         {
  931:             if (value == null)
  932:             {
  933:                 return string.Empty;
  934:             }
  935: 
  936:             if (value is bool boolean)
  937:             {
  938:                 return boolean
  939:                     ? "true"
  940:                     : "false";
  941:             }
  942: 
  943:             if (value is string text)
  944:             {
  945:                 return text;
  946:             }
  947: 
  948:             if (value is char character)
  949:             {
  950:                 return character.ToString();
  951:             }
  952: 
  953:             if (value is IFormattable formattable)
  954:             {
  955:                 return formattable.ToString(
  956:                            null,
  957:                            CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) ??
  958:                        string.Empty;
  959:             }
  960: 
  961:             return value.ToString() ??
  962:                    string.Empty;
  963:         }

  965:         private static QslEngine CreateQslEngine()

  967:             var registry =
  968:                 new QslRuntimeRegistry();
  969:

  971: 
  972:             var context =
  973:                 new QslRuntimeContext(
  974:                     registry);
  975: 
  976:             return new QslEngine(
  977:                 context);
  978:         }

 1098:         private static void WriteResultDetails(
 1099:             WildsQslCertificationResult result)
 1100:         {

 1103:                 "[" +
 1104:                 result.Category +

 1109:                 "  Status: " +

 1111: 
 1112:             Console.WriteLine(
 1113:                 "  Dependency: " +
 1114:                 (result.Dependency ?? "<none>"));
 1115: 
 1116:             Console.WriteLine(
 1117:                 "  Expected: " +
 1118:                 (string.IsNullOrEmpty(
 1119:                     result.Expected)
 1120:                     ? "<error>"
 1121:                     : result.Expected));
 1122: 
 1123:             Console.WriteLine(
 1124:                 "  Actual: " +
 1125:                 (string.IsNullOrEmpty(
 1126:                     result.Output)
 1127:                     ? "<null>"
 1128:                     : result.Output));
 1129: 
 1130:             Console.WriteLine(
 1131:                 "  Outcome: " +
 1132:                 (string.IsNullOrEmpty(
 1133:                     result.MomentOutcome)
 1134:                     ? "<none>"
 1135:                     : result.MomentOutcome));
 1136: 
 1137:             Console.WriteLine(
 1138:                 "  QSL succeeded: " +
 1139:                 result.QslSucceeded);
 1140: 
 1141:             Console.WriteLine(
 1142:                 "  Entered Wilds: " +
 1143:                 result.EnteredWilds);
 1144: 
 1145:             Console.WriteLine(
 1146:                 "  Moment completed: " +
 1147:                 result.MomentCompleted);
 1148: 
 1149:             Console.WriteLine(
 1150:                 "  Timeline recorded: " +
 1151:                 result.TimelineRecorded);
 1152: 
 1153:             Console.WriteLine(
 1154:                 "  Epoch recorded: " +
 1155:                 result.EpochRecorded);
 1156: 
 1157:             foreach (var diagnostic in
 1158:                      result.ParserDiagnostics)
 1159:             {
 1160:                 Console.WriteLine(
 1161:                     "  Parser: " +
 1162:                     diagnostic);
 1163:             }
 1164: 
 1165:             foreach (var diagnostic in
 1166:                      result.RuntimeDiagnostics)
 1167:             {
 1168:                 Console.WriteLine(
 1169:                     "  Runtime: " +
 1170:                     diagnostic);
 1171:             }
 1172: 
 1173:             if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(
 1174:                     result.Exception))
 1175:             {
 1176:                 Console.WriteLine(
 1177:                     "  Exception: " +
 1178:                     result.Exception);
 1179:             }
 1180:         }
 1181: 
 1182:         private static void WriteReport(
 1183:             WildsQslCertificationReport report)
 1184:         {
 1185:             var reportPath =
 1186:                 Path.Combine(
 1187:                     AppContext.BaseDirectory,
 1188:                     "Certification",
 1189:                     ReportFileName);
 1190: 
 1191:             try
 1192:             {
 1193:                 var reportDirectory =
 1194:                     Path.GetDirectoryName(
 1195:                         reportPath);
 1196: 
 1197:                 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(
 1198:                         reportDirectory))
 1199:                 {
 1200:                     Directory.CreateDirectory(
 1201:                         reportDirectory);
 1202:                 }
 1203: 
 1204:                 var reportJson =
 1205:                     JsonSerializer.Serialize(
 1206:                         report,
 1207:                         new JsonSerializerOptions
 1208:                         {
 1209:                             WriteIndented =
 1210:                                 true,
 1211: 
 1212:                             Converters =
 1213:                             {
 1214:                                 new JsonStringEnumConverter()
 1215:                             }
 1216:                         });
 1217: 
 1218:                 File.WriteAllText(
 1219:                     reportPath,
 1220:                     reportJson);
 1221: 
 1222:                 TestLog.State(
 1223:                     "Certification report: " +
 1224:                     reportPath);
 1225:             }
 1226:             catch (Exception exception)
 1227:             {
 1228:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
 1229:                     "Certification report could not be written.",
 1230:                     exception);
 1231:             }
 1232:         }
 1233: 
 1234:         private static WildsQslCertificationStatus ClassifyResult(
 1235:             WildsQslCertificationTest test,
 1236:             bool behavioralPass,
 1237:             bool dependencyMissing)
 1238:         {
 1239:             if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
 1240:                     test.Dependency) &&
 1241:                 dependencyMissing)
 1242:             {
 1243:                 return WildsQslCertificationStatus
 1244:                     .MissingDependency;
 1245:             }
 1246: 
 1247:             return behavioralPass
 1248:                 ? WildsQslCertificationStatus.Passed
 1249:                 : WildsQslCertificationStatus.Failed;
 1250:         }
 1251: 
 1252:         private static bool IsDeclaredDependencyMissing(
 1253:             WildsQslCertificationTest test,
 1254:             IReadOnlyList<string> runtimeDiagnostics)
 1255:         {
 1256:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
 1257:                     test.Dependency))
 1258:             {
 1259:                 return false;
 1260:             }
 1261: 
 1262:             var expected =
 1263:                 "Unresolved identifier: " +
 1264:                 test.Dependency;
 1265: 
 1266:             foreach (var diagnostic in runtimeDiagnostics)
 1267:             {
 1268:                 if (diagnostic.Contains(
 1269:                         expected,
 1270:                         StringComparison.Ordinal))
 1271:                 {
 1272:                     return true;
 1273:                 }
 1274:             }
 1275: 
 1276:             return false;
 1277:         }
 1278: 
 1279:         private static string GetCertificationStatus(
 1280:             WildsQslCertificationReport report)
 1281:         {
 1282:             if (report.IsCertified)
 1283:             {
 1284:                 return "CERTIFIED";
 1285:             }
 1286: 
 1287:             if (report.Failed == 0 &&
 1288:                 report.MissingDependencies > 0)
 1289:             {
 1290:                 return
 1291:                     "INCOMPLETE - CONSUMER DEPENDENCIES MISSING";
 1292:             }
 1293: 
 1294:             return "NOT CERTIFIED";
 1295:         }
 1296: 
 1297:         private static void Assert(
 1298:             bool condition,
 1299:             string message)
 1300:         {
 1301:             if (!condition)
 1302:             {
 1303:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
 1304:                     message);
 1305:             }
 1306:         }
 1307:     }
 1308:     public static class WildsQslEndToEndCertification
 1309:     {
 1310:         public static async Task RunAllAsync()
 1311:         {
 1312:             TestLog.Write(
 1313:                 "=== Wilds / QSL End-to-End Certification ===");
 1314: 
 1315:             TestLog.State(
 1316:                 "Route: Wilds -> Pulse -> WorkUnit -> " +
 1317:                 "QSL -> WorkUnit result -> Moment -> " +
 1318:                 "Timeline -> Epoch");
 1319: 
 1320:             var tests =
 1321:                 new global::WildsEngine.Core.Tests
 1322:                     .WildsQslEndToEndTests();
 1323: 
 1324:             await tests
 1325:                 .QslWorkResolvesThroughCompleteWildsLifecycle()
 1326:                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
 1327: 
 1328:             TestLog.Pass(
 1329:                 "Wilds / QSL end-to-end lifecycle certification");
 1330:         }
 1331:     }
 1332: 
 1333:     public static class WildsQslProvenanceCertification

    1: using System;
    2: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    3: 
    4: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Tests
    5: {
    6:     /// <summary>
    7:     /// Shared console logger for WildsEngine certification
    8:     /// and diagnostic test output.
    9:     /// </summary>
   10:     public static class CertificationLogger
   11:     {
   12:         public static void LogSection(string title)
   13:         {
   14:             Console.WriteLine();
   15:             Console.WriteLine(
   16:                 "============================================");
   17:             Console.WriteLine(
   18:                 $" {title}");
   19:             Console.WriteLine(
   20:                 "============================================");
   21:         }
   22: 
   23:         public static void LogTest(string name)
   24:         {
   25:             Console.WriteLine(
   26:                 $"[TEST] {name}");
   27:         }
   28: 
   29:         public static void LogPass(string name)
   30:         {
   31:             WriteColored(
   32:                 ConsoleColor.Green,
   33:                 $"[PASS] {name}");
   34:         }
   35: 
   36:         public static void LogTask(string message)
   37:         {
   38:             WriteColored(
   39:                 ConsoleColor.DarkGray,
   40:                 $"    [TASK] {message}");
   41:         }
   42: 
   43:         public static void LogState(
   44:             string name,
   45:             object? value)
   46:         {
   47:             WriteColored(
   48:                 ConsoleColor.Cyan,
   49:                 $"    [STATE] {name} = {value}");
   50:         }
   51: 
   52:         public static void LogPool<T>(
   53:             string name,
   54:             IObjectPool<T> pool)
   55:             where T : class
   56:         {
   57:             if (pool == null)
   58:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(pool));
   59: 
   60:             WriteColored(
   61:                 ConsoleColor.DarkCyan,
   62:                 $"    [POOL] {name}");
   63: 
   64:             Console.WriteLine(
   65:                 $"           Active     : {pool.ActiveCount}");
   66: 
   67:             Console.WriteLine(
   68:                 $"           Available  : {pool.AvailableCount}");
   69: 
   70:             Console.WriteLine(
   71:                 $"           Created    : {pool.CreatedCount}");
   72: 
   73:             Console.WriteLine(
   74:                 $"           Retained   : {pool.MaximumRetained}");
   75: 
   76:             Console.WriteLine(
   77:                 $"           Concurrent : {pool.MaximumConcurrent}");
   78:         }
   79: 
   80:         public static void LogExpected<TException>()
   81:             where TException : Exception
   82:         {
   83:             WriteColored(
   84:                 ConsoleColor.DarkYellow,
   85:                 $"    [EXPECTED] {typeof(TException).Name}");
   86:         }
   87: 
   88:         private static void WriteColored(
   89:             ConsoleColor color,
   90:             string message)
   91:         {
   92:             var previousColor =
   93:                 Console.ForegroundColor;
   94: 
   95:             try
   96:             {
   97:                 Console.ForegroundColor = color;
   98: 
   99:                 Console.WriteLine(message);
  100:             }
  101:             finally
  102:             {
  103:                 Console.ForegroundColor =
  104:                     previousColor;
  105:             }
  106:         }
  107:     }
  108: }

    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using System.Threading;
    4: using System.Threading.Tasks;
    5: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    6: using WildsEngine.Core.Processing;
    7: using WildsEngine.Tests.Logging;
    8: using WildsEngine.Tests.Registry;
    9: using Xunit;
   10: 
   11: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Tests
   12: {
   13:     /// <summary>
   14:     /// Certifies the current complete processing route:
   15:     ///
   16:     /// WildsEngine
   17:     ///     -> instruction processor lease
   18:     ///     -> instruction registry
   19:     ///     -> task processor lease
   20:     ///     -> task registry
   21:     ///     -> processor return
   22:     ///     -> instruction removal
   23:     ///
   24:     /// These tests intentionally use the current composition surface.
   25:     /// They do not invent the future WildsEngine.Process(...) contract.
   26:     /// </summary>
   27:     public static class EndToEndProcessingTests
   28:     {
   29:         private static readonly List<string> Passed =
   30:             new List<string>();
   31: 
   32:         public static async Task RunAllAsync()
   33:         {
   34:             Passed.Clear();
   35: 
   36:             TestLog.Write(
   37:                 "=== End-to-End Processing Tests ===");
   38: 
   39:             await RunAsync(
   40:                     "Instruction flows through complete processing route",
   41:                     InstructionFlowsThroughCompleteProcessingRoute)
   42:                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
   43: 
   44:             await RunAsync(
   45:                     "Processing failure returns processors and removes instruction",
   46:                     ProcessingFailureReturnsProcessorsAndRemovesInstruction)
   47:                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
   48: 
   49:             await RunAsync(
   50:                     "Processing cancellation returns processors and removes instruction",
   51:                     ProcessingCancellationReturnsProcessorsAndRemovesInstruction)
   52:                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
   53: 
   54:             TestLog.Write(
   55:                 $"End-to-end processing tests passed: " +
   56:                 $"{Passed.Count}/{Passed.Count}");
   57:         }
   58: 
   59: private static async Task
   60:     InstructionFlowsThroughCompleteProcessingRoute()
   61: {
   62:     var component =
   63:         CreateComponent(
   64:             "certification.end-to-end.success");
   65: 
   66:     using var engine =
   67:         CreateEngine(
   68:             component);
   69: 
   70:     Assert.True(
   71:         engine.Initialize());
   72: 
   73:     var instruction =
   74:         new SetContextVariableInstruction(
   75:             "PlayerHealth",
   76:             10);
   77: 
   78:     IInstructionsRegistry? observedInstructionRegistry =
   79:         null;
   80: 
   81:     ITaskRegistry? observedTaskRegistry =
   82:         null;
   83: 
   84:     ITaskProcessor? observedTaskProcessor =
   85:         null;
   86: 
   87:     SetContextVariable? observedTask =
   88:         null;
   89: 
   90:     TestLog.Write(
   91:         $"[PARK] Instruction {instruction.Id}");
   92: 
   93:     var result =
   94:         await engine.ExecuteInstructionAsync<int>(
   95:                 async (
   96:                     instructionProcessor,
   97:                     cancellationToken) =>
   98:                 {
   99:                     cancellationToken
  100:                         .ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
  101: 
  102:                     Assert.Same(
  103:                         component,
  104:                         instructionProcessor.Component);
  105: 
  106:                     observedInstructionRegistry =
  107:                         instructionProcessor.Registry;
  108: 
  109:                     Assert.Same(
  110:                         component,
  111:                         observedInstructionRegistry.Component);
  112: 
  113:                     Assert.True(
  114:                         observedInstructionRegistry.Register(
  115:                             instruction));
  116: 
  117:                     Assert.True(
  118:                         observedInstructionRegistry.TryGet(
  119:                             instruction.Id,
  120:                             out var parkedInstruction));
  121: 
  122:                     Assert.Same(
  123:                         instruction,
  124:                         parkedInstruction);
  125: 
  126:                     TestLog.Write(
  127:                         $"[READ] Instruction {instruction.Id}");
  128: 
  129:                     try
  130:                     {
  131:                         using var taskLease =
  132:                             await instructionProcessor
  133:                                 .RentTaskProcessorAsync(
  134:                                     cancellationToken)
  135:                                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
  136: 
  137:                         cancellationToken
  138:                             .ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
  139: 
  140:                         observedTaskProcessor =
  141:                             taskLease.Instance;
  142: 
  143:                         observedTaskRegistry =
  144:                             observedTaskProcessor.Registry;
  145: 
  146:                         Assert.NotNull(
  147:                             observedTaskProcessor);
  148: 
  149:                         Assert.NotNull(
  150:                             observedTaskRegistry);
  151: 
  152:                         Assert.Same(
  153:                             component,
  154:                             observedTaskProcessor.Component);
  155: 
  156:                         Assert.Same(
  157:                             component,
  158:                             observedTaskRegistry.Component);
  159: 
  160:                         observedTask =
  161:                             new SetContextVariable(
  162:                                 component,
  163:                                 component.State.Context,
  164:                                 instruction.Key,
  165:                                 instruction.Value);
  166: 
  167:                         Assert.Same(
  168:                             component,
  169:                             observedTask.Component);
  170: 
  171:                         Assert.Same(
  172:                             component.State.Context,
  173:                             observedTask.Context);
  174: 
  175:                         Assert.True(
  176:                             observedTaskProcessor.RegisterTask(
  177:                                 observedTask));
  178: 
  179:                         Assert.True(
  180:                             observedTaskProcessor.ContainsTask(
  181:                                 observedTask.Id));
  182: 
  183:                         Assert.True(
  184:                             observedTaskProcessor.TryGetTask(
  185:                                 observedTask.Id,
  186:                                 out var parkedTask));
  187: 
  188:                         Assert.Same(
  189:                             observedTask,
  190:                             parkedTask);
  191: 
  192:                         TestLog.Write(
  193:                             $"[TASK] Parked task {observedTask.Id}");
  194: 
  195:                         try
  196:                         {
  197:                             cancellationToken
  198:                                 .ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
  199: 
  200:                             Assert.True(
  201:                                 component.State.Process(
  202:                                     instruction));
  203: 
  204:                             Assert.True(
  205:                                 component.State.Context.Variables
  206:                                     .TryGetValue(
  207:                                         instruction.Key,
  208:                                         out var processedValue));
  209: 
  210:                             Assert.Equal(
  211:                                 instruction.Value,
  212:                                 processedValue);
  213: 
  214:                             TestLog.State(
  215:                                 $"{instruction.Key}={processedValue}");
  216: 
  217:                             return Assert.IsType<int>(
  218:                                 processedValue);
  219:                         }
  220:                         finally
  221:                         {
  222:                             Assert.True(
  223:                                 observedTaskProcessor.RemoveTask(
  224:                                     observedTask.Id));
  225: 
  226:                             TestLog.Write(
  227:                                 $"[TASK] Removed task {observedTask.Id}");
  228:                         }
  229:                     }
  230:                     finally
  231:                     {
  232:                         Assert.True(
  233:                             observedInstructionRegistry.Remove(
  234:                                 instruction.Id));
  235: 
  236:                         TestLog.Write(
  237:                             $"[REMOVE] Instruction {instruction.Id}");
  238:                     }
  239:                 })
  240:             .ConfigureAwait(false);
  241: 
  242:     Assert.Equal(
  243:         10,
  244:         result);
  245: 
  246:     Assert.NotNull(
  247:         observedInstructionRegistry);
  248: 
  249:     Assert.NotNull(
  250:         observedTaskProcessor);
  251: 
  252:     Assert.NotNull(
  253:         observedTaskRegistry);
  254: 
  255:     Assert.NotNull(
  256:         observedTask);
  257: 
  258:     Assert.False(
  259:         observedInstructionRegistry.TryGet(
  260:             instruction.Id,
  261:             out _));
  262: 
  263:     Assert.False(
  264:         observedTaskProcessor.TryGetTask(
  265:             observedTask.Id,
  266:             out _));
  267: 
  268:     Assert.True(
  269:         component.State.Context.Variables
  270:             .TryGetValue(
  271:                 "PlayerHealth",
  272:                 out var finalPlayerHealth));
  273: 
  274:     Assert.Equal(
  275:         10,
  276:         Assert.IsType<int>(
  277:             finalPlayerHealth));
  278: 
  279:     Assert.Equal(
  280:         0,
  281:         engine.Instructions.ActiveCount);
  282: 
  283:     Assert.Equal(
  284:         1,
  285:         engine.Instructions.AvailableCount);
  286: 
  287:     TestLog.State(
  288:         "Successful stateful route complete | " +
  289:         $"PlayerHealth={finalPlayerHealth}, " +
  290:         $"Active={engine.Instructions.ActiveCount}, " +
  291:         $"Available={engine.Instructions.AvailableCount}, " +
  292:         $"Created={engine.Instructions.CreatedCount}");
  293: }
  294: 
  295:         private static async Task
  296:             ProcessingFailureReturnsProcessorsAndRemovesInstruction()
  297:         {
  298:             var component =
  299:                 CreateComponent(
  300:                     "certification.end-to-end.failure");
  301: 
  302:             using var engine =
  303:                 CreateEngine(
  304:                     component);
  305: 
  306:             Assert.True(
  307:                 engine.Initialize());
  308: 
  309:             var instruction =
  310:                 new SetContextVariableInstruction(
  311:                     "PlayerHealth",
  312:                     10);
  313: 
  314:             IInstructionsRegistry? observedInstructionRegistry =
  315:                 null;
  316: 
  317:             ITaskRegistry? observedTaskRegistry =
  318:                 null;
  319: 
  320:             TestLog.Write(
  321:                 $"[PARK] Failure instruction {instruction.Id}");
  322: 
  323:             await Assert.ThrowsAsync<ExpectedProcessingException>(
  324:                 async () =>
  325:                 {
  326:                     await engine.ExecuteInstructionAsync<int>(
  327:                             async (
  328:                                 instructionProcessor,
  329:                                 cancellationToken) =>
  330:                             {
  331:                                 Assert.Same(
  332:                                     component,
  333:                                     instructionProcessor.Component);

  336:                                     instructionProcessor.Registry;
  337: 
  338:                                 Assert.Same(
  339:                                     component,
  340:                                     observedInstructionRegistry.Component);
  341: 
  342:                                 Assert.True(
  343:                                     observedInstructionRegistry.Register(
  344:                                         instruction));

  346:                                 try
  347:                                 {
  348:                                     using var taskLease =
  349:                                         await instructionProcessor
  350:                                             .RentTaskProcessorAsync(
  351:                                                 cancellationToken)
  352:                                             .ConfigureAwait(false);
  353: 
  354:                                     Assert.Same(
  355:                                         component,
  356:                                         taskLease.Instance.Component);
  357: 
  358:                                     observedTaskRegistry =
  359:                                         taskLease.Instance.Registry;
  360: 
  361:                                     Assert.NotNull(
  362:                                         observedTaskRegistry);
  363: 
  364:                                     Assert.Same(
  365:                                         component,
  366:                                         observedTaskRegistry.Component);
  367: 
  368:                                     throw new ExpectedProcessingException();
  369:                                 }
  370:                                 finally
  371:                                 {
  372:                                     Assert.True(
  373:                                         observedInstructionRegistry.Remove(
  374:                                             instruction.Id));
  375: 
  376:                                     TestLog.Write(
  377:                                         $"[REMOVE] Failure instruction " +
  378:                                         $"{instruction.Id}");
  379:                                 }
  380:                             })
  381:                         .ConfigureAwait(false);
  382:                 });
  383: 
  384:             TestLog.Expected(
  385:                 nameof(ExpectedProcessingException));
  386: 
  387:             Assert.NotNull(
  388:                 observedInstructionRegistry);
  389: 
  390:             Assert.NotNull(
  391:                 observedTaskRegistry);
  392: 
  393:             Assert.False(
  394:                 observedInstructionRegistry.TryGet(
  395:                     instruction.Id,
  396:                     out _));
  397: 
  398:             Assert.Equal(
  399:                 0,
  400:                 engine.Instructions.ActiveCount);
  401: 
  402:             Assert.Equal(
  403:                 1,
  404:                 engine.Instructions.AvailableCount);
  405: 
  406:             TestLog.State(
  407:                 "Failure cleanup complete | " +
  408:                 $"Active={engine.Instructions.ActiveCount}, " +
  409:                 $"Available={engine.Instructions.AvailableCount}");
  410: 
  411:             var recoveryResult =
  412:                 await ExecuteRecoveryAsync(
  413:                         engine,
  414:                         component)
  415:                     .ConfigureAwait(false);
  416: 
  417:             Assert.Equal(
  418:                 42,
  419:                 recoveryResult);
  420: 
  421:             Assert.Equal(
  422:                 0,
  423:                 engine.Instructions.ActiveCount);
  424: 
  425:             TestLog.State(
  426:                 "Engine recovered after processing failure");
  427:         }
  428: 
  429:         private static async Task
  430:             ProcessingCancellationReturnsProcessorsAndRemovesInstruction()
  431:         {
  432:             var component =
  433:                 CreateComponent(
  434:                     "certification.end-to-end.cancellation");
  435: 
  436:             using var engine =
  437:                 CreateEngine(
  438:                     component);
  439: 
  440:             Assert.True(
  441:                 engine.Initialize());
  442: 
  443:             var instruction =
  444:                 new SetContextVariableInstruction(
  445:                     "PlayerHealth",
  446:                     10);
  447: 
  448:             IInstructionsRegistry? observedInstructionRegistry =
  449:                 null;
  450: 
  451:             ITaskRegistry? observedTaskRegistry =
  452:                 null;
  453: 
  454:             var enteredProcessing =
  455:                 new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(
  456:                     TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
  457: 
  458:             using var cancellation =
  459:                 new CancellationTokenSource();
  460: 
  461:             TestLog.Write(
  462:                 $"[PARK] Cancellation instruction {instruction.Id}");
  463: 
  464:             var processing =
  465:                 engine.ExecuteInstructionAsync<int>(
  466:                         async (
  467:                             instructionProcessor,
  468:                             cancellationToken) =>
  469:                         {
  470:                             Assert.Same(
  471:                                 component,
  472:                                 instructionProcessor.Component);
  473: 
  474:                             observedInstructionRegistry =
  475:                                 instructionProcessor.Registry;
  476: 
  477:                             Assert.Same(
  478:                                 component,
  479:                                 observedInstructionRegistry.Component);
  480: 
  481:                             Assert.True(
  482:                                 observedInstructionRegistry.Register(
  483:                                     instruction));
  484: 
  485:                             try
  486:                             {
  487:                                 using var taskLease =
  488:                                     await instructionProcessor
  489:                                         .RentTaskProcessorAsync(
  490:                                             cancellationToken)
  491:                                         .ConfigureAwait(false);
  492: 
  493:                                 Assert.Same(
  494:                                     component,
  495:                                     taskLease.Instance.Component);
  496: 
  497:                                 observedTaskRegistry =
  498:                                     taskLease.Instance.Registry;
  499: 
  500:                                 Assert.NotNull(
  501:                                     observedTaskRegistry);
  502: 
  503:                                 Assert.Same(
  504:                                     component,
  505:                                     observedTaskRegistry.Component);
  506: 
  507:                                 enteredProcessing.TrySetResult(
  508:                                     true);
  509: 
  510:                                 await Task.Delay(
  511:                                         Timeout.Infinite,
  512:                                         cancellationToken)
  513:                                     .ConfigureAwait(false);
  514: 
  515:                                 return 10;
  516:                             }
  517:                             finally
  518:                             {
  519:                                 Assert.True(
  520:                                     observedInstructionRegistry.Remove(
  521:                                         instruction.Id));
  522: 
  523:                                 TestLog.Write(
  524:                                     $"[REMOVE] Cancellation instruction " +
  525:                                     $"{instruction.Id}");
  526:                             }
  527:                         },
  528:                         cancellation.Token)
  529:                     .AsTask();
  530: 
  531:             await enteredProcessing.Task
  532:                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
  533: 
  534:             TestLog.Write(
  535:                 "[TASK] Cancelling active processing route");
  536: 
  537:             cancellation.Cancel();
  538: 
  539:             await Assert.ThrowsAnyAsync<OperationCanceledException>(
  540:                 async () =>
  541:                 {
  542:                     await processing
  543:                         .ConfigureAwait(false);
  544:                 });
  545: 
  546:             TestLog.Expected(
  547:                 nameof(OperationCanceledException));
  548: 
  549:             Assert.NotNull(
  550:                 observedInstructionRegistry);
  551: 
  552:             Assert.NotNull(
  553:                 observedTaskRegistry);
  554: 
  555:             Assert.False(
  556:                 observedInstructionRegistry.TryGet(
  557:                     instruction.Id,
  558:                     out _));
  559: 
  560:             Assert.Equal(
  561:                 0,
  562:                 engine.Instructions.ActiveCount);
  563: 
  564:             Assert.Equal(
  565:                 1,
  566:                 engine.Instructions.AvailableCount);
  567: 
  568:             TestLog.State(
  569:                 "Cancellation cleanup complete | " +
  570:                 $"Active={engine.Instructions.ActiveCount}, " +
  571:                 $"Available={engine.Instructions.AvailableCount}");
  572: 
  573:             var recoveryResult =
  574:                 await ExecuteRecoveryAsync(
  575:                         engine,
  576:                         component)
  577:                     .ConfigureAwait(false);
  578: 
  579:             Assert.Equal(
  580:                 42,
  581:                 recoveryResult);
  582: 
  583:             Assert.Equal(
  584:                 0,
  585:                 engine.Instructions.ActiveCount);
  586: 
  587:             TestLog.State(
  588:                 "Engine recovered after processing cancellation");
  589:         }
  590: 
  591:         private static async Task<int> ExecuteRecoveryAsync(
  592:             Core.WildsEngine engine,
  593:             IComponent component)
  594:         {
  595:             return await engine.ExecuteInstructionAsync<int>(
  596:                     async (
  597:                         instructionProcessor,
  598:                         cancellationToken) =>
  599:                     {
  600:                         Assert.Same(
  601:                             component,
  602:                             instructionProcessor.Component);
  603: 
  604:                         Assert.Same(
  605:                             component,
  606:                             instructionProcessor.Registry.Component);
  607: 
  608:                         using var taskLease =
  609:                             await instructionProcessor
  610:                                 .RentTaskProcessorAsync(
  611:                                     cancellationToken)
  612:                                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
  613: 
  614:                         Assert.NotNull(
  615:                             taskLease.Instance);
  616: 
  617:                         Assert.NotNull(
  618:                             taskLease.Instance.Registry);
  619: 
  620:                         Assert.Same(
  621:                             component,
  622:                             taskLease.Instance.Component);
  623: 
  624:                         Assert.Same(
  625:                             component,
  626:                             taskLease.Instance.Registry.Component);
  627: 
  628:                         return 42;
  629:                     })
  630:                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
  631:         }

  305:     [Fact]
  306:     public void ExtremeFiniteInputsDoNotProduceNonFiniteOutput()
  307:     {
  308:         TestLog.Section(
  309:             "EXTREME INPUT SAFETY - FINITE OVERFLOW CONTAINMENT");
  310: 
  311:         TestLog.Test(
  312:             "Extreme finite propagation inputs remain finite after exponential attenuation.");
  313: 
  314:         var topology =
  315:             new NeighborTopologyFixture();
  316: 
  317:         var extremeRelationship =
  318:             CreateRelationship(
  319:                 topology,
  320:                 topology.B,
  321:                 NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,
  322:                 double.MaxValue);
  323: 
  324:         var extremePropagation =
  325:             new ExponentialDistancePropagation(
  326:                 double.MaxValue);
  327: 
  328:         TestLog.Task(
  329:             "Propagating maximum finite intensity through maximum finite decay and distance.");
  330: 
  331:         var fullyAttenuated =
  332:             extremePropagation.Propagate(
  333:                 double.MaxValue,
  334:                 extremeRelationship);
  335: 
  336:         Assert.False(
  337:             double.IsNaN(
  338:                 fullyAttenuated));
  339: 
  340:         Assert.False(
  341:             double.IsInfinity(
  342:                 fullyAttenuated));
  343: 
  344:         Assert.Equal(
  345:             0.0,
  346:             fullyAttenuated);
  347: 
  348:         var zeroDecayTopology =
  349:             new NeighborTopologyFixture();
  350: 
  351:         var zeroDecayRelationship =
  352:             CreateRelationship(
  353:                 zeroDecayTopology,
  354:                 zeroDecayTopology.B,
  355:                 NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,
  356:                 double.MaxValue);
  357: 
  358:         var zeroDecayPropagation =
  359:             new ExponentialDistancePropagation(
  360:                 0.0);
  361: 
  362:         TestLog.Task(
  363:             "Propagating maximum finite intensity through zero decay at maximum finite distance.");
  364: 
  365:         var preserved =
  366:             zeroDecayPropagation.Propagate(
  367:                 double.MaxValue,
  368:                 zeroDecayRelationship);
  369: 
  370:         Assert.False(
  371:             double.IsNaN(
  372:                 preserved));
  373: 
  374:         Assert.False(
  375:             double.IsInfinity(
  376:                 preserved));
  377: 
  378:         Assert.Equal(
  379:             double.MaxValue,
  380:             preserved);
  381: 
  382:         TestLog.State(
  383:             $"Extreme attenuation result = {fullyAttenuated:R}");
  384: 
  385:         TestLog.State(
  386:             $"Zero-decay extreme result = {preserved:R}");
  387: 
  388:         TestLog.Pass(
  389:             "Extreme finite attenuation converged to finite zero.");
  390: 
  391:         TestLog.Pass(
  392:             "Zero decay preserved the maximum finite source intensity without overflow.");
  393:     }
