  395:     [Fact]
  396:     public void EqualDistanceNeighborOrderingIsDeterministic()
  397:     {
  398:         TestLog.Section(
  399:             "EXTREME INPUT SAFETY - DETERMINISTIC EQUAL-DISTANCE ORDER");
  400: 
  401:         TestLog.Test(
  402:             "Equal-distance Neighbors are ordered by membership and then exact Neighbor identity.");
  403: 
  404:         var topology =
  405:             new NeighborTopologyFixture();
  406: 
  407:         const double equalDistance =
  408:             10.0;
  409: 
  410:         Assert.True(
  411:             topology.A.State.Process(
  412:                 new AddNeighborInstruction(
  413:                     topology.D,
  414:                     "beta",
  415:                     equalDistance)));
  416: 
  417:         Assert.True(
  418:             topology.A.State.Process(
  419:                 new AddNeighborInstruction(
  420:                     topology.C,
  421:                     "alpha",
  422:                     equalDistance)));
  423: 
  424:         Assert.True(
  425:             topology.A.State.Process(
  426:                 new AddNeighborInstruction(
  427:                     topology.B,
  428:                     "alpha",
  429:                     equalDistance)));
  430: 
  431:         var first =
  432:             topology.A.ApplyNeighborOperator(
  433:                 new NearestNeighborOrder());
  434: 
  435:         var second =
  436:             topology.A.ApplyNeighborOperator(
  437:                 new NearestNeighborOrder());
  438: 
  439:         Assert.Equal(
  440:             3,
  441:             first.Count);
  442: 
  443:         Assert.Equal(
  444:             3,
  445:             second.Count);
  446: 
  447:         Assert.Equal(
  448:             "alpha",
  449:             first[0].Membership);
  450: 
  451:         Assert.Equal(
  452:             "alpha",
  453:             first[1].Membership);
  454: 
  455:         Assert.Equal(
  456:             "beta",
  457:             first[2].Membership);
  458: 
  459:         var expectedFirstAlphaId =
  460:             topology.B.Id.CompareTo(
  461:                 topology.C.Id) < 0
  462:                 ? topology.B.Id
  463:                 : topology.C.Id;
  464: 
  465:         var expectedSecondAlphaId =
  466:             topology.B.Id.CompareTo(
  467:                 topology.C.Id) < 0
  468:                 ? topology.C.Id
  469:                 : topology.B.Id;
  470: 
  471:         Assert.Equal(
  472:             expectedFirstAlphaId,
  473:             first[0].Neighbor.Id);
  474: 
  475:         Assert.Equal(
  476:             expectedSecondAlphaId,
  477:             first[1].Neighbor.Id);
  478: 
  479:         for (var index = 0;
  480:              index < first.Count;
  481:              index++)
  482:         {
  483:             Assert.Equal(
  484:                 first[index].Membership,
  485:                 second[index].Membership);
  486: 
  487:             Assert.Equal(
  488:                 first[index].Neighbor.Id,
  489:                 second[index].Neighbor.Id);
  490: 
  491:             Assert.Equal(
  492:                 equalDistance,
  493:                 first[index].Distance,
  494:                 10);
  495:         }
  496: 
  497:         var comparer =
  498:             new NeighborDistanceAscendingComparer();
  499: 
  500:         Assert.True(
  501:             comparer.Compare(
  502:                 topology.A,
  503:                 first[0],
  504:                 first[1]) < 0);
  505: 
  506:         Assert.True(
  507:             comparer.Compare(
  508:                 topology.A,
  509:                 first[1],
  510:                 first[0]) > 0);
  511: 
  512:         Assert.True(
  513:             comparer.Compare(
  514:                 topology.A,
  515:                 first[1],
  516:                 first[2]) < 0);
  517: 
  518:         TestLog.State(
  519:             $"Ordered[0] = {first[0].Membership}/{first[0].Neighbor.Id}");
  520: 
  521:         TestLog.State(
  522:             $"Ordered[1] = {first[1].Membership}/{first[1].Neighbor.Id}");
  523: 
  524:         TestLog.State(
  525:             $"Ordered[2] = {first[2].Membership}/{first[2].Neighbor.Id}");
  526: 
  527:         TestLog.Pass(
  528:             "Equal distance first deferred to ordinal membership.");
  529: 
  530:         TestLog.Pass(
  531:             "Equal distance and membership then deferred to Neighbor identity.");
  532: 
  533:         TestLog.Pass(
  534:             "Repeated ordering produced the same exact sequence.");
  535:     }
  536: 
  537:     [Fact]
  538:     public void ThresholdComparisonsRemainInclusiveAtExactBoundary()
  539:     {
  540:         TestLog.Section(
  541:             "EXTREME INPUT SAFETY - INCLUSIVE THRESHOLD");
  542: 
  543:         TestLog.Test(
  544:             "Minimum-intensity eligibility remains inclusive at the exact threshold.");
  545: 
  546:         const double threshold =
  547:             0.25;
  548: 
  549:         var eligibility =
  550:             new MinimumIntensityEligibility(
  551:                 threshold);
  552: 
  553:         var immediatelyBelow =
  554:             Math.BitDecrement(
  555:                 threshold);
  556: 
  557:         var immediatelyAbove =
  558:             Math.BitIncrement(
  559:                 threshold);
  560: 
  561:         TestLog.Task(
  562:             "Testing the nearest representable values below, at, and above the threshold.");
  563: 
  564:         Assert.False(
  565:             eligibility.IsEligible(
  566:                 immediatelyBelow));
  567: 
  568:         Assert.True(
  569:             eligibility.IsEligible(
  570:                 threshold));
  571: 
  572:         Assert.True(
  573:             eligibility.IsEligible(
  574:                 immediatelyAbove));
  575: 
  576:         TestLog.State(
  577:             $"Immediately below = {immediatelyBelow:R}");
  578: 
  579:         TestLog.State(
  580:             $"Exact threshold = {threshold:R}");
  581: 
  582:         TestLog.State(
  583:             $"Immediately above = {immediatelyAbove:R}");
  584: 
  585:         TestLog.Pass(
  586:             "Intensity immediately below the threshold was excluded.");
  587: 
  588:         TestLog.Pass(
  589:             "Intensity exactly at the threshold was included.");
  590: 
  591:         TestLog.Pass(
  592:             "Intensity immediately above the threshold was included.");
  593:     }
  594: 
  595:     private static INeighborRelationship CreateRelationship(
  596:         NeighborTopologyFixture topology,
  597:         IBaseObject neighbor,
  598:         string membership,
  599:         double distance)
  600:     {
  601:         Assert.True(
  602:             topology.A.State.Process(
  603:                 new AddNeighborInstruction(
  604:                     neighbor,
  605:                     membership,
  606:                     distance)));
  607: 
  608:         Assert.True(
  609:             topology.A.Neighbors.TryGet(
  610:                 neighbor.Id,
  611:                 membership,
  612:                 out var relationship));
  613: 
  614:         Assert.NotNull(
  615:             relationship);
  616: 
  617:         return relationship!;
  618:     }
  619: }

  470:     {
  471:         TestLog.Section(
  472:             "NEIGHBOR TOPOLOGY - OPERATOR PIPELINE DETERMINISM");
  473: 
  474:         TestLog.Test(
  475:             "Proving composed topology operations are deterministic and source-safe.");
  476: 
  477:         var topology =
  478:             new NeighborTopologyFixture();
  479: 
  480:         Assert.True(
  481:             topology.A.State.Process(
  482:                 new AddNeighborInstruction(

  485:                     6.0)));
  486: 
  487:         Assert.True(
  488:             topology.A.State.Process(
  489:                 new AddNeighborInstruction(
  490:                     topology.C,
  491:                     NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,
  492:                     2.0)));
  493: 
  494:         Assert.True(
  495:             topology.A.State.Process(
  496:                 new AddNeighborInstruction(
  497:                     topology.D,
  498:                     NeighborTopologyFixture.RemoteMembership,
  499:                     1.0)));
  500: 
  501:         var sourceBefore =
  502:             topology.A.Neighbors
  503:                 .Relationships
  504:                 .Select(

  507:                             relationship.Neighbor.Id,
  508:                             relationship.Membership,
  509:                             relationship.Distance))
  510:                 .ToArray();
  511: 
  512:         TestLog.State(

  514: 
  515:         TestLog.Task(
  516:             "Building local -> nearest-first topology pipeline.");
  517: 
  518:         var pipeline =
  519:             new NeighborPipeline(
  520:                 new MembershipNeighborFilter(

  522:                 new NearestNeighborOrder());
  523: 
  524:         var first =
  525:             topology.A.ApplyNeighborOperator(

  527: 
  528:         var second =

  530:                 pipeline);
  531: 
  532:         TestLog.Expected(
  533:             "Both executions should produce C then B.");
  534: 
  535:         Assert.Equal(
  536:             2,
  537:             first.Count);
  538: 
  539:         Assert.Equal(
  540:             2,
  541:             second.Count);
  542: 
  543:         Assert.Equal(
  544:             topology.C.Id,
  545:             first[0].Neighbor.Id);
  546: 
  547:         Assert.Equal(
  548:             topology.B.Id,
  549:             first[1].Neighbor.Id);
  550: 
  551:         Assert.Equal(
  552:             first.Select(
  553:                 relationship =>
  554:                     relationship.Neighbor.Id),
  555:             second.Select(
  556:                 relationship =>
  557:                     relationship.Neighbor.Id));
  558: 
  559:         TestLog.State(
  560:             $"Pipeline result 1 = {first[0].Neighbor.Slug} -> {first[1].Neighbor.Slug}");
  561: 
  562:         TestLog.State(
  563:             $"Pipeline result 2 = {second[0].Neighbor.Slug} -> {second[1].Neighbor.Slug}");
  564: 
  565:         TestLog.Task(
  566:             "Comparing source topology before and after pipeline execution.");
  567: 
  568:         var sourceAfter =
  569:             topology.A.Neighbors
  570:                 .Relationships
  571:                 .Select(
  572:                     relationship =>
  573:                         (
  574:                             relationship.Neighbor.Id,

  577:                 .ToArray();

  581:             sourceAfter);

  585:             topology.A.Neighbors.Count);
  586: 
  587:         TestLog.Pass(

  589: 
  590:         TestLog.Pass(
  591:             "Operator pipeline preserved the source Neighbor topology.");
  592:     }
  593:     
  594:     [Fact]
  595: public void Topology_Relationships_AreDirectional_AndDoNotImplyReciprocity()
  596: {
  597:     TestLog.Section(
  598:         "NEIGHBOR TOPOLOGY - DIRECTIONAL INDEPENDENCE");
  599: 
  600:     TestLog.Test(
  601:         "Proving A -> B does not implicitly create B -> A.");
  602: 
  603:     var topology =
  604:         new NeighborTopologyFixture();
  605: 
  606:     TestLog.Task(
  607:         "Creating A -> B through the local membership.");
  608: 
  609:     Assert.True(
  610:         topology.A.State.Process(
  611:             new AddNeighborInstruction(
  612:                 topology.B,
  613:                 NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,
  614:                 4.0)));
  615: 
  616:     TestLog.Expected(
  617:         "A should contain B, while B should remain topologically independent.");
  618: 
  619:     Assert.True(
  620:         topology.A.Neighbors.Contains(
  621:             topology.B.Id,
  622:             NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership));
  623: 
  624:     Assert.False(
  625:         topology.B.Neighbors.Contains(
  626:             topology.A.Id,
  627:             NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership));
  628: 
  629:     Assert.Equal(
  630:         1,
  631:         topology.A.Neighbors.Count);
  632: 
  633:     Assert.Equal(
  634:         0,
  635:         topology.B.Neighbors.Count);
  636: 
  637:     TestLog.State(
  638:         $"A Neighbor count = {topology.A.Neighbors.Count}");
  639: 
  640:     TestLog.State(
  641:         $"B Neighbor count = {topology.B.Neighbors.Count}");
  642: 
  643:     TestLog.Pass(
  644:         "A -> B did not implicitly create B -> A.");
  645: 
  646:     TestLog.Task(
  647:         "Creating an explicit B -> A relationship with independent distance.");
  648: 
  649:     Assert.True(
  650:         topology.B.State.Process(
  651:             new AddNeighborInstruction(
  652:                 topology.A,
  653:                 NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,
  654:                 9.0)));
  655: 
  656:     TestLog.Expected(
  657:         "A -> B and B -> A should now exist as independent relationships.");
  658: 
  659:     Assert.True(
  660:         topology.A.Neighbors.TryGet(
  661:             topology.B.Id,
  662:             NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,
  663:             out var aToB));
  664: 
  665:     Assert.True(
  666:         topology.B.Neighbors.TryGet(
  667:             topology.A.Id,
  668:             NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,
  669:             out var bToA));
  670: 
  671:     Assert.NotNull(
  672:         aToB);
  673: 
  674:     Assert.NotNull(
  675:         bToA);
  676: 
  677:     Assert.Equal(
  678:         4.0,
  679:         aToB!.Distance);
  680: 
  681:     Assert.Equal(
  682:         9.0,
  683:         bToA!.Distance);
  684: 
  685:     TestLog.State(
  686:         $"A -> B distance = {aToB.Distance}");
  687: 
  688:     TestLog.State(
  689:         $"B -> A distance = {bToA.Distance}");
  690: 
  691:     TestLog.Pass(
  692:         "Reciprocal topology can exist without sharing relationship state.");
  693: 
  694:     TestLog.Task(
  695:         "Changing A -> B without modifying B -> A.");
  696: 
  697:     Assert.True(
  698:         topology.A.State.Process(
  699:             new SetNeighborDistanceInstruction(
  700:                 topology.B.Id,
  701:                 NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,
  702:                 1.5)));
  703: 
  704:     Assert.True(
  705:         topology.A.Neighbors.TryGet(
  706:             topology.B.Id,
  707:             NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,
  708:             out aToB));
  709: 
  710:     Assert.True(
  711:         topology.B.Neighbors.TryGet(
  712:             topology.A.Id,
  713:             NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,
  714:             out bToA));
  715: 
  716:     Assert.NotNull(
  717:         aToB);
  718: 
  719:     Assert.NotNull(
  720:         bToA);
  721: 
  722:     Assert.Equal(
  723:         1.5,
  724:         aToB!.Distance);
  725: 
  726:     Assert.Equal(
  727:         9.0,
  728:         bToA!.Distance);
  729: 
  730:     TestLog.State(
  731:         $"Updated A -> B distance = {aToB.Distance}");
  732: 
  733:     TestLog.State(
  734:         $"Preserved B -> A distance = {bToA.Distance}");
  735: 
  736:     TestLog.Pass(
  737:         "Directional relationship state remained independent.");
  738: 
  739:     TestLog.Task(
  740:         "Removing A -> B while preserving B -> A.");
  741: 
  742:     Assert.True(
  743:         topology.A.State.Process(
  744:             new RemoveNeighborInstruction(
  745:                 topology.B.Id,
  746:                 NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership)));
  747: 
  748:     Assert.False(
  749:         topology.A.Neighbors.Contains(
  750:             topology.B.Id,
  751:             NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership));
  752: 
  753:     Assert.True(
  754:         topology.B.Neighbors.Contains(
  755:             topology.A.Id,
  756:             NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership));
  757: 
  758:     Assert.Equal(
  759:         0,
  760:         topology.A.Neighbors.Count);
  761: 
  762:     Assert.Equal(
  763:         1,
  764:         topology.B.Neighbors.Count);
  765: 
  766:     TestLog.Pass(
  767:         "Removing one direction did not alter the reciprocal relationship.");
  768: 
  769:     TestLog.Pass(
  770:         "Neighbor topology directional-independence certification completed successfully.");
  771: }
  772: }

    1: using System;
    2: using System.Threading;
    3: using System.Threading.Tasks;
    4: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    5: using WildsEngine.Core.Pooling;
    6: using WildsEngine.Tests.Logging;
    7: 
    8: namespace WildsEngine.Tests.Pooling
    9: {
   10:     public static class ObjectPoolTests
   11:     {
   12:         private static int _passed;
   13: 
   14:         public static async Task RunAllAsync()
   15:         {
   16:             _passed = 0;
   17:             TestLog.Write("=== ObjectPool Tests ===");
   18:             Run("Rent creates instance", RentCreatesInstance);
   19:             Run("Return retains instance", ReturnRetainsInstance);
   20:             Run("Rent reuses instance", RentReusesInstance);
   21:             Run("Double lease dispose is safe", DoubleLeaseDisposeIsSafe);
   22:             Run("Retention limit is enforced", RetentionLimitIsEnforced);
   23:             Run("Reset is called on return", ResetIsCalledOnReturn);
   24:             Run("Failed reset rejects instance", FailedResetRejectsInstance);
   25:             Run("Dispose clears retained instances", DisposeClearsRetainedInstances);
   26:             Run("Rent after dispose throws", RentAfterDisposeThrows);
   27:             await RunAsync("Concurrent rent is bounded", ConcurrentRentIsBoundedAsync);
   28:             await RunAsync("Waiting rent can be cancelled", WaitingRentCanBeCancelledAsync);
   29:             TestLog.Write($"=== ObjectPool Tests Passed: {_passed}/{_passed} ===");
   30:         }
   31: 
   32:         private static void RentCreatesInstance()
   33:         {
   34:             using var pool = CreatePool();
   35:             using var lease = pool.Rent();
   36:             LogState(pool, "After first rent");
   37:             Assert(lease.Instance != null, "Rent should return an instance.");
   38:             Assert(pool.CreatedCount == 1, "First rent should create one instance.");
   39:             Assert(pool.ActiveCount == 1, "First rent should create one active lease.");
   40:         }
   41: 
   42:         private static void ReturnRetainsInstance()
   43:         {
   44:             using var pool = CreatePool();
   45:             var lease = pool.Rent();
   46:             lease.Dispose();
   47:             LogState(pool, "After return");
   48:             Assert(pool.ActiveCount == 0, "Returned instance should no longer be active.");
   49:             Assert(pool.AvailableCount == 1, "Returned instance should be retained.");
   50:         }
   51: 
   52:         private static void RentReusesInstance()
   53:         {
   54:             using var pool = CreatePool();
   55:             TestPoolObject first;
   56:             using (var lease = pool.Rent()) first = lease.Instance;
   57:             using (var lease = pool.Rent())
   58:                 Assert(ReferenceEquals(first, lease.Instance), "Second rent should reuse retained instance.");
   59:             Assert(pool.CreatedCount == 1, "Reusing an instance should not create another object.");
   60:         }
   61: 
   62:         private static void DoubleLeaseDisposeIsSafe()
   63:         {
   64:             using var pool = CreatePool();
   65:             var lease = pool.Rent();
   66:             lease.Dispose();
   67:             lease.Dispose();
   68:             Assert(pool.ActiveCount == 0, "Double lease disposal must not double-return.");
   69:             Assert(pool.AvailableCount == 1, "Double disposal must retain only one instance.");
   70:         }
   71: 
   72:         private static void RetentionLimitIsEnforced()
   73:         {
   74:             using var pool = new ObjectPool<TestPoolObject>(() => new TestPoolObject(), 1, 2);
   75:             var first = pool.Rent();
   76:             var second = pool.Rent();
   77:             first.Dispose();
   78:             second.Dispose();
   79:             LogState(pool, "After retention test");
   80:             Assert(pool.AvailableCount == 1, "Pool should retain no more than MaximumRetained.");
   81:             Assert(pool.CreatedCount == 2, "Two simultaneous leases should require two instances.");
   82:         }
   83: 
   84:         private static void ResetIsCalledOnReturn()
   85:         {
   86:             using var pool = CreatePool();
   87:             TestPoolObject instance;
   88:             using (var lease = pool.Rent()) { instance = lease.Instance; instance.Value = 42; }
   89:             TestLog.State($"ResetCount = {instance.ResetCount}; Value = {instance.Value}");
   90:             Assert(instance.ResetCount == 1, "Returning pooled object should call TryReset.");
   91:             Assert(instance.Value == 0, "Reset should clear transient state.");
   92:         }
   93: 
   94:         private static void FailedResetRejectsInstance()
   95:         {
   96:             using var pool = new ObjectPool<TestPoolObject>(() => new TestPoolObject { AllowReset = false }, 4, 4);
   97:             using (var lease = pool.Rent()) { }
   98:             Assert(pool.ActiveCount == 0, "Rejected instance should no longer be active.");
   99:             Assert(pool.AvailableCount == 0, "Failed reset should prevent retention.");
  100:         }
  101: 
  102:         private static void DisposeClearsRetainedInstances()
  103:         {
  104:             var pool = CreatePool();
  105:             TestPoolObject instance;
  106:             using (var lease = pool.Rent()) instance = lease.Instance;
  107:             pool.Dispose();
  108:             Assert(pool.AvailableCount == 0, "Disposal should clear retained instances.");
  109:             Assert(instance.IsDisposed, "Retained disposable instance should be disposed.");
  110:         }
  111: 
  112:         private static void RentAfterDisposeThrows()
  113:         {
  114:             var pool = CreatePool();
  115:             pool.Dispose();
  116:             var threw = false;
  117:             try { pool.Rent(); }
  118:             catch (ObjectDisposedException) { threw = true; TestLog.Expected("ObjectDisposedException"); }
  119:             Assert(threw, "Rent after pool disposal should throw.");
  120:         }
  121: 
  122:         private static async Task ConcurrentRentIsBoundedAsync()
  123:         {
  124:             using var pool = new ObjectPool<TestPoolObject>(() => new TestPoolObject(), 2, 2);
  125:             using var first = await pool.RentAsync();
  126:             using var second = await pool.RentAsync();
  127:             using var cancellation = new CancellationTokenSource();
  128:             var waiting = pool.RentAsync(cancellation.Token);
  129:             Assert(!waiting.IsCompletedSuccessfully, "Additional asynchronous rent should wait.");
  130:             cancellation.Cancel();
  131:             var cancelled = false;
  132:             try { using var ignored = await waiting; }
  133:             catch (OperationCanceledException) { cancelled = true; TestLog.Expected("OperationCanceledException"); }
  134:             Assert(cancelled, "Waiting rent should observe cancellation.");
  135:             Assert(pool.ActiveCount == 2, "Existing leases should remain active.");
  136:         }
  137: 
  138:         private static async Task WaitingRentCanBeCancelledAsync()
  139:         {
  140:             using var pool = new ObjectPool<TestPoolObject>(() => new TestPoolObject(), 1, 1);
  141:             using var active = await pool.RentAsync();
  142:             using var cancellation = new CancellationTokenSource();
  143:             var waiting = pool.RentAsync(cancellation.Token);
  144:             cancellation.Cancel();
  145:             var cancelled = false;
  146:             try { using var ignored = await waiting; }
  147:             catch (OperationCanceledException) { cancelled = true; TestLog.Expected("OperationCanceledException"); }
  148:             Assert(cancelled, "Cancellation should release a waiting renter.");
  149:             Assert(pool.ActiveCount == 1, "Cancellation must not affect existing lease.");
  150:         }
  151: 
  152:         private static ObjectPool<TestPoolObject> CreatePool() =>
  153:             new ObjectPool<TestPoolObject>(() => new TestPoolObject(), 4, 4);
  154: 
  155:         private static void Run(string name, Action test)
  156:         {
  157:             TestLog.Test(name);
  158:             try { test(); _passed++; TestLog.Pass(name); }
  159:             catch (Exception ex) { TestLog.Fail(name, ex); throw; }
  160:         }
  161: 
  162:         private static async Task RunAsync(string name, Func<Task> test)
  163:         {
  164:             TestLog.Test(name);
  165:             try { await test().ConfigureAwait(false); _passed++; TestLog.Pass(name); }
  166:             catch (Exception ex) { TestLog.Fail(name, ex); throw; }
  167:         }
  168: 
  169:         private static void LogState(ObjectPool<TestPoolObject> pool, string message) =>
  170:             TestLog.State($"{message} | Active={pool.ActiveCount}, Available={pool.AvailableCount}, Created={pool.CreatedCount}, Maximum={pool.MaximumConcurrent}");
  171: 
  172:         private static void Assert(bool condition, string message)
  173:         {
  174:             if (!condition) throw new InvalidOperationException($"ObjectPool test failed: {message}");
  175:         }
  176: 
  177:         private sealed class TestPoolObject : IResettablePoolObject, IDisposable
  178:         {
  179:             public int Value { get; set; }
  180:             public int ResetCount { get; private set; }
  181:             public bool AllowReset { get; set; } = true;
  182:             public bool IsDisposed { get; private set; }
  183:             public bool TryReset() { ResetCount++; if (!AllowReset) return false; Value = 0; return true; }
  184:             public void Dispose() => IsDisposed = true;
  185:         }
  186:     }
  187: }

   13:     {

   15:             "NEIGHBOR PROPAGATION - EXPONENTIAL DISTANCE ATTENUATION");
   16:

   18:             "Proving propagation intensity attenuates according to Neighbor distance.");
   19: 
   20:         var topology =
   21:             new NeighborTopologyFixture();
   22:

   24:             1.0;
   25:

   27:             0.5;
   28:

   30:             "Creating A -> B at distance 1.");

   33:             topology.A.State.Process(
   34:                 new AddNeighborInstruction(
   35:                     topology.B,
   36:                     NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,

   38:

   40:             "Creating A -> C at distance 3.");
   41: 
   42:         Assert.True(
   43:             topology.A.State.Process(

   45:                     topology.C,
   46:                     NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,

   48:

   51:                 topology.B.Id,

   54: 
   55:         Assert.True(
   56:             topology.A.Neighbors.TryGet(
   57:                 topology.C.Id,
   58:                 NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,
   59:                 out var relationshipC));
   60:

   62:             relationshipB);
   63: 
   64:         Assert.NotNull(
   65:             relationshipC);
   66: 
   67:         var propagation =
   68:             new ExponentialDistancePropagation(
   69:                 decay);
   70: 
   71:         TestLog.State(
   72:             $"Source intensity = {sourceIntensity}");
   73: 
   74:         TestLog.State(
   75:             $"Decay = {decay}");

   78:             $"B distance = {relationshipB!.Distance}");
   79: 
   80:         TestLog.State(
   81:             $"C distance = {relationshipC!.Distance}");
   82: 
   83:         TestLog.Task(
   84:             "Propagating source intensity independently to B and C.");
   85: 
   86:         var intensityB =
   87:             propagation.Propagate(
   88:                 sourceIntensity,
   89:                 relationshipB);
   90: 
   91:         var intensityC =
   92:             propagation.Propagate(
   93:                 sourceIntensity,
   94:                 relationshipC);
   95: 
   96:         var expectedB =
   97:             sourceIntensity *
   98:             Math.Exp(
   99:                 -decay *
  100:                 relationshipB.Distance);
  101: 
  102:         var expectedC =
  103:             sourceIntensity *
  104:             Math.Exp(
  105:                 -decay *
  106:                 relationshipC.Distance);
  107: 
  108:         TestLog.Expected(
  109:             $"B intensity = {expectedB:R}");
  110: 
  111:         TestLog.Expected(
  112:             $"C intensity = {expectedC:R}");
  113: 
  114:         TestLog.State(
  115:             $"B received intensity = {intensityB:R}");
  116: 
  117:         TestLog.State(
  118:             $"C received intensity = {intensityC:R}");
  119: 
  120:         Assert.Equal(
  121:             expectedB,
  122:             intensityB,
  123:             12);
  124: 
  125:         Assert.Equal(
  126:             expectedC,
  127:             intensityC,
  128:             12);
  129: 
  130:         Assert.True(
  131:             intensityB <
  132:             sourceIntensity);
  133: 
  134:         Assert.True(
  135:             intensityC <
  136:             intensityB);
  137: 
  138:         Assert.True(
  139:             intensityC >
  140:             0.0);
  141: 
  142:         TestLog.Pass(
  143:             "Propagation attenuated monotonically with increasing Neighbor distance.");
  144:

  146:             "Exponential Neighbor propagation certification completed successfully.");

  307: 
  308:         TestLog.Pass(
  309:             "Propagation input validation completed successfully.");
  310:     }

  444:     [Fact]
  445:     public void PropagatedIntensity_DeterminesNeighborEligibility()
  446:     {
  447:         TestLog.Section(
  448:             "NEIGHBOR PROPAGATION - ATTENUATION TO ELIGIBILITY");
  449: 
  450:         TestLog.Test(
  451:             "Proving certified topology and attenuation determine which Neighbors qualify.");
  452: 
  453:         var topology =
  454:             new NeighborTopologyFixture();
  455: 
  456:         const double sourceIntensity =
  457:             1.0;
  458: 
  459:         const double decay =
  460:             0.5;
  461: 
  462:         const double threshold =
  463:             0.25;
  464: 
  465:         Assert.True(
  466:             topology.A.State.Process(
  467:                 new AddNeighborInstruction(
  468:                     topology.B,
  469:                     NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,
  470:                     1.0)));
  471: 
  472:         Assert.True(
  473:             topology.A.State.Process(
  474:                 new AddNeighborInstruction(
  475:                     topology.C,
  476:                     NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,
  477:                     3.0)));
  478: 
  479:         Assert.True(
  480:             topology.A.Neighbors.TryGet(
  481:                 topology.B.Id,
  482:                 NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,
  483:                 out var relationshipB));
  484: 
  485:         Assert.True(
  486:             topology.A.Neighbors.TryGet(
  487:                 topology.C.Id,
  488:                 NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,
  489:                 out var relationshipC));
  490: 
  491:         Assert.NotNull(
  492:             relationshipB);
  493: 
  494:         Assert.NotNull(
  495:             relationshipC);
  496: 
  497:         var propagation =
  498:             new ExponentialDistancePropagation(
  499:                 decay);
  500: 
  501:         var eligibility =
  502:             new MinimumIntensityEligibility(
  503:                 threshold);
  504: 
  505:         var intensityB =
  506:             propagation.Propagate(
  507:                 sourceIntensity,
  508:                 relationshipB!);
  509: 
  510:         var intensityC =
  511:             propagation.Propagate(
  512:                 sourceIntensity,
  513:                 relationshipC!);
  514: 
  515:         TestLog.State(
  516:             $"Source intensity = {sourceIntensity:R}");
  517: 
  518:         TestLog.State(
  519:             $"Eligibility threshold = {threshold:R}");
  520: 
  521:         TestLog.State(
  522:             $"B distance = {relationshipB.Distance:R}");
  523: 
  524:         TestLog.State(
  525:             $"B received intensity = {intensityB:R}");
  526: 
  527:         TestLog.State(
  528:             $"C distance = {relationshipC.Distance:R}");
  529: 
  530:         TestLog.State(
  531:             $"C received intensity = {intensityC:R}");
  532: 
  533:         TestLog.Expected(
  534:             "B should qualify and C should fall below the response threshold.");
  535: 
  536:         Assert.True(
  537:             eligibility.IsEligible(
  538:                 intensityB));
  539: 
  540:         Assert.False(
  541:             eligibility.IsEligible(
  542:                 intensityC));
  543: 
  544:         TestLog.Pass(
  545:             "B was selected as an eligible propagation recipient.");
  546: 
  547:         TestLog.Pass(
  548:             "C remained below the propagation eligibility threshold.");
  549: 
  550:         TestLog.Pass(
  551:             "Topology -> propagation -> eligibility boundary completed successfully.");
  552:     }
  553: }

FILE: WildsEngine.Core.Tests\PulseDecompositionCertificationTests.cs

    1: using System;
    2: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.Processing.Coordinator;
    4: using WildsEngine.Core.Units;
    5: using WildsEngine.Tests.Logging;
    6: using Xunit;
    7: 
    8: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Tests;
    9: 
   10: public sealed class PulseDecompositionCertificationTests
   11: {
   12:     [Fact]
   13:     public void
   14:         OneRequestCanOwnMultipleRequiredWorkUnits()
   15:     {
   16:         TestLog.Section(
   17:             "PULSE MULTI-WORK DECOMPOSITION");
   18: 
   19:         TestLog.Test(
   20:             "One request owns multiple required WorkUnits through one Pulse.");
   21: 
   22:         var request =
   23:             new TestRuntimeObject(
   24:                 "consumer-request");
   25: 
   26:         var pulse =
   27:             new Pulse(
   28:                 request);
   29: 
   30:         Assert.True(
   31:             pulse.TryBeginDecomposition());
   32: 
   33:         var qslWork =
   34:             new WorkUnit(
   35:                 pulse.Id,
   36:                 new TestRuntimeObject(
   37:                     "qsl-work"));
   38: 
   39:         var instructionWork =
   40:             new WorkUnit(
   41:                 pulse.Id,
   42:                 new TestRuntimeObject(
   43:                     "instruction-work"));
   44: 
   45:         var taskWork =
   46:             new WorkUnit(
   47:                 pulse.Id,
   48:                 new TestRuntimeObject(
   49:                     "task-work"));
   50: 
   51:         var coordinator =
   52:             new PulseCoordinator(
   53:                 pulse);
   54: 
   55:         Assert.True(
   56:             coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
   57:                 qslWork));
   58: 
   59:         Assert.True(
   60:             coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
   61:                 instructionWork));
   62: 
   63:         Assert.True(
   64:             coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
   65:                 taskWork));
   66: 
   67:         Assert.Equal(
   68:             3,
   69:             coordinator.WorkUnitCount);
   70: 
   71:         Assert.Equal(
   72:             pulse.Id,
   73:             qslWork.PulseId);
   74: 
   75:         Assert.Equal(
   76:             pulse.Id,
   77:             instructionWork.PulseId);
   78: 
   79:         Assert.Equal(
   80:             pulse.Id,
   81:             taskWork.PulseId);
   82: 
   83:         Assert.NotEqual(
   84:             qslWork.Id,
   85:             instructionWork.Id);
   86: 
   87:         Assert.NotEqual(
   88:             qslWork.Id,
   89:             taskWork.Id);
   90: 
   91:         Assert.NotEqual(
   92:             instructionWork.Id,
   93:             taskWork.Id);
   94: 
   95:         TestLog.State(
   96:             $"Pulse = {pulse.Id}");
   97: 
   98:         TestLog.State(
   99:             $"Required WorkUnits = {coordinator.WorkUnitCount}");
  100: 
  101:         TestLog.State(
  102:             $"QSL WorkUnit = {qslWork.Id}");
  103: 
  104:         TestLog.State(
  105:             $"Instruction WorkUnit = {instructionWork.Id}");
  106: 
  107:         TestLog.State(
  108:             $"Task WorkUnit = {taskWork.Id}");
  109: 
  110:         TestLog.Pass(
  111:             "One request decomposed into three distinct required WorkUnits.");
  112: 
  113:         TestLog.Pass(
  114:             "Every WorkUnit retained the owning Pulse identity.");
  115:     }

  120:     {
  121:         TestLog.Section(
  122:             "PULSE MULTI-WORK SUCCESS");
  123: 
  124:         TestLog.Test(
  125:             "All required WorkUnits produce one authoritative completed Moment.");
  126: 
  127:         var request =
  128:             new TestRuntimeObject(
  129:                 "successful-multi-work-request");

  142:                 pulse,

  146:             CreateProcessingWork(

  152:                 pulse);

  157:

  159:             coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  160:                 instructionWork));
  161: 
  162:         Assert.True(
  163:             coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  164:                 taskWork));
  165:

  167:             new TestRuntimeObject(
  168:                 "qsl-result");

  216:             coordinator.CanResolve);

  236:

  238:             pulse.IsTerminal);

  242:             moment.PulseId);
  243: 
  244:         Assert.Equal(
  245:             3,
  246:             moment.WorkUnitIds.Count);

  249:             qslWork.Id,
  250:             moment.WorkUnitIds);
  251: 
  252:         Assert.Contains(
  253:             instructionWork.Id,
  254:             moment.WorkUnitIds);
  255:

  257:             taskWork.Id,
  258:             moment.WorkUnitIds);
  259: 
  260:         Assert.Same(
  261:             finalResult,
  262:             moment.Result);
  263: 
  264:         Assert.Null(
  265:             moment.Exception);
  266: 
  267:         Assert.Same(
  268:             qslResult,
  269:             qslWork.Result);
  270: 
  271:         Assert.Same(
  272:             instructionResult,
  273:             instructionWork.Result);
  274:

  276:             taskResult,
  277:             taskWork.Result);

  280:             ReferenceEquals(
  281:                 qslResult,
  282:                 moment.Result));
  283:

  285:             ReferenceEquals(
  286:                 instructionResult,
  287:                 moment.Result));
  288:

  290:             ReferenceEquals(
  291:                 taskResult,
  292:                 moment.Result));

  314:

  317: 
  318:         TestLog.Pass(
  319:             "The Pulse could not produce a second Moment.");

  322:     [Fact]
  323:     public void
  324:         PartialCompletionFollowedByFailureProducesFailedMoment()
  325:     {
  326:         TestLog.Section(
  327:             "PULSE MULTI-WORK PARTIAL FAILURE");
  328: 
  329:         TestLog.Test(
  330:             "Partial success followed by failure produces an honest failed Moment.");
  331: 
  332:         var pulse =
  333:             CreateProcessingPulse(
  334:                 new TestRuntimeObject(
  335:                     "partial-failure-request"));
  336: 
  337:         var completed =
  338:             CreateProcessingWork(
  339:                 pulse,
  340:                 "completed-work");
  341: 
  342:         var failed =
  343:             CreateProcessingWork(
  344:                 pulse,
  345:                 "failed-work");
  346: 
  347:         var remaining =
  348:             CreateProcessingWork(
  349:                 pulse,
  350:                 "remaining-work");
  351: 
  352:         var coordinator =
  353:             new PulseCoordinator(
  354:                 pulse);
  355: 
  356:         Assert.True(
  357:             coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  358:                 completed));
  359: 
  360:         Assert.True(
  361:             coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  362:                 failed));
  363: 
  364:         Assert.True(
  365:             coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  366:                 remaining));
  367: 
  368:         var subordinateResult =
  369:             new TestRuntimeObject(
  370:                 "subordinate-success-result");
  371: 
  372:         var forbiddenFinalResult =
  373:             new TestRuntimeObject(
  374:                 "must-not-be-final-result");
  375: 
  376:         var failure =
  377:             new ExpectedDecompositionException(
  378:                 "Expected multi-work failure.");
  379: 
  380:         Assert.True(
  381:             completed.TryComplete(
  382:                 subordinateResult));
  383: 
  384:         Assert.True(
  385:             failed.TryFail(
  386:                 failure));
  387: 
  388:         Assert.False(
  389:             coordinator.CanResolve);
  390: 
  391:         Assert.False(
  392:             coordinator.CanFinalize);
  393: 
  394:         Assert.False(
  395:             coordinator.TryFinalize(
  396:                 forbiddenFinalResult,
  397:                 out var prematureMoment));
  398: 
  399:         Assert.Null(
  400:             prematureMoment);
  401: 
  402:         Assert.Equal(
  403:             PulseStatus.Processing,
  404:             pulse.Status);
  405: 
  406:         TestLog.Expected(
  407:             "Known failure could not finalize while required work remained unresolved.");
  408: 
  409:         Assert.True(
  410:             remaining.TryComplete(
  411:                 new TestRuntimeObject(
  412:                     "remaining-result")));
  413: 
  414:         Assert.False(
  415:             coordinator.CanResolve);
  416: 
  417:         Assert.True(
  418:             coordinator.CanFinalize);
  419: 
  420:         Assert.True(
  421:             coordinator.TryFinalize(
  422:                 forbiddenFinalResult,
  423:                 out var moment));
  424: 
  425:         Assert.NotNull(
  426:             moment);
  427: 
  428:         Assert.Equal(
  429:             MomentOutcome.Failed,
  430:             moment!.Outcome);
  431: 
  432:         Assert.Equal(
  433:             PulseStatus.Failed,
  434:             pulse.Status);
  435: 
  436:         Assert.True(
  437:             pulse.IsTerminal);
  438: 
  439:         Assert.Null(
  440:             moment.Result);
  441: 
  442:         Assert.Same(
  443:             failure,
  444:             moment.Exception);
  445: 
  446:         Assert.Equal(
  447:             3,
  448:             moment.WorkUnitIds.Count);
  449: 
  450:         Assert.Contains(
  451:             completed.Id,
  452:             moment.WorkUnitIds);
  453: 
  454:         Assert.Contains(
  455:             failed.Id,
  456:             moment.WorkUnitIds);
  457: 
  458:         Assert.Contains(
  459:             remaining.Id,
  460:             moment.WorkUnitIds);
  461: 
  462:         Assert.Same(
  463:             subordinateResult,
  464:             completed.Result);
  465: 
  466:         Assert.False(
  467:             ReferenceEquals(
  468:                 subordinateResult,
  469:                 moment.Result));
  470: 
  471:         Assert.False(
  472:             ReferenceEquals(
  473:                 forbiddenFinalResult,
  474:                 moment.Result));
  475: 
  476:         TestLog.State(
  477:             $"Pulse outcome = {pulse.Status}");
  478: 
  479:         TestLog.State(
  480:             $"Moment outcome = {moment.Outcome}");
  481: 
  482:         TestLog.State(
  483:             $"Exception = {moment.Exception!.Message}");
  484: 
  485:         TestLog.Pass(
  486:             "Partial success could not masquerade as Pulse success.");
  487: 
  488:         TestLog.Pass(
  489:             "The exact WorkUnit failure became authoritative history.");
  490:     }

  652: 
  653:     private static Pulse CreateProcessingPulse(
  654:         object? request)
  655:     {
  656:         var pulse =
  657:             new Pulse(
  658:                 request);
  659: 
  660:         Assert.True(
  661:             pulse.TryBeginDecomposition());
  662: 
  663:         Assert.True(
  664:             pulse.TryMarkPending());
  665: 
  666:         Assert.True(
  667:             pulse.TryMarkReady());
  668: 
  669:         Assert.True(
  670:             pulse.TryBeginProcessing());
  671: 
  672:         return pulse;
  673:     }
  674: 
  675:     private static WorkUnit CreateProcessingWork(
  676:         Pulse pulse,
  677:         object? payload)
  678:     {
  679:         var work =
  680:             new WorkUnit(
  681:                 pulse.Id,
  682:                 payload);
  683: 
  684:         Assert.True(
  685:             work.TryMarkPending());
  686: 
  687:         Assert.True(
  688:             work.TryBeginProcessing());
  689: 
  690:         return work;
  691:     }
  692: 
  693:     private sealed class TestRuntimeObject
  694:     {
  695:         public TestRuntimeObject(
  696:             string name)
  697:         {
  698:             Name =
  699:                 name;
  700:         }
  701: 
  702:         public string Name { get; }
  703:     }
  704: 
  705:     private sealed class ExpectedDecompositionException :
  706:         Exception
  707:     {
  708:         public ExpectedDecompositionException(
  709:             string message)
  710:             : base(
  711:                 message)
  712:         {
  713:         }
  714:     }
  715: }

  205:         [Fact]
  206:         public void FailureTakesPrecedenceOverCancellation()
  207:         {
  208:             var pulse =
  209:                 CreateProcessingPulse(
  210:                     "mixed-terminal-request");
  211: 
  212:             var failed =
  213:                 CreateProcessingWork(
  214:                     pulse,
  215:                     "failed-work");
  216: 
  217:             var cancelled =
  218:                 new WorkUnit(
  219:                     pulse.Id,
  220:                     "cancelled-work");
  221: 
  222:             var exception =
  223:                 new InvalidOperationException(
  224:                     "Failure wins.");
  225: 
  226:             Assert.True(
  227:                 failed.TryFail(
  228:                     exception));
  229: 
  230:             Assert.True(
  231:                 cancelled.TryMarkPending());
  232: 
  233:             Assert.True(
  234:                 cancelled.TryCancel());
  235: 
  236:             var coordinator =
  237:                 new PulseCoordinator(
  238:                     pulse);
  239: 
  240:             Assert.True(
  241:                 coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  242:                     failed));
  243: 
  244:             Assert.True(
  245:                 coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  246:                     cancelled));
  247: 
  248:             Assert.True(
  249:                 coordinator.CanFinalize);
  250: 
  251:             Assert.True(
  252:                 coordinator.TryFinalize(
  253:                     null,
  254:                     out var moment));
  255: 
  256:             Assert.NotNull(
  257:                 moment);
  258: 
  259:             Assert.Equal(
  260:                 MomentOutcome.Failed,
  261:                 moment!.Outcome);
  262: 
  263:             Assert.Equal(
  264:                 PulseStatus.Failed,
  265:                 pulse.Status);
  266: 
  267:             Assert.Same(
  268:                 exception,
  269:                 moment.Exception);
  270:         }
  271: 
  272:         [Fact]
  273:         public void UnresolvedWorkCannotProduceAnyMoment()
  274:         {
  275:             var pulse =
  276:                 CreateProcessingPulse(
  277:                     "unresolved-request");
  278: 
  279:             var work =
  280:                 new WorkUnit(
  281:                     pulse.Id,
  282:                     "pending-work");
  283: 
  284:             Assert.True(
  285:                 work.TryMarkPending());
  286: 
  287:             var coordinator =
  288:                 new PulseCoordinator(
  289:                     pulse);
  290: 
  291:             Assert.True(
  292:                 coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  293:                     work));
  294: 
  295:             Assert.False(
  296:                 coordinator.CanResolve);
  297: 
  298:             Assert.False(
  299:                 coordinator.CanFinalize);
  300: 
  301:             Assert.False(
  302:                 coordinator.TryFinalize(
  303:                     null,
  304:                     out var moment));
  305: 
  306:             Assert.Null(
  307:                 moment);
  308: 
  309:             Assert.Equal(
  310:                 PulseStatus.Processing,
  311:                 pulse.Status);
  312:         }
  313: 
  314:         private static Pulse CreateProcessingPulse(
  315:             object? request)
  316:         {
  317:             var pulse =
  318:                 new Pulse(
  319:                     request);
  320: 
  321:             Assert.True(
  322:                 pulse.TryBeginDecomposition());
  323: 
  324:             Assert.True(
  325:                 pulse.TryMarkPending());
  326: 
  327:             Assert.True(
  328:                 pulse.TryMarkReady());
  329: 
  330:             Assert.True(
  331:                 pulse.TryBeginProcessing());
  332: 
  333:             return pulse;
  334:         }
  335: 
  336:         private static WorkUnit CreateProcessingWork(
  337:             Pulse pulse,
  338:             object? payload)
  339:         {
  340:             var work =
  341:                 new WorkUnit(
  342:                     pulse.Id,
  343:                     payload);
  344: 
  345:             Assert.True(
  346:                 work.TryMarkPending());
  347: 
  348:             Assert.True(
  349:                 work.TryBeginProcessing());
  350: 
  351:             return work;
  352:         }

  357:                 string name)

  359:                 Name = name;
  360:             }
  361:

  363:         }
  364:     }

  306:     public void RemovingOnePropertyPreservesOtherAttachedAndNativeProperties()
  307:     {
  308:         TestLog.Section(
  309:             "QSL PACKAGE LIFECYCLE - PROPERTY REMOVAL");
  310: 
  311:         TestLog.Test(
  312:             "Removing one attached property preserves unrelated attached and native properties.");
  313: 
  314:         var engine = CreateQslEngine();
  315: 
  316:         var player = new TestPlayer(
  317:             50.0);
  318: 
  319:         engine.BindConsumer(
  320:             new QslConsumerBinding(
  321:                 "player",
  322:                 "Player",
  323:                 player));
  324: 
  325:         var received = engine.ReceiveState(
  326:             new QslStatePackage(
  327:                 player,
  328:                 new Dictionary<string, object?>
  329:                 {
  330:                     {
  331:                         "Curiosity",
  332:                         11.0
  333:                     },
  334:                     {
  335:                         "Fatigue",
  336:                         4.0
  337:                     }
  338:                 }));
  339: 
  340:         Assert.Equal(
  341:             2,
  342:             received);
  343:

  347: 
  348:         var removedTwice = engine.RemoveState(
  349:             player,
  350:             "Curiosity");
  351: 
  352:         Assert.True(
  353:             removedOnce);
  354: 
  355:         Assert.False(
  356:             removedTwice);
  357: 
  358:         var removed = engine.Evaluate(
  359:             "player.Curiosity");
  360: 
  361:         var preservedAttached = engine.Evaluate(
  362:             "player.Fatigue");
  363: 
  364:         var preservedNative = engine.Evaluate(
  365:             "player.Health");
  366: 
  367:         Assert.False(
  368:             removed.Succeeded);
  369: 
  370:         AssertSucceededWithValue(
  371:             preservedAttached,
  372:             4.0);
  373: 
  374:         AssertSucceededWithValue(
  375:             preservedNative,
  376:             50.0);
  377: 
  378:         TestLog.State(
  379:             $"Initial package properties received = {received}");
  380: 
  381:         TestLog.State(
  382:             $"First removal succeeded = {removedOnce}");
  383: 
  384:         TestLog.State(
  385:             $"Repeated removal succeeded = {removedTwice}");
  386: 
  387:         TestLog.State(
  388:             $"Removed player.Curiosity resolved = {removed.Succeeded}");
  389: 
  390:         TestLog.State(
  391:             $"Preserved player.Fatigue = {preservedAttached.Value}");
  392: 
  393:         TestLog.State(
  394:             $"Preserved player.Health = {preservedNative.Value}");
  395: 
  396:         TestLog.Pass(
  397:             "The requested attached property was removed.");
  398: 
  399:         TestLog.Pass(
  400:             "Repeated removal correctly reported that no state remained.");
  401: 
  402:         TestLog.Pass(
  403:             "Unrelated attached and native properties remained available.");
  404:     }

  706:         engine.Evaluate(
  707:             "player.Fatigue"),
  708:         4.0);
  709: 
  710:     TestLog.Task(
  711:         "Applying a Wilds-resolved zero-value decay package with removal enabled.");
  712: 
  713:     var decayPackage = new QslDecayPackage(
  714:         player,
  715:         new Dictionary<string, object?>
  716:         {
  717:             {
  718:                 "Curiosity",
  719:                 0.0
  720:             }
  721:         },
  722:         removeAtZero: true);
  723: 
  724:     var affected = engine.ReceiveDecay(
  725:         decayPackage);
  726: 
  727:     Assert.Equal(
  728:         1,
  729:         affected);
  730: 
  731:     var removed = engine.Evaluate(
  732:         "player.Curiosity");
  733: 
  734:     var preservedAttached = engine.Evaluate(
  735:         "player.Fatigue");
  736: 
  737:     var preservedNative = engine.Evaluate(
  738:         "player.Health");
  739: 
  740:     Assert.False(
  741:         removed.Succeeded);
  742: 
  743:     AssertSucceededWithValue(
  744:         preservedAttached,
  745:         4.0);
  746: 
  747:     AssertSucceededWithValue(
  748:         preservedNative,
  749:         50.0);
  750: 
  751:     TestLog.State(
  752:         $"Decay properties affected = {affected}");
  753: 
  754:     TestLog.State(
  755:         $"player.Curiosity resolved after decay = {removed.Succeeded}");
  756: 
  757:     TestLog.State(
  758:         $"Preserved player.Fatigue = {preservedAttached.Value}");
  759: 
  760:     TestLog.State(
  761:         $"Preserved player.Health = {preservedNative.Value}");
  762: 
  763:     TestLog.Pass(
  764:         "The resolved zero-value decay package retired the watched attached property.");
  765: 
  766:     TestLog.Pass(
  767:         "The decay package preserved unrelated attached state.");
  768: 
  769:     TestLog.Pass(
  770:         "The decay package preserved native consumer-owned state.");
  771: }
  772: 
  773:     private static QslEngine CreateQslEngine()
  774:     {
  775:         var registry = new QslRuntimeRegistry();
  776: 
  777:         registry.RegisterDefaultEvaluators();
  778: 
  779:         var context = new QslRuntimeContext(
  780:             registry);
  781: 
  782:         return new QslEngine(
  783:             context);
  784:     }

  787:         QslProcessingResult result,
  788:         double expected)
  789:     {
  790:         Assert.NotNull(
  791:             result);
  792: 
  793:         Assert.True(
  794:             result.Succeeded);
  795: 
  796:         Assert.False(
  797:             result.ParseFailed);
  798: 
  799:         Assert.False(
  800:             result.EvaluationFailed);
  801: 
  802:         Assert.False(
  803:             result.HasException);
  804: 
  805:         Assert.Empty(
  806:             result.ParserDiagnostics);
  807: 
  808:         Assert.Empty(
  809:             result.RuntimeDiagnostics);
  810: 
  811:         Assert.Null(
  812:             result.Exception);
  813: 
  814:         Assert.NotNull(
  815:             result.Value);
  816: 
  817:         Assert.Equal(
  818:             expected,
  819:             Convert.ToDouble(
  820:                 result.Value),
  821:             10);
  822:     }

  551:         private static void VerifyRemainingInstructionsAreUnaffected()
  552:         {
  553:             TestLog.Write(
  554:                 "[TEST] Verify remaining items unaffected");
  555: 
  556:             var component =
  557:                 CreateComponent(
  558:                     "certification.registry.remaining");
  559: 
  560:             var registry =
  561:                 CreateInstructionRegistry(
  562:                     component);
  563: 
  564:             var first =
  565:                 CreateInstruction(
  566:                     "certification.instruction.remaining.first");
  567: 
  568:             var removed =
  569:                 CreateInstruction(
  570:                     "certification.instruction.remaining.removed");
  571: 
  572:             var third =
  573:                 CreateInstruction(
  574:                     "certification.instruction.remaining.third");
  575: 
  576:             registry.Register(
  577:                 first);
  578: 
  579:             registry.Register(
  580:                 removed);
  581: 
  582:             registry.Register(
  583:                 third);
  584: 
  585:             registry.Remove(
  586:                 removed.Id);
  587: 
  588:             Assert(
  589:                 registry.Count == 2,
  590:                 "Removing one instruction should leave two parked.");
  591: 
  592:             Assert(
  593:                 registry.Contains(
  594:                     first.Id),
  595:                 "The first instruction should remain.");
  596: 
  597:             Assert(
  598:                 registry.Contains(
  599:                     third.Id),
  600:                 "The third instruction should remain.");
  601: 
  602:             Assert(
  603:                 !registry.Contains(
  604:                     removed.Id),
  605:                 "Only the selected instruction should be removed.");
  606: 
  607:             Assert(
  608:                 ReferenceEquals(
  609:                     first,
  610:                     registry.Get(first.Id)),
  611:                 "The first parked reference should remain unchanged.");
  612: 
  613:             Assert(
  614:                 ReferenceEquals(

  721:         private static void TaskRegistrySupportsCoreBehavior()
  722:         {
  723:             TestLog.Write(
  724:                 "[TEST] Repeat core behavior for task registry");
  725: 
  726:             var component =
  727:                 CreateComponent(
  728:                     "certification.task");
  729: 
  730:             var registry =
  731:                 CreateTaskRegistry(
  732:                     component);
  733: 
  734:             Assert(
  735:                 registry.Count == 0,
  736:                 "A new task registry should start empty.");
  737: 
  738:             var first =
  739:                 new TestTask(
  740:                     component,
  741:                     "certification.task.first");
  742: 
  743:             var second =
  744:                 new TestTask(
  745:                     component,
  746:                     "certification.task.second");
  747: 
  748:             TestLog.Write(
  749:                 $"    [PARK] {DescribeTask(first)}");
  750: 
  751:             TestLog.Write(
  752:                 $"    [PARK] {DescribeTask(second)}");
  753: 
  754:             Assert(
  755:                 registry.Register(
  756:                     first),
  757:                 "The first task should be parked.");
  758: 
  759:             Assert(
  760:                 registry.Register(
  761:                     second),
  762:                 "The second task should be parked.");
  763: 
  764:             Assert(
  765:                 registry.Count == 2,
  766:                 "The task registry should contain both tasks.");
  767: 
  768:             Assert(
  769:                 ReferenceEquals(
  770:                     first,
  771:                     registry.Get(first.Id)),
  772:                 "The task registry should preserve reference identity.");
  773: 
  774:             Assert(
  775:                 !registry.Register(
  776:                     first),
  777:                 "Duplicate task registration should be rejected.");
  778: 
  779:             foreach (var task in registry.Items)
  780:             {
  781:                 TestLog.Write(
  782:                     $"    [ITEM] {DescribeTask(task)}");
  783:             }
  784: 
  785:             TestLog.Write(
  786:                 $"    [REMOVE] Task {first.Id}");
  787: 
  788:             Assert(
  789:                 registry.Remove(
  790:                     first.Id),
  791:                 "Removing the first task should succeed.");
  792: 
  793:             Assert(
  794:                 !registry.Contains(
  795:                     first.Id),
  796:                 "The removed task should no longer be parked.");
  797: 
  798:             Assert(
  799:                 registry.Contains(
  800:                     second.Id),
  801:                 "The remaining task should be unaffected.");
  802: 
  803:             registry.Clear();
  804: 
  805:             Assert(
  806:                 registry.Count == 0,
  807:                 "Clearing should empty the task registry.");
  808: 
  809:             Assert(
  810:                 registry.Items.Count == 0,
  811:                 "The task registry should enumerate no items after Clear.");
  812: 
  813:             TestLog.Pass(
  814:                 "Repeat core behavior for task registry");
  815:         }
  816: 
  817:         private static async Task
  818:             ConcurrentRegistrationAndRemovalStressAsync()
  819:         {
  820:             TestLog.Write(
  821:                 "[TEST] Concurrent registration/removal stress");
  822: 
  823:             var component =
  824:                 CreateComponent(
  825:                     "certification.registry.concurrent");
  826: 
  827:             var registry =
  828:                 CreateInstructionRegistry(
  829:                     component);
  830: 
  831:             var instructions =
  832:                 CreateInstructionSet(
  833:                     ConcurrentItemCount,
  834:                     "certification.instruction.concurrent");
  835: 
  836:             TestLog.Write(
  837:                 $"    [TASK] Concurrently parking " +
  838:                 $"{instructions.Count} instructions");
  839: 
  840:             var registrationTasks =
  841:                 new List<Task>(
  842:                     instructions.Count);
  843: 
  844:             foreach (var instruction in instructions)
  845:             {
  846:                 registrationTasks.Add(
  847:                     Task.Run(
  848:                         () =>
  849:                         {
  850:                             var registered =
  851:                                 registry.Register(
  852:                                     instruction);
  853: 
  854:                             Assert(
  855:                                 registered,
  856:                                 $"Concurrent registration failed " +
  857:                                 $"for {instruction.Id}.");
  858:                         }));
  859:             }
  860: 
  861:             await Task.WhenAll(
  862:                     registrationTasks)
  863:                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
  864: 
  865:             TestLog.Write(
  866:                 $"    [STATE] Count after registration = " +
  867:                 $"{registry.Count}");
  868: 
  869:             Assert(
  870:                 registry.Count == instructions.Count,
  871:                 "Concurrent registration should retain " +
  872:                 "every unique instruction.");
  873: 
  874:             foreach (var instruction in instructions)
  875:             {
  876:                 Assert(
  877:                     registry.Contains(
  878:                         instruction.Id),
  879:                     $"Instruction {instruction.Id} should be parked.");
  880:             }
  881: 
  882:             var removedInstructions =
  883:                 instructions
  884:                     .Where(
  885:                         (_, index) =>
  886:                             index % 2 == 0)
  887:                     .ToArray();
  888: 
  889:             var retainedInstructions =
  890:                 instructions
  891:                     .Where(
  892:                         (_, index) =>
  893:                             index % 2 != 0)
  894:                     .ToArray();
  895: 
  896:             TestLog.Write(
  897:                 $"    [TASK] Concurrently removing " +
  898:                 $"{removedInstructions.Length} instructions");
  899: 
  900:             var removalTasks =
  901:                 new List<Task>(
  902:                     removedInstructions.Length);
  903: 
  904:             foreach (var instruction in removedInstructions)
  905:             {
  906:                 removalTasks.Add(
  907:                     Task.Run(
  908:                         () =>
  909:                         {
  910:                             var removed =
  911:                                 registry.Remove(
  912:                                     instruction.Id);
  913: 
  914:                             Assert(
  915:                                 removed,
  916:                                 $"Concurrent removal failed " +
  917:                                 $"for {instruction.Id}.");
  918:                         }));
  919:             }
  920: 
  921:             await Task.WhenAll(
  922:                     removalTasks)
  923:                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
  924: 
  925:             TestLog.Write(
  926:                 $"    [STATE] Count after removal = " +
  927:                 $"{registry.Count}");
  928: 
  929:             Assert(
  930:                 registry.Count == retainedInstructions.Length,
  931:                 "Concurrent removal should leave the " +
  932:                 "expected instruction count.");
  933: 
  934:             foreach (var instruction in removedInstructions)
  935:             {
  936:                 Assert(
  937:                     !registry.Contains(
  938:                         instruction.Id),
  939:                     $"Removed instruction {instruction.Id} " +
  940:                     "should be absent.");
  941:             }
  942: 
  943:             foreach (var instruction in retainedInstructions)
  944:             {
  945:                 Assert(
  946:                     registry.Contains(
  947:                         instruction.Id),
  948:                     $"Retained instruction {instruction.Id} " +
  949:                     "should remain parked.");
  950: 
  951:                 Assert(
  952:                     ReferenceEquals(
  953:                         instruction,
  954:                         registry.Get(
  955:                             instruction.Id)),
  956:                     $"Retained instruction {instruction.Id} " +
  957:                     "should preserve its reference.");
  958:             }
  959: 
  960:             registry.Clear();
  961: 
  962:             Assert(
  963:                 registry.Count == 0,
  964:                 "The stressed registry should remain clearable.");
  965: 
  966:             TestLog.Pass(
  967:                 "Concurrent registration/removal stress");
  968:         }

  184:         private static void HighVolumeTaskLifecycle(
  185:             int taskCount)
  186:         {
  187:             var testName =
  188:                 $"Task registry lifecycle at {taskCount:N0}";
  189: 
  190:             TestLog.Write(
  191:                 $"[TEST] {testName}");
  192: 
  193:             var component =
  194:                 CreateComponent(
  195:                     $"test.task-registry.{taskCount}");
  196: 
  197:             var registry =
  198:                 new DefaultTasksRegistry(
  199:                     component,
  200:                     $"test.task-registry.{taskCount}");
  201: 
  202:             Assert(
  203:                 registry.Initialize(),
  204:                 "Registry initialization should succeed.");
  205: 
  206:             var taskIds =
  207:                 new Guid[taskCount];
  208: 
  209:             var registrationWatch =
  210:                 Stopwatch.StartNew();
  211: 
  212:             TestLog.Write(
  213:                 $"    [TASK] Parking {taskCount:N0} tasks");
  214: 
  215:             for (var i = 0; i < taskCount; i++)
  216:             {
  217:                 var task =
  218:                     new TestTask(
  219:                         component,
  220:                         "test.task.parked");
  221: 
  222:                 taskIds[i] =
  223:                     task.Id;
  224: 
  225:                 if (!registry.Register(task))
  226:                 {
  227:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  228:                         $"Task registration failed at index {i:N0}.");
  229:                 }
  230:             }
  231: 
  232:             registrationWatch.Stop();
  233: 
  234:             TestLog.Write(
  235:                 $"    [STATE] Parked count = {registry.Count:N0}");
  236: 
  237:             TestLog.Write(
  238:                 $"    [TIME] Registration = " +
  239:                 $"{registrationWatch.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds:F3} ms");
  240: 
  241:             Assert(
  242:                 registry.Count == taskCount,
  243:                 $"Registry should contain {taskCount:N0} tasks.");
  244: 
  245:             Assert(
  246:                 registry.Items.Count == taskCount,
  247:                 "Items should expose every parked task.");
  248: 
  249:             VerifyRepresentativeTasks(
  250:                 registry,
  251:                 taskIds);
  252: 
  253:             var duplicateId =
  254:                 taskIds[taskCount / 2];
  255: 
  256:             var duplicateTask =
  257:                 registry.Get(
  258:                     duplicateId);
  259: 
  260:             Assert(
  261:                 duplicateTask != null,
  262:                 "Representative task should be available.");
  263: 
  264:             if (duplicateTask == null)
  265:             {
  266:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  267:                     "TaskRegistry test failed: " +
  268:                     "Representative task retrieval returned null.");
  269:             }
  270: 
  271:             Assert(
  272:                 !registry.Register(duplicateTask),
  273:                 "Duplicate task registration should be rejected.");
  274: 
  275:             Assert(
  276:                 registry.Count == taskCount,
  277:                 "Duplicate registration must not alter count.");
  278: 
  279:             var retrievalWatch =
  280:                 Stopwatch.StartNew();
  281: 
  282:             TestLog.Write(
  283:                 $"    [TASK] Reading {taskCount:N0} parked tasks");
  284: 
  285:             for (var i = 0; i < taskIds.Length; i++)
  286:             {
  287:                 if (!registry.TryGet(
  288:                         taskIds[i],
  289:                         out var task))
  290:                 {
  291:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  292:                         $"Task retrieval failed at index {i:N0}.");
  293:                 }
  294: 
  295:                 if (task == null)
  296:                 {
  297:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  298:                         $"Task retrieval returned null at index {i:N0}.");
  299:                 }
  300: 
  301:                 if (task.Id != taskIds[i])
  302:                 {
  303:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  304:                         $"Task identity mismatch at index {i:N0}.");
  305:                 }
  306:             }
  307: 
  308:             retrievalWatch.Stop();
  309: 
  310:             TestLog.Write(
  311:                 $"    [TIME] Retrieval = " +
  312:                 $"{retrievalWatch.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds:F3} ms");
  313: 
  314:             var removalWatch =
  315:                 Stopwatch.StartNew();
  316: 
  317:             TestLog.Write(
  318:                 $"    [TASK] Removing {taskCount:N0} parked tasks");
  319: 
  320:             for (var i = 0; i < taskIds.Length; i++)
  321:             {
  322:                 if (!registry.Remove(
  323:                         taskIds[i]))
  324:                 {
  325:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  326:                         $"Task removal failed at index {i:N0}.");
  327:                 }
  328:             }
  329: 
  330:             removalWatch.Stop();
  331: 
  332:             TestLog.Write(
  333:                 $"    [STATE] Remaining count = {registry.Count:N0}");
  334: 
  335:             TestLog.Write(
  336:                 $"    [TIME] Removal = " +
  337:                 $"{removalWatch.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds:F3} ms");
  338: 
  339:             Assert(
  340:                 registry.Count == 0,
  341:                 "Registry should be empty after every task is removed.");
  342: 
  343:             Assert(
  344:                 registry.Items.Count == 0,
  345:                 "Items should be empty after removal.");
  346: 
  347:             VerifyTasksAreAbsent(
  348:                 registry,
  349:                 taskIds);
  350: 
  351:             Assert(
  352:                 registry.Shutdown(),
  353:                 "Registry shutdown should succeed.");
  354: 
  355:             TestLog.Write(
  356:                 $"[PASS] {testName}");
  357:         }
  358: 
  359:         private static void VerifyRepresentativeTasks(
  360:             ITaskRegistry registry,
  361:             Guid[] taskIds)
  362:         {
  363:             var indexes =
  364:                 new[]
  365:                 {
  366:                     0,
  367:                     taskIds.Length / 2,
  368:                     taskIds.Length - 1
  369:                 };
  370: 
  371:             for (var i = 0; i < indexes.Length; i++)
  372:             {
  373:                 var index =
  374:                     indexes[i];
  375: 
  376:                 var id =
  377:                     taskIds[index];
  378: 
  379:                 TestLog.Write(
  380:                     $"    [READ] Representative task " +
  381:                     $"{index:N0}: {id}");
  382: 
  383:                 Assert(
  384:                     registry.Contains(id),
  385:                     $"Registry should contain task at index {index:N0}.");
  386: 
  387:                 var task =
  388:                     registry.Get(id);
  389: 
  390:                 Assert(
  391:                     task != null,
  392:                     $"Task at index {index:N0} should be retrievable.");
  393: 
  394:                 if (task == null)
  395:                 {
  396:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  397:                         "TaskRegistry test failed: " +
  398:                         $"Task at index {index:N0} returned null.");
  399:                 }
  400: 
  401:                 Assert(
  402:                     task.Id == id,
  403:                     $"Task at index {index:N0} should preserve identity.");
  404:             }
  405:         }
  406: 
  407:         private static void VerifyTasksAreAbsent(
  408:             ITaskRegistry registry,
  409:             Guid[] taskIds)
  410:         {
  411:             var indexes =
  412:                 new[]
  413:                 {
  414:                     0,
  415:                     taskIds.Length / 2,
  416:                     taskIds.Length - 1
  417:                 };
  418: 
  419:             for (var i = 0; i < indexes.Length; i++)
  420:             {
  421:                 var index =
  422:                     indexes[i];
  423: 
  424:                 var id =
  425:                     taskIds[index];
  426: 
  427:                 TestLog.Write(
  428:                     $"    [VERIFY] Removed task " +
  429:                     $"{index:N0}: {id}");
  430: 
  431:                 Assert(
  432:                     !registry.Contains(id),
  433:                     $"Removed task at index {index:N0} " +
  434:                     "should not be contained.");

  438:                     $"Removed task at index {index:N0} " +
  439:                     "should not be retrievable.");

  442:                     !registry.TryGet(
  443:                         id,
  444:                         out var task),
  445:                     $"TryGet should reject removed task " +
  446:                     $"at index {index:N0}.");
  447: 
  448:                 Assert(
  449:                     task == null,
  450:                     "Failed TryGet should return null.");
  451:             }
  452:         }
