    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using System.Threading;
    4: using System.Threading.Tasks;
    5: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    6: using WildsEngine.Core.Units;
    7: using WildsEngine.Tests.Logging;
    8: using WildsEngine.Tests.Registry;
    9: using Xunit;
   10: 
   11: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Tests;
   12: 
   13: public sealed class TemporalConcurrencyOrderingCertificationTests
   14: {
   15:     [Fact]
   16:     public async Task ConcurrentTimelineCommitsPreserveSuccessfulSerializedOrder()
   17:     {
   18:         TestLog.Section(
   19:             "TEMPORAL CONCURRENCY - TIMELINE COMMIT ORDER");
   20: 
   21:         TestLog.Test(
   22:             "Concurrent Moment commits produce one coherent serialized Timeline order.");
   23: 
   24:         const int count =
   25:             64;
   26: 
   27:         var timeline =
   28:             new Timeline();
   29: 
   30:         var moments =
   31:             new Moment[count];
   32: 
   33:         for (var index = 0;
   34:              index < count;
   35:              index++)
   36:         {
   37:             moments[index] =
   38:                 new Moment(
   39:                     Guid.NewGuid(),
   40:                     index,
   41:                     new[]
   42:                     {
   43:                         Guid.NewGuid()
   44:                     });
   45:         }
   46: 
   47:         var readyCount =
   48:             0;
   49: 
   50:         var allReady =
   51:             new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(
   52:                 TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
   53: 
   54:         var release =
   55:             new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(
   56:                 TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
   57: 
   58:         var tasks =
   59:             new Task<bool>[count];
   60: 
   61:         for (var index = 0;
   62:              index < count;
   63:              index++)
   64:         {
   65:             var captured =
   66:                 moments[index];
   67: 
   68:             tasks[index] =
   69:                 Task.Run(
   70:                     async () =>
   71:                     {
   72:                         if (Interlocked.Increment(
   73:                                 ref readyCount) == count)
   74:                         {
   75:                             allReady.TrySetResult(
   76:                                 true);
   77:                         }
   78: 
   79:                         await release.Task
   80:                             .ConfigureAwait(false);
   81: 
   82:                         return timeline.AddMoment(
   83:                             captured);
   84:                     });
   85:         }
   86: 
   87:         TestLog.Task(
   88:             "Waiting until every concurrent writer is ready.");
   89: 
   90:         await allReady.Task
   91:             .WaitAsync(
   92:                 TimeSpan.FromSeconds(
   93:                     10));
   94: 
   95:         TestLog.Task(
   96:             "Releasing all Timeline writers concurrently.");
   97: 
   98:         release.TrySetResult(
   99:             true);
  100: 
  101:         var committed =
  102:             await Task.WhenAll(
  103:                 tasks);
  104: 
  105:         for (var index = 0;
  106:              index < committed.Length;
  107:              index++)
  108:         {
  109:             Assert.True(
  110:                 committed[index]);
  111:         }
  112: 
  113:         var history =
  114:             timeline.Moments;
  115: 
  116:         Assert.Equal(
  117:             count,
  118:             timeline.Count);
  119: 
  120:         Assert.Equal(
  121:             count,
  122:             history.Count);
  123: 
  124:         var expectedIds =
  125:             new HashSet<Guid>();
  126: 
  127:         for (var index = 0;
  128:              index < moments.Length;
  129:              index++)
  130:         {
  131:             Assert.True(
  132:                 expectedIds.Add(
  133:                     moments[index].Id));
  134:         }
  135: 
  136:         var committedIds =
  137:             new HashSet<Guid>();
  138: 
  139:         for (var index = 0;
  140:              index < history.Count;
  141:              index++)
  142:         {
  143:             Assert.True(
  144:                 committedIds.Add(
  145:                     history[index].Id));
  146: 
  147:             Assert.Contains(
  148:                 history[index].Id,
  149:                 expectedIds);
  150:         }
  151: 
  152:         Assert.Equal(
  153:             count,
  154:             committedIds.Count);
  155: 
  156:         /*
  157:          * We intentionally do not assert that Timeline order
  158:          * equals creation, submission, task-start, or task-
  159:          * completion order.
  160:          *
  161:          * The Timeline contract is successful serialized commit
  162:          * order. The observable Moments snapshot is the
  163:          * authoritative historical sequence.
  164:          */
  165: 
  166:         TestLog.State(
  167:             $"Concurrent commits = {count}");
  168: 
  169:         TestLog.State(
  170:             $"Timeline Moments = {history.Count}");
  171: 
  172:         TestLog.State(
  173:             $"Unique Moment identities = {committedIds.Count}");
  174: 
  175:         TestLog.Pass(
  176:             "Every concurrent Moment was committed exactly once.");
  177: 
  178:         TestLog.Pass(
  179:             "Timeline exposed one coherent serialized history.");
  180: 
  181:         TestLog.Pass(
  182:             "No unsupported submission or completion ordering was assumed.");
  183:     }

  185:     [Fact]
  186:     public async Task ConcurrentExecuteAsyncHistoryUsesTimelineCommitOrder()
  187:     {
  188:         TestLog.Section(
  189:             "TEMPORAL CONCURRENCY - ENGINE TIMELINE ORDER");
  190: 
  191:         TestLog.Test(
  192:             "Concurrent Wilds executions expose their terminal Moments in committed Timeline order.");
  193: 
  194:         const int count =
  195:             32;
  196: 
  197:         using var engine =
  198:             CreateEngine(
  199:                 "timeline-order-certification");
  200: 
  201:         Assert.True(
  202:             engine.Initialize());
  203: 
  204:         var requests =
  205:             new object[count];
  206: 
  207:         for (var index = 0;
  208:              index < count;
  209:              index++)
  210:         {
  211:             requests[index] =
  212:                 new object();
  213:         }
  214: 
  215:         var readyCount =
  216:             0;
  217: 
  218:         var allReady =
  219:             new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(
  220:                 TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
  221: 
  222:         var release =
  223:             new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(
  224:                 TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
  225: 
  226:         var executions =
  227:             new Task<IMoment>[count];
  228: 
  229:         for (var index = 0;
  230:              index < count;
  231:              index++)
  232:         {
  233:             var request =
  234:                 requests[index];
  235: 
  236:             executions[index] =
  237:                 Task.Run(
  238:                     async () =>
  239:                     {
  240:                         return await engine.ExecuteAsync(
  241:                             request,
  242:                             async (
  243:                                 value,
  244:                                 cancellationToken) =>
  245:                             {
  246:                                 if (Interlocked.Increment(
  247:                                         ref readyCount) == count)
  248:                                 {
  249:                                     allReady.TrySetResult(
  250:                                         true);
  251:                                 }
  252: 
  253:                                 await release.Task
  254:                                     .WaitAsync(
  255:                                         cancellationToken)
  256:                                     .ConfigureAwait(false);
  257: 
  258:                                 return value;
  259:                             });
  260:                     });
  261:         }
  262: 
  263:         TestLog.Task(
  264:             "Waiting until every concurrent Wilds operation is active.");
  265: 
  266:         await allReady.Task
  267:             .WaitAsync(
  268:                 TimeSpan.FromSeconds(
  269:                     10));
  270: 
  271:         TestLog.Task(
  272:             "Releasing concurrent Wilds operations.");
  273: 
  274:         release.TrySetResult(
  275:             true);
  276: 
  277:         var returned =
  278:             await Task.WhenAll(
  279:                 executions);
  280: 
  281:         var history =
  282:             engine.Timeline.Moments;
  283: 
  284:         Assert.Equal(
  285:             count,
  286:             returned.Length);
  287: 
  288:         Assert.Equal(
  289:             count,
  290:             engine.Timeline.Count);
  291: 
  292:         Assert.Equal(
  293:             count,
  294:             history.Count);
  295: 
  296:         var returnedById =
  297:             new Dictionary<Guid, IMoment>();
  298: 
  299:         for (var index = 0;
  300:              index < returned.Length;
  301:              index++)
  302:         {
  303:             Assert.True(
  304:                 returnedById.TryAdd(
  305:                     returned[index].Id,
  306:                     returned[index]));
  307:         }
  308: 
  309:         var historyIds =
  310:             new HashSet<Guid>();
  311: 
  312:         for (var index = 0;
  313:              index < history.Count;
  314:              index++)
  315:         {
  316:             var committed =
  317:                 history[index];
  318: 
  319:             Assert.True(
  320:                 historyIds.Add(
  321:                     committed.Id));
  322: 
  323:             Assert.True(
  324:                 returnedById.TryGetValue(
  325:                     committed.Id,
  326:                     out var returnedMoment));
  327: 
  328:             Assert.Same(
  329:                 returnedMoment,
  330:                 committed);
  331:         }
  332: 
  333:         Assert.Equal(
  334:             count,
  335:             returnedById.Count);
  336: 
  337:         Assert.Equal(
  338:             count,
  339:             historyIds.Count);
  340: 
  341:         Assert.Single(
  342:             engine.Epoch.Timelines);
  343: 
  344:         Assert.Same(
  345:             engine.Timeline,
  346:             engine.Epoch.Timelines[0]);
  347: 
  348:         var epochHistory =
  349:             engine.Epoch.Timelines[0]
  350:                 .Moments;
  351: 
  352:         Assert.Equal(
  353:             history.Count,
  354:             epochHistory.Count);
  355: 
  356:         for (var index = 0;
  357:              index < history.Count;
  358:              index++)
  359:         {
  360:             Assert.Same(
  361:                 history[index],
  362:                 epochHistory[index]);
  363:         }
  364: 
  365:         /*
  366:          * Timeline.Moments is the authoritative observation of
  367:          * serialized commit order.
  368:          *
  369:          * This test intentionally does not equate that order with
  370:          * request submission, Pulse creation, operation completion,
  371:          * or pre-commit finalization.
  372:          */
  373: 
  374:         TestLog.State(
  375:             $"Concurrent executions = {count}");
  376: 
  377:         TestLog.State(
  378:             $"Returned Moments = {returned.Length}");
  379: 
  380:         TestLog.State(
  381:             $"Committed Timeline Moments = {history.Count}");
  382: 
  383:         TestLog.State(
  384:             $"Epoch Timeline Moments = {epochHistory.Count}");
  385: 
  386:         TestLog.Pass(
  387:             "Every returned Moment appeared exactly once in committed history.");
  388: 
  389:         TestLog.Pass(
  390:             "Timeline and Epoch exposed the same committed Moment sequence.");
  391: 
  392:         TestLog.Pass(
  393:             "Concurrent Wilds history remained coherent under the successful-commit ordering contract.");
  394: 
  395:         TestLog.Pass(
  396:             "The certification did not impose an unsupported concurrent execution order.");
  397:     }

FILE: WildsEngine.Core.Tests\TestLog.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Globalization;
    3: using System.IO;
    4: using System.Text;
    5: 
    6: namespace WildsEngine.Tests.Logging
    7: {
    8:     public static class TestLog
    9:     {
   10:         private static readonly object Sync = new object();
   11:         private static string? _path;
   12: 
   13:         public static string Path => _path ?? string.Empty;
   14: 
   15:         public static void Initialize(string? fileName = null)
   16:         {
   17:             lock (Sync)
   18:             {
   19:                 if (_path != null)
   20:                     return;
   21: 
   22:                 var logs = System.IO.Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "Logs");
   23:                 Directory.CreateDirectory(logs);
   24:                 var name = fileName ?? $"wildsengine-tests-{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd-HHmmss}.log";
   25:                 _path = System.IO.Path.Combine(logs, name);
   26:                 File.WriteAllText(_path, $"WildsEngine test log{Environment.NewLine}", Encoding.UTF8);
   27:             }
   28:         }
   29: 
   30:         public static void Section(string title)
   31:         {
   32:             Write("");
   33:             Write("============================================");
   34:             Write($" {title}");
   35:             Write("============================================");
   36:         }
   37: 
   38:         public static void Write(string message)
   39:         {
   40:             lock (Sync)
   41:             {
   42:                 if (_path == null)
   43:                     Initialize();
   44: 
   45:                 Console.WriteLine(message);
   46:                 File.AppendAllText(_path!,
   47:                     $"{DateTime.Now.ToString("O", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)} {message}{Environment.NewLine}",
   48:                     Encoding.UTF8);
   49:             }
   50:         }
   51: 
   52:         public static void Test(string message) => Write($"[TEST] {message}");
   53:         public static void Pass(string message) => Write($"[PASS] {message}");
   54:         public static void Task(string message) => Write($"    [TASK] {message}");
   55:         public static void State(string message) => Write($"    [STATE] {message}");
   56:         public static void Expected(string message) => Write($"    [EXPECTED] {message}");
   57:         public static void Fail(string message, Exception ex) =>
   58:             Write($"[FAIL] {message}: {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");
   59:     }
   60: }

FILE: WildsEngine.Core.Tests\TestState.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.States;
    4: 
    5: namespace WildsEngine.Tests.Registry;
    6: 
    7: internal sealed class TestState :
    8:     WildsState
    9: {
   10:     public TestState(
   11:         IComponent component,
   12:         IContext context,
   13:         string layer)
   14:         : base(
   15:             component,
   16:             context,
   17:             layer)
   18:     {
   19:     }
   20: 
   21:     public override bool Process(
   22:         IStateInstruction instruction)
   23:     {
   24:         if (instruction == null)
   25:         {
   26:             throw new ArgumentNullException(
   27:                 nameof(instruction));
   28:         }
   29: 
   30:         if (TryProcessNeighborInstruction(
   31:                 instruction))
   32:         {
   33:             return true;
   34:         }
   35: 
   36:         if (instruction is
   37:             ISetContextVariableInstruction
   38:             setContextVariable)
   39:         {
   40:             Context.SetVariable(
   41:                 setContextVariable.Key,
   42:                 setContextVariable.Value);
   43: 
   44:             return true;
   45:         }
   46: 
   47:         return false;
   48:     }
   49: }

    1: using System;
    2: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;

    7: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Tests
    8: {
    9:     /// <summary>
   10:     /// Certifies the Wilds unit and temporal foundation:
   11:     ///
   12:     /// BaseUnit
   13:     ///     -> Pulse
   14:     ///         -> WorkUnit(s)
   15:     ///             -> Moment
   16:     ///                 -> Timeline
   17:     ///                     -> Epoch
   18:     ///
   19:     /// A Pulse represents one complete request.
   20:     /// WorkUnits represent internal processing required
   21:     /// to resolve that Pulse.
   22:     /// A Moment records the completed outcome.
   23:     /// Timelines preserve ordered Moments.
   24:     /// Epochs preserve collections of Timelines.
   25:     /// </summary>
   26:     public sealed class UnitCertificationTests
   27:     {
   28:         [Fact]
   29:         public void PulseReceivesStableNonEmptyIdentity()
   30:         {
   31:             var request =
   32:                 new TestRuntimeObject(
   33:                     "request");
   34: 
   35:             var pulse =
   36:                 new Pulse(
   37:                     request);
   38: 
   39:             Assert.NotEqual(
   40:                 Guid.Empty,
   41:                 pulse.Id);
   42: 
   43:             Assert.Same(
   44:                 request,
   45:                 pulse.Request);
   46: 
   47:             Assert.Equal(
   48:                 PulseStatus.Created,
   49:                 pulse.Status);
   50: 
   51:             Assert.False(
   52:                 pulse.IsTerminal);
   53:         }
   54: 
   55:         [Fact]
   56:         public void PulseEnforcesLifecycleOrder()
   57:         {
   58:             var pulse =
   59:                 new Pulse(
   60:                     new TestRuntimeObject(
   61:                         "request"));
   62: 
   63:             Assert.False(
   64:                 pulse.TryMarkPending());
   65: 
   66:             Assert.False(
   67:                 pulse.TryMarkReady());
   68: 
   69:             Assert.False(
   70:                 pulse.TryBeginProcessing());
   71: 
   72:             Assert.False(
   73:                 pulse.TryComplete());
   74: 
   75:             Assert.True(
   76:                 pulse.TryBeginDecomposition());
   77: 
   78:             Assert.Equal(
   79:                 PulseStatus.Decomposing,
   80:                 pulse.Status);
   81: 
   82:             Assert.True(
   83:                 pulse.TryMarkPending());
   84: 
   85:             Assert.Equal(
   86:                 PulseStatus.Pending,
   87:                 pulse.Status);
   88: 
   89:             Assert.True(
   90:                 pulse.TryMarkReady());
   91: 
   92:             Assert.Equal(
   93:                 PulseStatus.Ready,
   94:                 pulse.Status);
   95: 
   96:             Assert.True(
   97:                 pulse.TryBeginProcessing());
   98: 
   99:             Assert.Equal(
  100:                 PulseStatus.Processing,
  101:                 pulse.Status);
  102: 
  103:             Assert.True(
  104:                 pulse.TryComplete());
  105: 
  106:             Assert.Equal(
  107:                 PulseStatus.Completed,
  108:                 pulse.Status);
  109: 
  110:             Assert.True(
  111:                 pulse.IsTerminal);
  112: 
  113:             Assert.False(
  114:                 pulse.TryComplete());
  115: 
  116:             Assert.False(
  117:                 pulse.TryFail());
  118: 
  119:             Assert.False(
  120:                 pulse.TryCancel());
  121:         }

  488:         [Fact]
  489:         
  490:         public void ArbitraryRuntimeObjectSurvivesCompleteUnitRoute()
  491:         {
  492:             TestLog.Section(
  493:                 "Wilds Temporal Unit Certification");
  494: 
  495:             var runtimeObject =
  496:                 new TestRuntimeObject(
  497:                     "consumer-runtime-object");
  498: 
  499:             var pulse =
  500:                 new Pulse(
  501:                     runtimeObject);
  502: 
  503:             TestLog.Test(
  504:                 "Complete Pulse -> WorkUnit -> Moment -> Timeline -> Epoch route");
  505: 
  506:             TestLog.State(
  507:                 $"Pulse created | Id={pulse.Id} | Status={pulse.Status}");
  508: 
  509:             Assert.Same(
  510:                 runtimeObject,
  511:                 pulse.Request);
  512: 
  513:             Assert.True(
  514:                 pulse.TryBeginDecomposition());
  515: 
  516:             TestLog.State(
  517:                 $"Pulse decomposing | Status={pulse.Status}");
  518: 
  519:             var work =
  520:                 new WorkUnit(
  521:                     pulse.Id,
  522:                     pulse.Request);
  523: 
  524:             TestLog.Task(
  525:                 $"WorkUnit created | Id={work.Id} | PulseId={work.PulseId}");
  526: 
  527:             Assert.Same(
  528:                 runtimeObject,
  529:                 work.Payload);
  530: 
  531:             TestLog.State(
  532:                 "Request reference preserved in WorkUnit payload");
  533: 
  534:             Assert.True(
  535:                 work.TryMarkPending());
  536: 
  537:             Assert.True(
  538:                 pulse.TryMarkPending());
  539: 
  540:             TestLog.State(
  541:                 $"Pulse pending | Status={pulse.Status}");
  542: 
  543:             Assert.True(
  544:                 pulse.TryMarkReady());
  545: 
  546:             TestLog.State(
  547:                 $"Pulse ready | Status={pulse.Status}");
  548: 
  549:             Assert.True(
  550:                 pulse.TryBeginProcessing());
  551: 
  552:             Assert.True(
  553:                 work.TryBeginProcessing());
  554: 
  555:             TestLog.Task(
  556:                 $"WorkUnit processing | Status={work.Status}");
  557: 
  558:             Assert.True(
  559:                 work.TryComplete(
  560:                     runtimeObject));
  561: 
  562:             Assert.Same(
  563:                 runtimeObject,
  564:                 work.Result);
  565: 
  566:             TestLog.Task(
  567:                 $"WorkUnit completed | Status={work.Status}");
  568: 
  569:             TestLog.State(
  570:                 "Runtime object reference preserved through WorkUnit result");
  571: 
  572:             Assert.True(
  573:                 pulse.TryComplete());
  574: 
  575:             TestLog.State(
  576:                 $"Pulse completed | Status={pulse.Status}");
  577: 
  578:             var moment =
  579:                 new Moment(
  580:                     pulse.Id,
  581:                     work.Result,
  582:                     new[]
  583:                     {
  584:                         work.Id
  585:                     });
  586: 
  587:             Assert.Equal(
  588:                 pulse.Id,
  589:                 moment.PulseId);
  590: 
  591:             Assert.Same(
  592:                 runtimeObject,
  593:                 moment.Result);
  594: 
  595:             Assert.Single(
  596:                 moment.WorkUnitIds);
  597: 
  598:             Assert.Equal(
  599:                 work.Id,
  600:                 moment.WorkUnitIds[0]);
  601: 
  602:             TestLog.State(
  603:                 $"Moment recorded | Id={moment.Id} | PulseId={moment.PulseId}");
  604: 
  605:             var timeline =
  606:                 new Timeline();
  607: 
  608:             Assert.True(
  609:                 timeline.AddMoment(
  610:                     moment));
  611: 
  612:             TestLog.State(
  613:                 $"Timeline recorded Moment | Moments={timeline.Count}");
  614: 
  615:             var epoch =
  616:                 new Epoch();
  617: 
  618:             Assert.True(
  619:                 epoch.AddTimeline(
  620:                     timeline));
  621: 
  622:             TestLog.State(
  623:                 $"Epoch recorded Timeline | Timelines={epoch.Count}");
  624: 
  625:             Assert.Same(
  626:                 runtimeObject,
  627:                 epoch.Timelines[0]
  628:                     .Moments[0]
  629:                     .Result);
  630: 
  631:             TestLog.Pass(
  632:                 "Exact runtime object survived " +
  633:                 "Pulse -> WorkUnit -> Moment -> Timeline -> Epoch");
  634:         }

  646:     }

############################################################
FILE: WildsEngine.Core.Tests\WIldsEngineActiveCancellationTests.cs
############################################################
    1: using System.Threading;
    2: using System.Threading.Tasks;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    4: using WildsEngine.Tests.Logging;
    5: using WildsEngine.Tests.Registry;
    6: using Xunit;
    7: 
    8: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Tests;
    9: 
   10: public sealed class WildsEngineActiveCancellationTests
   11: {
   12:     [Fact]
   13:     public async Task
   14:         ActiveExecuteAsyncCancellationProducesCancelledMoment()
   15:     {
   16:         TestLog.Section(
   17:             "WILDSENGINE ACTIVE EXECUTION CANCELLATION");
   18: 
   19:         TestLog.Test(
   20:             "Cancellation during active ExecuteAsync work produces a cancelled Moment.");
   21: 
   22:         var component =
   23:             CreateComponent(
   24:                 "execute.active-cancellation");
   25: 
   26:         using var engine =
   27:             CreateEngine(
   28:                 component);
   29: 
   30:         Assert.True(
   31:             engine.Initialize());
   32: 
   33:         using var cancellation =
   34:             new CancellationTokenSource();
   35: 
   36:         var enteredOperation =
   37:             new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(
   38:                 TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
   39: 
   40:         var observedCancellation =
   41:             new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(
   42:                 TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
   43: 
   44:         var request =
   45:             new TestRuntimeObject(
   46:                 "active-cancellation-request");
   47: 
   48:         var forbiddenResult =
   49:             new TestRuntimeObject(
   50:                 "must-not-be-recorded");
   51: 
   52:         TestLog.Task(
   53:             "Starting ExecuteAsync with cancellable active work.");
   54: 
   55:         var execution =
   56:             engine.ExecuteAsync(
   57:                     request,
   58:                     async (
   59:                         observedRequest,
   60:                         cancellationToken) =>
   61:                     {
   62:                         Assert.Same(
   63:                             request,
   64:                             observedRequest);
   65: 
   66:                         Assert.False(
   67:                             cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested);
   68: 
   69:                         enteredOperation.TrySetResult(
   70:                             true);
   71: 
   72:                         TestLog.State(
   73:                             "ExecuteAsync operation entered active work.");
   74: 
   75:                         try
   76:                         {
   77:                             await Task.Delay(
   78:                                     Timeout.Infinite,
   79:                                     cancellationToken)
   80:                                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
   81:                         }
   82:                         catch (OperationCanceledException)
   83:                         {
   84:                             observedCancellation.TrySetResult(
   85:                                 true);
   86: 
   87:                             TestLog.State(
   88:                                 "Active operation observed cancellation.");
   89: 
   90:                             throw;
   91:                         }
   92: 
   93:                         return forbiddenResult;
   94:                     },
   95:                     cancellation.Token)
   96:                 .AsTask();
   97: 
   98:         await enteredOperation.Task
   99:             .ConfigureAwait(false);
  100: 
  101:         Assert.False(
  102:             execution.IsCompleted);
  103: 
  104:         TestLog.Task(
  105:             "Cancelling the request after active execution has begun.");
  106: 
  107:         cancellation.Cancel();
  108: 
  109:         await observedCancellation.Task
  110:             .ConfigureAwait(false);
  111: 
  112:         var moment =
  113:             await execution
  114:                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
  115: 
  116:         TestLog.Task(
  117:             "Verifying cancellation became honest temporal history.");
  118: 
  119:         Assert.Equal(
  120:             MomentOutcome.Cancelled,
  121:             moment.Outcome);
  122: 
  123:         Assert.Null(
  124:             moment.Result);
  125: 
  126:         Assert.Null(
  127:             moment.Exception);
  128: 
  129:         Assert.Single(
  130:             moment.WorkUnitIds);
  131: 
  132:         Assert.NotEqual(
  133:             System.Guid.Empty,
  134:             moment.WorkUnitIds[0]);
  135: 
  136:         Assert.NotEqual(
  137:             System.Guid.Empty,
  138:             moment.PulseId);
  139: 
  140:         Assert.Equal(
  141:             1,
  142:             engine.Timeline.Count);
  143: 
  144:         Assert.Single(
  145:             engine.Timeline.Moments);
  146: 
  147:         Assert.Same(
  148:             moment,
  149:             engine.Timeline.Moments[0]);
  150: 
  151:         Assert.Equal(
  152:             1,
  153:             engine.Epoch.Count);
  154: 
  155:         Assert.Single(
  156:             engine.Epoch.Timelines);
  157: 
  158:         Assert.Same(
  159:             engine.Timeline,
  160:             engine.Epoch.Timelines[0]);

  199:     {

  201:             "WILDSENGINE ACTIVE CANCELLATION RECOVERY");
  202: 
  203:         TestLog.Test(
  204:             "Engine accepts successful work after an actively cancelled request.");
  205: 
  206:         var component =
  207:             CreateComponent(
  208:                 "execute.active-cancellation-recovery");
  209: 
  210:         using var engine =
  211:             CreateEngine(
  212:                 component);
  213: 
  214:         Assert.True(
  215:             engine.Initialize());
  216: 
  217:         using var cancellation =
  218:             new CancellationTokenSource();
  219: 
  220:         var enteredOperation =
  221:             new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(
  222:                 TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);

  225:             new TestRuntimeObject(
  226:                 "cancelled-request");

  229:             engine.ExecuteAsync(

  236:                             cancelledRequest,
  237:                             observedRequest);
  238: 
  239:                         enteredOperation.TrySetResult(
  240:                             true);

  242:                         await Task.Delay(
  243:                                 Timeout.Infinite,
  244:                                 cancellationToken)
  245:                             .ConfigureAwait(false);
  246: 
  247:                         return new TestRuntimeObject(
  248:                             "must-not-complete");
  249:                     },
  250:                     cancellation.Token)
  251:                 .AsTask();
  252: 
  253:         await enteredOperation.Task
  254:             .ConfigureAwait(false);
  255: 
  256:         TestLog.Task(
  257:             "Cancelling active execution.");
  258: 
  259:         cancellation.Cancel();
  260: 
  261:         var cancelledMoment =
  262:             await cancelledExecution
  263:                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
  264: 
  265:         Assert.Equal(
  266:             MomentOutcome.Cancelled,
  267:             cancelledMoment.Outcome);
  268: 
  269:         Assert.Null(
  270:             cancelledMoment.Result);
  271: 
  272:         Assert.Null(
  273:             cancelledMoment.Exception);
  274:

  276:             cancelledMoment.WorkUnitIds);
  277: 
  278:         Assert.Equal(
  279:             1,
  280:             engine.Timeline.Count);
  281: 
  282:         var recoveryRequest =
  283:             new TestRuntimeObject(
  284:                 "recovery-request");
  285: 
  286:         var recoveryResult =
  287:             new TestRuntimeObject(
  288:                 "recovery-result");
  289: 
  290:         TestLog.Task(
  291:             "Submitting recovery work through the same engine.");

  294:             await engine.ExecuteAsync(
  295:                     recoveryRequest,
  296:                     (
  297:                         observedRequest,
  298:                         cancellationToken) =>

  300:                         cancellationToken
  301:                             .ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
  302: 
  303:                         Assert.Same(
  304:                             recoveryRequest,
  305:                             observedRequest);
  306: 
  307:                         return new ValueTask<object?>(
  308:                             recoveryResult);
  309:                     })
  310:                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
  311: 
  312:         Assert.Equal(
  313:             MomentOutcome.Completed,
  314:             completedMoment.Outcome);

  329:

  335:             2,
  336:             engine.Timeline.Count);

  342:         Assert.Same(
  343:             completedMoment,
  344:             engine.Timeline.Moments[1]);
  345: 
  346:         Assert.Equal(
  347:             MomentOutcome.Cancelled,
  348:             engine.Timeline.Moments[0].Outcome);
  349: 
  350:         Assert.Equal(
  351:             MomentOutcome.Completed,
  352:             engine.Timeline.Moments[1].Outcome);
  353: 
  354:         Assert.Equal(
  355:             1,
  356:             engine.Epoch.Count);
  357: 
  358:         Assert.Same(
  359:             engine.Timeline,
  360:             engine.Epoch.Timelines[0]);
  361: 
  362:         Assert.Equal(
  363:             2,
  364:             engine.Epoch
  365:                 .Timelines[0]
  366:                 .Moments
  367:                 .Count);
  368: 
  369:         TestLog.State(
  370:             "Timeline outcomes = " +
  371:             $"{engine.Timeline.Moments[0].Outcome} -> " +
  372:             $"{engine.Timeline.Moments[1].Outcome}");
  373: 
  374:         TestLog.Pass(
  375:             "The engine recovered after active cancellation.");
  376: 
  377:         TestLog.Pass(
  378:             "Cancelled and completed requests remained distinct in history.");

  381:     [Fact]
  382:     public async Task
  383:         CancellationAfterOperationResultPreventsFalseSuccess()
  384:     {
  385:         TestLog.Section(
  386:             "WILDSENGINE POST-OPERATION CANCELLATION");
  387: 
  388:         TestLog.Test(
  389:             "Cancellation after operation work but before completion prevents false success.");
  390: 
  391:         var component =
  392:             CreateComponent(
  393:                 "execute.post-operation-cancellation");
  394: 
  395:         using var engine =
  396:             CreateEngine(
  397:                 component);
  398: 
  399:         Assert.True(
  400:             engine.Initialize());
  401: 
  402:         using var cancellation =
  403:             new CancellationTokenSource();
  404: 
  405:         var operationEntered =
  406:             new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(
  407:                 TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
  408: 
  409:         var allowOperationReturn =
  410:             new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(
  411:                 TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
  412: 
  413:         var request =
  414:             new TestRuntimeObject(
  415:                 "post-operation-cancellation-request");
  416: 
  417:         var forbiddenResult =
  418:             new TestRuntimeObject(
  419:                 "completed-operation-result");
  420: 
  421:         var execution =
  422:             engine.ExecuteAsync(
  423:                     request,
  424:                     async (
  425:                         observedRequest,
  426:                         cancellationToken) =>
  427:                     {
  428:                         Assert.Same(
  429:                             request,
  430:                             observedRequest);
  431: 
  432:                         operationEntered.TrySetResult(
  433:                             true);
  434: 
  435:                         await allowOperationReturn.Task
  436:                             .ConfigureAwait(false);
  437: 
  438:                         /*
  439:                          * Deliberately return a value without checking
  440:                          * the token here.
  441:                          *
  442:                          * WildsEngine.ExecuteAsync must perform its own
  443:                          * post-operation cancellation check before it
  444:                          * completes the WorkUnit.
  445:                          */
  446:                         return forbiddenResult;
  447:                     },
  448:                     cancellation.Token)
  449:                 .AsTask();
  450: 
  451:         await operationEntered.Task
  452:             .ConfigureAwait(false);
  453: 
  454:         TestLog.Task(
  455:             "Cancelling after the operation entered but before it returned.");
  456: 
  457:         cancellation.Cancel();
  458: 
  459:         allowOperationReturn.TrySetResult(
  460:             true);
  461: 
  462:         var moment =
  463:             await execution
  464:                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
  465: 
  466:         Assert.Equal(
  467:             MomentOutcome.Cancelled,
  468:             moment.Outcome);
  469: 
  470:         Assert.Null(
  471:             moment.Result);
  472: 
  473:         Assert.Null(
  474:             moment.Exception);
  475: 
  476:         Assert.Single(
  477:             moment.WorkUnitIds);
  478: 
  479:         Assert.Single(
  480:             engine.Timeline.Moments);
  481: 
  482:         Assert.Same(
  483:             moment,
  484:             engine.Timeline.Moments[0]);
  485: 
  486:         Assert.False(
  487:             ReferenceEquals(
  488:                 forbiddenResult,
  489:                 moment.Result));
  490: 
  491:         TestLog.State(
  492:             $"Moment outcome = {moment.Outcome}");
  493: 
  494:         TestLog.Pass(
  495:             "Post-operation cancellation prevented false successful completion.");
  496:     }

  380:         private static async Task
  381:             ConcurrentLoadRespectsLimit()
  382:         {
  383:             const int limit = 3;
  384:             const int count = 24;
  385: 
  386:             using var engine =
  387:                 CreateEngine(
  388:                     "certification.concurrent",
  389:                     retainedInstructions: limit,
  390:                     concurrentInstructions: limit);
  391: 
  392:             Assert(
  393:                 engine.Initialize(),
  394:                 "Initialize() should succeed.");
  395: 
  396:             var current = 0;
  397:             var maximum = 0;
  398: 
  399:             var release =
  400:                 new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(
  401:                     TaskCreationOptions
  402:                         .RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
  403: 
  404:             var entered =
  405:                 new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(
  406:                     TaskCreationOptions
  407:                         .RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
  408: 
  409:             var tasks =
  410:                 new List<Task<int>>(
  411:                     count);
  412: 
  413:             for (var i = 0; i < count; i++)
  414:             {
  415:                 tasks.Add(
  416:                     engine.ExecuteInstructionAsync<int>(
  417:                             async (_, token) =>
  418:                             {
  419:                                 var now =
  420:                                     Interlocked.Increment(
  421:                                         ref current);
  422: 
  423:                                 UpdateMaximum(
  424:                                     ref maximum,
  425:                                     now);
  426: 
  427:                                 if (now >= limit)
  428:                                 {
  429:                                     entered.TrySetResult(
  430:                                         true);
  431:                                 }
  432: 
  433:                                 try
  434:                                 {
  435:                                     await release.Task
  436:                                         .ConfigureAwait(false);
  437: 
  438:                                     token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
  439: 
  440:                                     return 1;
  441:                                 }
  442:                                 finally
  443:                                 {
  444:                                     Interlocked.Decrement(
  445:                                         ref current);
  446:                                 }
  447:                             })
  448:                         .AsTask());
  449:             }
  450: 
  451:             await entered.Task
  452:                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
  453: 
  454:             LogPool(
  455:                 engine,
  456:                 "At concurrency limit");
  457: 
  458:             Assert(
  459:                 engine.Instructions.ActiveCount <= limit,
  460:                 "Active leases exceeded MaximumConcurrent.");
  461: 
  462:             release.TrySetResult(
  463:                 true);
  464: 
  465:             await Task.WhenAll(
  466:                     tasks)
  467:                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
  468: 
  469:             Assert(
  470:                 maximum == limit,
  471:                 "Concurrent load did not exercise the configured limit.");
  472: 
  473:             Assert(
  474:                 engine.Instructions.ActiveCount == 0,
  475:                 "All concurrent leases should be returned.");
  476: 
  477:             Assert(
  478:                 engine.Instructions.CreatedCount <= limit,
  479:                 "Pool created more processors than " +
  480:                 "concurrent leasing permits.");
  481:         }
  482: 
  483:         private static void UpdateMaximum(
  484:             ref int target,
  485:             int value)
  486:         {
  487:             while (true)
  488:             {
  489:                 var current =
  490:                     Volatile.Read(
  491:                         ref target);
  492: 
  493:                 if (value <= current)
  494:                     return;
  495: 
  496:                 if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(
  497:                         ref target,
  498:                         value,
  499:                         current) == current)
  500:                 {
  501:                     return;
  502:                 }
  503:             }
  504:         }
  505:

  507:             string name,

  514:             {

  516:

  519: 
  520:                 TestLog.Pass(
  521:                     name);
  522:             }
  523:             catch (Exception exception)
  524:             {
  525:                 TestLog.Fail(
  526:                     name,
  527:                     exception);
  528: 
  529:                 throw;
  530:             }
  531:         }

  164:             "Task",

  166: 
  167:         TestLog.State(
  168:             $"Operation order = " +
  169:             $"{executionOrder[0]} -> " +
  170:             $"{executionOrder[1]} -> " +
  171:             $"{executionOrder[2]}");
  172: 
  173:         TestLog.Task(
  174:             "Verifying one authoritative Moment owns all required work.");
  175: 
  176:         Assert.Equal(
  177:             MomentOutcome.Completed,
  178:             moment.Outcome);
  179: 
  180:         Assert.Same(
  181:             finalResult,
  182:             moment.Result);
  183: 
  184:         Assert.Null(
  185:             moment.Exception);
  186: 
  187:         Assert.Equal(
  188:             3,
  189:             moment.WorkUnitIds.Count);
  190: 
  191:         Assert.NotEqual(
  192:             Guid.Empty,
  193:             moment.PulseId);
  194: 
  195:         Assert.NotEqual(
  196:             Guid.Empty,
  197:             moment.WorkUnitIds[0]);
  198: 
  199:         Assert.NotEqual(
  200:             Guid.Empty,
  201:             moment.WorkUnitIds[1]);
  202: 
  203:         Assert.NotEqual(
  204:             Guid.Empty,
  205:             moment.WorkUnitIds[2]);
  206: 
  207:         Assert.NotEqual(
  208:             moment.WorkUnitIds[0],
  209:             moment.WorkUnitIds[1]);
  210: 
  211:         Assert.NotEqual(
  212:             moment.WorkUnitIds[0],
  213:             moment.WorkUnitIds[2]);
  214: 
  215:         Assert.NotEqual(
  216:             moment.WorkUnitIds[1],
  217:             moment.WorkUnitIds[2]);
  218: 
  219:         TestLog.State(
  220:             $"Pulse = {moment.PulseId}");
  221: 
  222:         TestLog.State(
  223:             $"Required WorkUnits = {moment.WorkUnitIds.Count}");
  224: 
  225:         TestLog.Task(
  226:             "Verifying subordinate results did not become the Pulse result.");
  227: 
  228:         Assert.False(
  229:             ReferenceEquals(
  230:                 firstResult,
  231:                 moment.Result));
  232: 
  233:         Assert.False(
  234:             ReferenceEquals(
  235:                 secondResult,
  236:                 moment.Result));
  237: 
  238:         Assert.False(
  239:             ReferenceEquals(
  240:                 thirdResult,
  241:                 moment.Result));
  242: 
  243:         Assert.Same(
  244:             finalResult,
  245:             moment.Result);
  246: 
  247:         TestLog.Pass(
  248:             "Result selector supplied the authoritative Pulse result.");
  249: 
  250:         TestLog.Task(
  251:             "Verifying the Moment entered Wilds temporal history exactly once.");
  252: 
  253:         Assert.Equal(
  254:             1,
  255:             engine.Timeline.Count);
  256: 
  257:         Assert.Single(
  258:             engine.Timeline.Moments);
  259: 
  260:         Assert.Same(
  261:             moment,
  262:             engine.Timeline.Moments[0]);
  263: 
  264:         Assert.Same(
  265:             finalResult,
  266:             engine.Timeline
  267:                 .Moments[0]
  268:                 .Result);
  269: 
  270:         Assert.Equal(
  271:             1,
  272:             engine.Epoch.Count);
  273: 
  274:         Assert.Single(
  275:             engine.Epoch.Timelines);
  276: 
  277:         Assert.Same(
  278:             engine.Timeline,
  279:             engine.Epoch.Timelines[0]);
  280: 
  281:         Assert.Single(
  282:             engine.Epoch
  283:                 .Timelines[0]
  284:                 .Moments);
  285: 
  286:         Assert.Same(
  287:             moment,
  288:             engine.Epoch
  289:                 .Timelines[0]
  290:                 .Moments[0]);
  291: 
  292:         Assert.Same(
  293:             finalResult,
  294:             engine.Epoch
  295:                 .Timelines[0]
  296:                 .Moments[0]
  297:                 .Result);
  298: 
  299:         TestLog.State(
  300:             $"Moment outcome = {moment.Outcome}");
  301: 
  302:         TestLog.State(
  303:             $"Timeline Moments = {engine.Timeline.Count}");
  304: 
  305:         TestLog.State(
  306:             $"Epoch Timelines = {engine.Epoch.Count}");
  307: 
  308:         TestLog.Pass(
  309:             "One Wilds-facing request owned three required WorkUnits.");
  310: 
  311:         TestLog.Pass(
  312:             "Wilds produced one authoritative completed Moment.");
  313: 
  314:         TestLog.Pass(
  315:             "Subordinate results did not leak into the final result.");
  316: 
  317:         TestLog.Pass(
  318:             "The completed Moment survived Timeline and Epoch history.");
  319: 
  320:         TestLog.Pass(
  321:             "Public multi-work decomposition certification completed successfully.");
  322:     }

  632: [Fact]
  633: public async Task
  634:     ConcurrentExecuteAsyncRecordsEveryMomentExactlyOnce()
  635: {
  636:     const int requestCount =
  637:         64;
  638: 
  639:     TestLog.Section(
  640:         "WildsEngine ExecuteAsync Concurrency");
  641: 
  642:     TestLog.Test(
  643:         "Concurrent requests record every Moment exactly once");
  644: 
  645:     var component =
  646:         CreateComponent(
  647:             "execute.concurrent-history");
  648: 
  649:     using var engine =
  650:         CreateEngine(
  651:             component);
  652: 
  653:     Assert.True(
  654:         engine.Initialize());
  655: 
  656:     var requests =
  657:         Enumerable
  658:             .Range(
  659:                 0,
  660:                 requestCount)
  661:             .Select(
  662:                 index =>
  663:                     new TestRuntimeObject(
  664:                         $"concurrent-request-{index:D3}"))
  665:             .ToArray();
  666: 
  667:     var release =
  668:         new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(
  669:             TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
  670: 
  671:     var enteredCount =
  672:         0;
  673: 
  674:     TestLog.Task(
  675:         $"Submitting {requestCount} concurrent requests.");
  676: 
  677:     var executions =
  678:         requests
  679:             .Select(
  680:                 request =>
  681:                     engine.ExecuteAsync(
  682:                             request,
  683:                             async (
  684:                                 observedRequest,
  685:                                 cancellationToken) =>
  686:                             {
  687:                                 cancellationToken
  688:                                     .ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
  689: 
  690:                                 Assert.Same(
  691:                                     request,
  692:                                     observedRequest);
  693: 
  694:                                 Interlocked.Increment(
  695:                                     ref enteredCount);
  696: 
  697:                                 await release.Task
  698:                                     .ConfigureAwait(false);
  699: 
  700:                                 cancellationToken
  701:                                     .ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
  702: 
  703:                                 return observedRequest;
  704:                             })
  705:                         .AsTask())
  706:             .ToArray();
  707: 
  708:     TestLog.State(
  709:         $"Submitted requests = {executions.Length}");
  710: 
  711:     Assert.Equal(
  712:         requestCount,
  713:         executions.Length);
  714: 
  715:     release.TrySetResult(
  716:         true);
  717: 
  718:     var moments =
  719:         await Task.WhenAll(
  720:                 executions)
  721:             .ConfigureAwait(false);
  722: 
  723:     TestLog.State(
  724:         $"Entered operations = {enteredCount}");
  725: 
  726:     TestLog.State(
  727:         $"Returned Moments = {moments.Length}");
  728: 
  729:     Assert.Equal(
  730:         requestCount,
  731:         enteredCount);
  732: 
  733:     Assert.Equal(
  734:         requestCount,
  735:         moments.Length);
  736: 
  737:     TestLog.Task(
  738:         "Verifying every concurrent request completed successfully.");
  739: 
  740:     Assert.All(
  741:         moments,
  742:         moment =>
  743:         {
  744:             Assert.Equal(
  745:                 MomentOutcome.Completed,
  746:                 moment.Outcome);
  747: 
  748:             Assert.Null(
  749:                 moment.Exception);
  750: 
  751:             Assert.NotNull(
  752:                 moment.Result);
  753: 
  754:             Assert.Single(
  755:                 moment.WorkUnitIds);
  756:         });
  757: 
  758:     TestLog.Pass(
  759:         "Every concurrent request produced a completed Moment.");
  760: 
  761:     TestLog.Task(
  762:         "Verifying request and result identity remained aligned.");
  763: 
  764:     for (var index = 0;
  765:          index < requestCount;
  766:          index++)
  767:     {
  768:         Assert.Same(
  769:             requests[index],
  770:             moments[index].Result);
  771:     }
  772: 
  773:     TestLog.Pass(
  774:         "Every Moment retained its exact request object as the result.");
  775: 
  776:     TestLog.Task(
  777:         "Verifying Pulse identities are unique.");
  778: 
  779:     var pulseIds =
  780:         moments
  781:             .Select(
  782:                 moment =>
  783:                     moment.PulseId)
  784:             .ToArray();
  785: 
  786:     Assert.Equal(
  787:         requestCount,
  788:         pulseIds.Distinct().Count());
  789: 
  790:     Assert.DoesNotContain(
  791:         Guid.Empty,
  792:         pulseIds);
  793: 
  794:     TestLog.Pass(
  795:         "Every concurrent request received a unique Pulse identity.");
  796: 
  797:     TestLog.Task(
  798:         "Verifying WorkUnit identities are unique.");
  799: 
  800:     var workUnitIds =
  801:         moments
  802:             .SelectMany(
  803:                 moment =>
  804:                     moment.WorkUnitIds)
  805:             .ToArray();
  806: 
  807:     Assert.Equal(
  808:         requestCount,
  809:         workUnitIds.Length);
  810: 
  811:     Assert.Equal(
  812:         requestCount,
  813:         workUnitIds.Distinct().Count());
  814: 
  815:     Assert.DoesNotContain(
  816:         Guid.Empty,
  817:         workUnitIds);
  818: 
  819:     TestLog.Pass(
  820:         "Every concurrent request received one unique WorkUnit identity.");
  821: 
  822:     TestLog.Task(
  823:         "Verifying Timeline recorded every returned Moment exactly once.");
  824: 
  825:     Assert.Equal(
  826:         requestCount,
  827:         engine.Timeline.Count);
  828: 
  829:     var recordedMoments =
  830:         engine.Timeline
  831:             .Moments
  832:             .ToArray();
  833: 
  834:     Assert.Equal(
  835:         requestCount,
  836:         recordedMoments.Length);
  837: 
  838:     Assert.Equal(
  839:         requestCount,
  840:         recordedMoments
  841:             .Select(
  842:                 moment =>
  843:                     moment.Id)
  844:             .Distinct()
  845:             .Count());
  846: 
  847:     foreach (var returnedMoment in moments)
  848:     {
  849:         Assert.Equal(
  850:             1,
  851:             recordedMoments.Count(
  852:                 recordedMoment =>
  853:                     ReferenceEquals(
  854:                         returnedMoment,
  855:                         recordedMoment)));
  856:     }
  857: 
  858:     TestLog.Pass(
  859:         "Timeline recorded every returned Moment exactly once.");
  860: 
  861:     TestLog.Task(
  862:         "Verifying every submitted request appears exactly once in history.");
  863: 
  864:     foreach (var request in requests)
  865:     {
  866:         Assert.Equal(
  867:             1,
  868:             recordedMoments.Count(
  869:                 moment =>
  870:                     ReferenceEquals(
  871:                         request,
  872:                         moment.Result)));
  873:     }
  874: 
  875:     TestLog.Pass(
  876:         "Timeline retained every submitted request exactly once.");
  877: 
  878:     TestLog.Task(
  879:         "Verifying Epoch retained the complete shared Timeline.");
  880: 
  881:     Assert.Equal(
  882:         1,
  883:         engine.Epoch.Count);
  884: 
  885:     Assert.Single(
  886:         engine.Epoch.Timelines);
  887: 
  888:     Assert.Same(
  889:         engine.Timeline,
  890:         engine.Epoch.Timelines[0]);
  891: 
  892:     Assert.Equal(
  893:         requestCount,
  894:         engine.Epoch
  895:             .Timelines[0]
  896:             .Moments
  897:             .Count);
  898: 
  899:     foreach (var returnedMoment in moments)
  900:     {
  901:         Assert.Equal(
  902:             1,
  903:             engine.Epoch
  904:                 .Timelines[0]
  905:                 .Moments
  906:                 .Count(
  907:                     recordedMoment =>
  908:                         ReferenceEquals(
  909:                             returnedMoment,
  910:                             recordedMoment)));
  911:     }
  912: 
  913:     TestLog.Pass(
  914:         "Epoch retained the complete concurrent Timeline.");
  915: 
  916:     TestLog.State(
  917:         $"Requests = {requestCount}");
  918: 
  919:     TestLog.State(
  920:         $"Unique Pulses = {pulseIds.Distinct().Count()}");
  921: 
  922:     TestLog.State(
  923:         $"Unique WorkUnits = {workUnitIds.Distinct().Count()}");
  924: 
  925:     TestLog.State(
  926:         $"Timeline Moments = {engine.Timeline.Count}");
  927: 
  928:     TestLog.State(
  929:         $"Epoch Timelines = {engine.Epoch.Count}");
  930: 
  931:     TestLog.Pass(
  932:         "Concurrent ExecuteAsync temporal-history certification completed successfully.");
  933: }

    1: using System;

   13: 
   14: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Tests
   15: {
   16:     /// <summary>
   17:     /// Certifies the complete Wilds -> QSL -> Wilds route.
   18:     ///
   19:     /// Consumer request
   20:     ///     -> Wilds
   21:     ///     -> Pulse
   22:     ///     -> WorkUnit
   23:     ///     -> QSL
   24:     ///     -> WorkUnit result
   25:     ///     -> Moment
   26:     ///     -> Timeline
   27:     ///     -> Epoch
   28:     ///
   29:     /// Wilds owns request processing and temporal resolution.
   30:     /// QSL performs delegated language work inside that route.
   31:     /// </summary>
   32:     public sealed class WildsQslEndToEndTests
   33:     {
   34:         [Fact]
   35:         public async Task QslWorkResolvesThroughCompleteWildsLifecycle()
   36:         {
   37:             TestLog.Section(
   38:                 "Wilds / QSL End-to-End");
   39: 
   40:             TestLog.Test(
   41:                 "QSL work resolves inside the Wilds lifecycle");
   42: 
   43:             var qslEngine =
   44:                 CreateQslEngine();
   45: 
   46:             var component =
   47:                 new TestComponent(
   48:                     "qsl.end-to-end");
   49: 
   50:             using var wildsEngine =
   51:                 CreateWildsEngine(
   52:                     component);
   53: 
   54:             Assert.True(
   55:                 wildsEngine.Initialize());
   56: 
   57:             var executor =
   58:                 new WildsQslExecutor(
   59:                     qslEngine,
   60:                     wildsEngine);
   61: 
   62:             var player =
   63:                 new TestPlayer(
   64:                     50.0);
   65: 
   66:             var action =
   67:                 new TestAction(
   68:                     10.0);
   69: 
   70:             var playerBinding =
   71:                 new QslConsumerBinding(
   72:                     "player",
   73:                     "Player",
   74:                     player);
   75: 
   76:             var actionBinding =
   77:                 new QslConsumerBinding(
   78:                     "action",
   79:                     "Action",
   80:                     action);
   81: 
   82:             var statePackage =
   83:                 new QslStatePackage(
   84:                     action,
   85:                     new Dictionary<string, object?>
   86:                     {
   87:                         {
   88:                             "SpaceDustAppetite",
   89:                             87.0
   90:                         }
   91:                     });
   92: 
   93:             var request =
   94:                 new WildsQslRequest(
   95:                     "player.Health = player.Health - " +
   96:                     "(action.Amount * " +
   97:                     "(action.SpaceDustAppetite / 100))",
   98:                     new[]
   99:                     {
  100:                         playerBinding,
  101:                         actionBinding
  102:                     },
  103:                     new[]
  104:                     {
  105:                         statePackage
  106:                     });
  107: 
  108:             Assert.Equal(
  109:                 0,
  110:                 wildsEngine.Timeline.Count);
  111: 
  112:             TestLog.State(
  113:                 "Submitting consumer request to Wilds");
  114: 
  115:             var moment =
  116:                 await executor.ExecuteAsync(
  117:                     request);
  118: 
  119:             TestLog.State(
  120:                 "QSL work returned to Wilds");
  121: 
  122:             Assert.Equal(
  123:                 MomentOutcome.Completed,
  124:                 moment.Outcome);
  125: 
  126:             Assert.Null(
  127:                 moment.Exception);
  128: 
  129:             Assert.Single(
  130:                 moment.WorkUnitIds);
  131: 
  132:             Assert.Equal(
  133:                 41.3,
  134:                 Convert.ToDouble(
  135:                     moment.Result),
  136:                 10);
  137: 
  138:             Assert.Equal(
  139:                 41.3,
  140:                 player.Health,
  141:                 10);
  142: 
  143:             Assert.Same(
  144:                 player,
  145:                 playerBinding.Value);
  146: 
  147:             Assert.Same(
  148:                 action,
  149:                 actionBinding.Value);
  150: 
  151:             Assert.Same(
  152:                 action,
  153:                 statePackage.Target);
  154: 
  155:             Assert.Equal(
  156:                 1,
  157:                 wildsEngine.Timeline.Count);
  158: 
  159:             Assert.Same(
  160:                 moment,
  161:                 wildsEngine.Timeline.Moments[0]);
  162: 
  163:             Assert.Equal(
  164:                 1,
  165:                 wildsEngine.Epoch.Count);
  166: 
  167:             Assert.Single(
  168:                 wildsEngine.Epoch.Timelines);
  169: 
  170:             Assert.Same(
  171:                 wildsEngine.Timeline,
  172:                 wildsEngine.Epoch.Timelines[0]);
  173: 
  174:             Assert.Single(
  175:                 wildsEngine.Epoch
  176:                     .Timelines[0]
  177:                     .Moments);
  178: 
  179:             Assert.Same(
  180:                 moment,
  181:                 wildsEngine.Epoch
  182:                     .Timelines[0]
  183:                     .Moments[0]);
  184: 
  185:             TestLog.State(

  187:                 player.Health);
  188:

  190:                 "Moment outcome: " +

  196:

  199:                 wildsEngine.Timeline.Count);
  200: 
  201:             TestLog.State(
  202:                 "Epoch Timelines: " +
  203:                 wildsEngine.Epoch.Count);
  204:

   46:

   48:          * Deliberately incomplete expression.
   49:          *
   50:          * The source reaches QSL through the Wilds-owned

   54:         var request =

   68: 
   69:         Assert.Single(
   70:             moment.WorkUnitIds);
   71:

   73:             Assert.IsType<WildsQslExecutionException>(
   74:                 moment.Exception);
   75: 
   76:         var processingResult =
   77:             qslException.Result;
   78: 
   79:         Assert.False(
   80:             processingResult.Succeeded);
   81:

   83:             processingResult.ParseFailed);
   84: 
   85:         Assert.False(
   86:             processingResult.EvaluationFailed);
   87: 
   88:         Assert.NotEmpty(
   89:             processingResult.ParserDiagnostics);
   90: 
   91:         Assert.Empty(
   92:             processingResult.RuntimeDiagnostics);
   93: 
   94:         Assert.Same(
   95:             qslException,
   96:             moment.Exception);
   97: 
   98:         Assert.Single(
   99:             wildsEngine.Timeline.Moments);

  104: 
  105:         Assert.Single(
  106:             wildsEngine.Epoch.Timelines);
  107: 
  108:         Assert.Same(
  109:             wildsEngine.Timeline,
  110:             wildsEngine.Epoch.Timelines[0]);
  111:

  113:             wildsEngine.Epoch
  114:                 .Timelines[0]
  115:                 .Moments);
  116: 
  117:         Assert.Same(
  118:             moment,
  119:             wildsEngine.Epoch
  120:                 .Timelines[0]
  121:                 .Moments[0]);
  122:

  124:             "Parser diagnostics: " +
  125:             processingResult
  126:                 .ParserDiagnostics
  127:                 .Count);
  128: 
  129:         TestLog.State(
  130:             "Moment outcome: " +
  131:             moment.Outcome);
  132: 
  133:         TestLog.Pass(
  134:             "Original QSL parse diagnostics survived " +
  135:             "the Wilds failure route");
  136:     }

  143:

  146:

  191:         Assert.Single(
  192:             moment.WorkUnitIds);
  193: 
  194:         var qslException =
  195:             Assert.IsType<WildsQslExecutionException>(
  196:                 moment.Exception);
  197: 
  198:         var processingResult =
  199:             qslException.Result;
  200: 
  201:         Assert.False(
  202:             processingResult.Succeeded);
  203: 
  204:         Assert.False(
  205:             processingResult.ParseFailed);
  206: 
  207:         Assert.True(
  208:             processingResult.EvaluationFailed);
  209: 
  210:         Assert.Empty(
  211:             processingResult.ParserDiagnostics);
  212: 
  213:         Assert.NotEmpty(
  214:             processingResult.RuntimeDiagnostics);
  215: 
  216:         var foundExpectedDiagnostic =
  217:             false;
  218: 
  219:         for (
  220:             var index = 0;
  221:             index <
  222:             processingResult.RuntimeDiagnostics.Count;
  223:             index++)
  224:         {
  225:             var diagnostic =
  226:                 processingResult
  227:                     .RuntimeDiagnostics[index];
  228: 
  229:             if (diagnostic.Message.Contains(
  230:                     "Unresolved identifier: missingConsumer",
  231:                     StringComparison.Ordinal))
  232:             {
  233:                 foundExpectedDiagnostic =
  234:                     true;
  235: 
  236:                 break;
  237:             }
  238:         }
  239: 
  240:         Assert.True(
  241:             foundExpectedDiagnostic,
  242:             "The original unresolved-identifier " +
  243:             "QSL provenance entry must remain available.");
  244: 
  245:         Assert.Same(
  246:             qslException,
  247:             moment.Exception);
  248: 
  249:         Assert.Single(
  250:             wildsEngine.Timeline.Moments);
  251: 
  252:         Assert.Same(
  253:             moment,
  254:             wildsEngine.Timeline.Moments[0]);
  255: 
  256:         Assert.Single(
  257:             wildsEngine.Epoch.Timelines);
  258:

  267:

  272:                 .Moments[0]);

  277:                 .RuntimeDiagnostics
  278:                 .Count);
  279:

  425:         private static bool NumericEquals(
  426:             object? value,
  427:             double expected)
  428:         {
  429:             if (value == null)
  430:             {
  431:                 return false;
  432:             }
  433: 
  434:             try
  435:             {
  436:                 var actual =
  437:                     Convert.ToDouble(
  438:                         value,
  439:                         CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
  440: 
  441:                 return Math.Abs(
  442:                            actual -
  443:                            expected) <
  444:                        0.0000001;
  445:             }
  446:             catch (
  447:                 InvalidCastException)
  448:             {
  449:                 return false;
  450:             }
  451:             catch (
  452:                 FormatException)
  453:             {
  454:                 return false;
  455:             }
  456:             catch (
  457:                 OverflowException)
  458:             {
  459:                 return false;
  460:             }
  461:         }
  462: 
  463:         private static string FormatValue(
  464:             object? value)
  465:         {
  466:             if (value == null)
  467:             {
  468:                 return "<null>";
  469:             }
  470: 
  471:             var formattable =
  472:                 value as IFormattable;
  473: 
  474:             if (formattable != null)
  475:             {
  476:                 return formattable.ToString(
  477:                            null,
  478:                            CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
  479:                        ?? string.Empty;
  480:             }
  481: 
  482:             return value.ToString()
  483:                    ?? string.Empty;
  484:         }
