   29:             CreateQslEngine();
   30: 
   31:         var qslB =
   32:             CreateQslEngine();
   33: 
   34:         var componentA =
   35:             new TestComponent(
   36:                 "qsl.isolation.a");
   37: 
   38:         var componentB =
   39:             new TestComponent(
   40:                 "qsl.isolation.b");
   41: 
   42:         using var wildsA =
   43:             CreateWildsEngine(
   44:                 componentA,
   45:                 "certification.qsl.isolation.a");
   46: 
   47:         using var wildsB =
   48:             CreateWildsEngine(
   49:                 componentB,
   50:                 "certification.qsl.isolation.b");
   51: 
   52:         Assert.True(
   53:             wildsA.Initialize());
   54: 
   55:         Assert.True(
   56:             wildsB.Initialize());
   57: 
   58:         var executorA =
   59:             new WildsQslExecutor(
   60:                 qslA,
   61:                 wildsA);
   62: 
   63:         var executorB =
   64:             new WildsQslExecutor(
   65:                 qslB,
   66:                 wildsB);
   67: 
   68:         var playerA =
   69:             new TestPlayer(
   70:                 100.0);
   71: 
   72:         var playerB =
   73:             new TestPlayer(
   74:                 200.0);
   75: 
   76:         var actionA =
   77:             new TestAction(
   78:                 10.0);
   79: 
   80:         var actionB =
   81:             new TestAction(
   82:                 20.0);
   83: 
   84:         /*
   85:          * Both runtimes intentionally use the exact
   86:          * same consumer aliases.
   87:          */
   88:         var playerBindingA =
   89:             new QslConsumerBinding(
   90:                 "player",
   91:                 "Player",
   92:                 playerA);
   93: 
   94:         var actionBindingA =
   95:             new QslConsumerBinding(
   96:                 "action",
   97:                 "Action",
   98:                 actionA);
   99: 
  100:         var playerBindingB =
  101:             new QslConsumerBinding(
  102:                 "player",
  103:                 "Player",
  104:                 playerB);
  105: 
  106:         var actionBindingB =
  107:             new QslConsumerBinding(
  108:                 "action",
  109:                 "Action",
  110:                 actionB);
  111: 
  112:         /*
  113:          * Both packages intentionally introduce the
  114:          * same attached-property name with different
  115:          * values and different exact target objects.
  116:          */
  117:         var packageA =
  118:             new QslStatePackage(
  119:                 actionA,
  120:                 new Dictionary<string, object?>
  121:                 {
  122:                     {
  123:                         "SpaceDustAppetite",
  124:                         25.0
  125:                     }
  126:                 });
  127: 
  128:         var packageB =
  129:             new QslStatePackage(
  130:                 actionB,
  131:                 new Dictionary<string, object?>
  132:                 {
  133:                     {
  134:                         "SpaceDustAppetite",
  135:                         75.0
  136:                     }
  137:                 });
  138: 
  139:         var source =
  140:             "player.Health = player.Health - " +
  141:             "(action.Amount * " +
  142:             "(action.SpaceDustAppetite / 100))";
  143: 
  144:         var requestA =
  145:             new WildsQslRequest(
  146:                 source,
  147:                 new[]
  148:                 {
  149:                     playerBindingA,
  150:                     actionBindingA
  151:                 },
  152:                 new[]
  153:                 {
  154:                     packageA
  155:                 });
  156: 
  157:         var requestB =
  158:             new WildsQslRequest(
  159:                 source,
  160:                 new[]
  161:                 {
  162:                     playerBindingB,
  163:                     actionBindingB
  164:                 },
  165:                 new[]
  166:                 {
  167:                     packageB
  168:                 });
  169: 
  170:         TestLog.State(
  171:             "Runtime A: player.Health=100, action.Amount=10, " +
  172:             "SpaceDustAppetite=25");
  173: 
  174:         TestLog.State(
  175:             "Runtime B: player.Health=200, action.Amount=20, " +
  176:             "SpaceDustAppetite=75");
  177: 
  178:         TestLog.Task(
  179:             "Executing both requests through their independent Wilds/QSL runtimes.");
  180: 
  181:         var momentA =
  182:             await executorA.ExecuteAsync(
  183:                 requestA);
  184: 
  185:         var momentB =
  186:             await executorB.ExecuteAsync(
  187:                 requestB);
  188: 
  189:         TestLog.Task(
  190:             "Verifying both runtimes completed independently.");
  191: 
  192:         Assert.Equal(
  193:             MomentOutcome.Completed,
  194:             momentA.Outcome);
  195: 
  196:         Assert.Equal(
  197:             MomentOutcome.Completed,
  198:             momentB.Outcome);
  199: 
  200:         Assert.Null(
  201:             momentA.Exception);
  202: 
  203:         Assert.Null(
  204:             momentB.Exception);
  205: 
  206:         /*
  207:          * A:
  208:          *
  209:          * 100 - (10 * 0.25)
  210:          * = 97.5
  211:          */
  212:         Assert.Equal(
  213:             97.5,
  214:             playerA.Health,
  215:             10);
  216: 
  217:         Assert.Equal(
  218:             97.5,
  219:             Convert.ToDouble(
  220:                 momentA.Result),
  221:             10);
  222: 
  223:         /*
  224:          * B:
  225:          *
  226:          * 200 - (20 * 0.75)
  227:          * = 185
  228:          */
  229:         Assert.Equal(
  230:             185.0,
  231:             playerB.Health,
  232:             10);
  233: 
  234:         Assert.Equal(
  235:             185.0,
  236:             Convert.ToDouble(
  237:                 momentB.Result),
  238:             10);
  239: 
  240:         TestLog.State(
  241:             $"Runtime A Player.Health = {playerA.Health}");
  242: 
  243:         TestLog.State(
  244:             $"Runtime B Player.Health = {playerB.Health}");
  245: 
  246:         TestLog.Pass(
  247:             "Identical aliases resolved against independent consumer objects.");
  248: 
  249:         TestLog.Task(
  250:             "Verifying exact target and package identity remained isolated.");
  251: 
  252:         Assert.Same(
  253:             playerA,
  254:             playerBindingA.Value);
  255: 
  256:         Assert.Same(
  257:             actionA,
  258:             actionBindingA.Value);
  259: 
  260:         Assert.Same(
  261:             actionA,
  262:             packageA.Target);
  263: 
  264:         Assert.Same(
  265:             playerB,
  266:             playerBindingB.Value);
  267: 
  268:         Assert.Same(
  269:             actionB,
  270:             actionBindingB.Value);
  271: 
  272:         Assert.Same(
  273:             actionB,
  274:             packageB.Target);
  275: 
  276:         Assert.NotSame(
  277:             playerA,
  278:             playerB);
  279: 
  280:         Assert.NotSame(
  281:             actionA,
  282:             actionB);
  283: 
  284:         Assert.NotSame(
  285:             packageA,
  286:             packageB);
  287: 
  288:         TestLog.Pass(
  289:             "Consumer and state-package target identities remained isolated.");
  290: 
  291:         TestLog.Task(
  292:             "Verifying Wilds temporal histories remained isolated.");
  293: 
  294:         Assert.Equal(
  295:             1,
  296:             wildsA.Timeline.Count);
  297: 
  298:         Assert.Equal(
  299:             1,
  300:             wildsB.Timeline.Count);
  301: 
  302:         Assert.Same(
  303:             momentA,
  304:             wildsA.Timeline.Moments[0]);
  305: 
  306:         Assert.Same(
  307:             momentB,
  308:             wildsB.Timeline.Moments[0]);
  309: 
  310:         Assert.NotSame(
  311:             momentA,
  312:             momentB);
  313: 
  314:         Assert.NotEqual(
  315:             momentA.PulseId,
  316:             momentB.PulseId);
  317: 
  318:         Assert.Equal(
  319:             1,
  320:             wildsA.Epoch.Count);
  321: 
  322:         Assert.Equal(
  323:             1,
  324:             wildsB.Epoch.Count);
  325: 
  326:         Assert.Same(
  327:             wildsA.Timeline,
  328:             wildsA.Epoch.Timelines[0]);
  329: 
  330:         Assert.Same(
  331:             wildsB.Timeline,
  332:             wildsB.Epoch.Timelines[0]);
  333: 
  334:         Assert.NotSame(
  335:             wildsA.Timeline,
  336:             wildsB.Timeline);
  337: 
  338:         Assert.NotSame(
  339:             wildsA.Epoch,
  340:             wildsB.Epoch);
  341: 
  342:         TestLog.Pass(
  343:             "Timeline and Epoch histories remained runtime-local.");
  344: 
  345:         TestLog.Pass(
  346:             "Wilds/QSL runtime isolation certification completed successfully.");
  347:     }

  351:     [Fact]
  352:     public async Task
  353:         FailureInOneRuntimeDoesNotContaminateAnotherRuntime()
  354:     {
  355:         TestLog.Section(
  356:             "WILDS / QSL FAILURE ISOLATION");
  357: 
  358:         TestLog.Test(
  359:             "Failure in one runtime does not alter another runtime's result or history.");
  360: 
  361:         var qslA =
  362:             CreateQslEngine();
  363: 
  364:         var qslB =
  365:             CreateQslEngine();
  366: 
  367:         var componentA =
  368:             new TestComponent(
  369:                 "qsl.failure-isolation.a");
  370: 
  371:         var componentB =
  372:             new TestComponent(
  373:                 "qsl.failure-isolation.b");
  374: 
  375:         using var wildsA =
  376:             CreateWildsEngine(
  377:                 componentA,
  378:                 "certification.qsl.failure-isolation.a");
  379: 
  380:         using var wildsB =
  381:             CreateWildsEngine(
  382:                 componentB,
  383:                 "certification.qsl.failure-isolation.b");
  384: 
  385:         Assert.True(
  386:             wildsA.Initialize());
  387: 
  388:         Assert.True(
  389:             wildsB.Initialize());
  390: 
  391:         var executorA =
  392:             new WildsQslExecutor(
  393:                 qslA,
  394:                 wildsA);
  395: 
  396:         var executorB =
  397:             new WildsQslExecutor(
  398:                 qslB,
  399:                 wildsB);
  400: 
  401:         var playerA =
  402:             new TestPlayer(
  403:                 50.0);
  404: 
  405:         var actionA =
  406:             new TestAction(
  407:                 10.0);
  408: 
  409:         var playerB =
  410:             new TestPlayer(
  411:                 80.0);
  412: 
  413:         var actionB =
  414:             new TestAction(
  415:                 20.0);
  416: 
  417:         var requestA =
  418:             new WildsQslRequest(
  419:                 "player.Health = player.Health - " +
  420:                 "(action.Amount * " +
  421:                 "(action.SpaceDustAppetite / 100))",
  422:                 new[]
  423:                 {
  424:                     new QslConsumerBinding(
  425:                         "player",
  426:                         "Player",
  427:                         playerA),
  428: 
  429:                     new QslConsumerBinding(
  430:                         "action",
  431:                         "Action",
  432:                         actionA)
  433:                 },
  434:                 new[]
  435:                 {
  436:                     new QslStatePackage(
  437:                         actionA,
  438:                         new Dictionary<string, object?>
  439:                         {
  440:                             {
  441:                                 "SpaceDustAppetite",
  442:                                 50.0
  443:                             }
  444:                         })
  445:                 });
  446: 
  447:         /*
  448:          * Runtime B deliberately receives source that
  449:          * cannot resolve successfully.
  450:          *
  451:          * We do not need its exact diagnostic shape here.
  452:          * This test only certifies cross-runtime isolation.
  453:          */
  454:         var requestB =
  455:             new WildsQslRequest(
  456:                 "missingRuntimeObject.Value",
  457:                 new[]
  458:                 {
  459:                     new QslConsumerBinding(
  460:                         "player",
  461:                         "Player",
  462:                         playerB),
  463: 
  464:                     new QslConsumerBinding(
  465:                         "action",
  466:                         "Action",
  467:                         actionB)
  468:                 });
  469: 
  470:         TestLog.Task(
  471:             "Executing successful Runtime A request.");
  472: 
  473:         var momentA =
  474:             await executorA.ExecuteAsync(
  475:                 requestA);
  476: 
  477:         Assert.Equal(
  478:             MomentOutcome.Completed,
  479:             momentA.Outcome);
  480: 
  481:         Assert.Equal(
  482:             45.0,
  483:             playerA.Health,
  484:             10);
  485: 
  486:         Assert.Equal(
  487:             45.0,
  488:             Convert.ToDouble(
  489:                 momentA.Result),
  490:             10);
  491: 
  492:         TestLog.Task(
  493:             "Executing intentionally failing Runtime B request.");
  494: 
  495:         var momentB =
  496:             await executorB.ExecuteAsync(
  497:                 requestB);
  498: 
  499:         Assert.Equal(
  500:             MomentOutcome.Failed,
  501:             momentB.Outcome);
  502: 
  503:         Assert.Null(
  504:             momentB.Result);
  505: 
  506:         Assert.NotNull(
  507:             momentB.Exception);
  508: 
  509:         /*
  510:          * Runtime B failure must not alter the already
  511:          * resolved consumer state belonging to Runtime A.
  512:          */
  513:         Assert.Equal(
  514:             45.0,
  515:             playerA.Health,
  516:             10);
  517: 
  518:         /*
  519:          * The failed source did not assign playerB.Health,
  520:          * so its native value must remain unchanged.
  521:          */
  522:         Assert.Equal(
  523:             80.0,
  524:             playerB.Health,
  525:             10);
  526: 
  527:         TestLog.State(
  528:             $"Runtime A outcome = {momentA.Outcome}");
  529: 
  530:         TestLog.State(
  531:             $"Runtime B outcome = {momentB.Outcome}");
  532: 
  533:         TestLog.State(
  534:             $"Runtime A Player.Health = {playerA.Health}");
  535: 
  536:         TestLog.State(
  537:             $"Runtime B Player.Health = {playerB.Health}");
  538: 
  539:         TestLog.Task(
  540:             "Verifying each engine retained only its own Moment.");
  541: 
  542:         Assert.Single(
  543:             wildsA.Timeline.Moments);
  544: 
  545:         Assert.Single(
  546:             wildsB.Timeline.Moments);
  547: 
  548:         Assert.Same(
  549:             momentA,
  550:             wildsA.Timeline.Moments[0]);
  551: 
  552:         Assert.Same(
  553:             momentB,
  554:             wildsB.Timeline.Moments[0]);
  555: 
  556:         Assert.NotSame(
  557:             momentA,
  558:             momentB);
  559: 
  560:         Assert.Equal(
  561:             MomentOutcome.Completed,
  562:             wildsA.Timeline.Moments[0].Outcome);
  563: 
  564:         Assert.Equal(
  565:             MomentOutcome.Failed,
  566:             wildsB.Timeline.Moments[0].Outcome);
  567: 
  568:         Assert.NotEqual(
  569:             momentA.PulseId,
  570:             momentB.PulseId);
  571: 
  572:         Assert.Same(
  573:             wildsA.Timeline,
  574:             wildsA.Epoch.Timelines[0]);
  575: 
  576:         Assert.Same(
  577:             wildsB.Timeline,
  578:             wildsB.Epoch.Timelines[0]);
  579: 
  580:         TestLog.Pass(
  581:             "Failure remained local to the failing runtime.");
  582: 
  583:         TestLog.Pass(
  584:             "Successful consumer state and history remained unchanged.");
  585: 
  586:         TestLog.Pass(
  587:             "Wilds/QSL failure-isolation certification completed successfully.");
  588:     }
  589:     
  590:     [Fact]
  591: public void
  592:     ClearingOneQslRuntimeDoesNotAffectAnotherRuntime()
  593: {
  594:     TestLog.Section(
  595:         "WILDS / QSL CLEAR ISOLATION");
  596: 
  597:     TestLog.Test(
  598:         "Clearing one QSL runtime does not alter another runtime.");
  599: 
  600:     var qslA =
  601:         CreateQslEngine();
  602: 
  603:     var qslB =
  604:         CreateQslEngine();
  605: 
  606:     var playerA =
  607:         new TestPlayer(
  608:             50.0);
  609: 
  610:     var playerB =
  611:         new TestPlayer(
  612:             80.0);
  613: 
  614:     var bindingA =
  615:         new QslConsumerBinding(
  616:             "player",
  617:             "Player",
  618:             playerA);
  619: 
  620:     var bindingB =
  621:         new QslConsumerBinding(
  622:             "player",
  623:             "Player",
  624:             playerB);
  625: 
  626:     qslA.BindConsumer(
  627:         bindingA);
  628: 
  629:     qslB.BindConsumer(
  630:         bindingB);
  631: 
  632:     Assert.True(
  633:         qslA.ReceiveState(
  634:             playerA,
  635:             "Curiosity",
  636:             11.0));
  637: 
  638:     Assert.True(
  639:         qslB.ReceiveState(
  640:             playerB,
  641:             "Curiosity",
  642:             22.0));
  643: 
  644:     var beforeA =
  645:         qslA.Evaluate(
  646:             "player.Curiosity");
  647: 
  648:     var beforeB =
  649:         qslB.Evaluate(
  650:             "player.Curiosity");
  651: 
  652:     Assert.True(
  653:         beforeA.Succeeded);
  654: 
  655:     Assert.True(
  656:         beforeB.Succeeded);
  657: 
  658:     Assert.Equal(
  659:         11.0,
  660:         Convert.ToDouble(
  661:             beforeA.Value),
  662:         10);
  663: 
  664:     Assert.Equal(
  665:         22.0,
  666:         Convert.ToDouble(
  667:             beforeB.Value),
  668:         10);
  669: 
  670:     TestLog.State(
  671:         "Runtime A player.Curiosity = 11");
  672: 
  673:     TestLog.State(
  674:         "Runtime B player.Curiosity = 22");
  675: 
  676:     TestLog.Task(
  677:         "Clearing Runtime A only.");
  678: 
  679:     qslA.Clear();
  680: 
  681:     var afterA =
  682:         qslA.Evaluate(
  683:             "player.Curiosity");
  684: 
  685:     var afterB =
  686:         qslB.Evaluate(
  687:             "player.Curiosity");
  688: 
  689:     TestLog.Task(
  690:         "Verifying Runtime A no longer resolves its cleared consumer state.");
  691: 
  692:     Assert.False(
  693:         afterA.Succeeded);
  694: 
  695:     TestLog.Pass(
  696:         "Runtime A active bindings and attached state were cleared.");
  697: 
  698:     TestLog.Task(
  699:         "Verifying Runtime B remains completely operational.");
  700: 
  701:     Assert.True(
  702:         afterB.Succeeded);
  703: 
  704:     Assert.Equal(
  705:         22.0,
  706:         Convert.ToDouble(
  707:             afterB.Value),
  708:         10);
  709: 
  710:     Assert.Same(
  711:         playerB,
  712:         bindingB.Value);
  713: 
  714:     Assert.Equal(
  715:         80.0,
  716:         playerB.Health,
  717:         10);
  718: 
  719:     TestLog.State(
  720:         $"Runtime B player.Curiosity = {afterB.Value}");
  721: 
  722:     TestLog.Pass(
  723:         "Runtime B binding and attached state survived Runtime A clear.");
  724: 
  725:     TestLog.Pass(
  726:         "QSL runtime clear isolation certification completed successfully.");
  727: }

  729: [Fact]
  730: public void
  731:     UnbindingConsumerInOneRuntimeDoesNotRemoveSameAliasFromAnotherRuntime()
  732: {
  733:     TestLog.Section(
  734:         "WILDS / QSL CONSUMER UNBIND ISOLATION");
  735: 
  736:     TestLog.Test(
  737:         "Unbinding one consumer does not remove the same alias from another runtime.");
  738: 
  739:     var qslA =
  740:         CreateQslEngine();
  741: 
  742:     var qslB =
  743:         CreateQslEngine();
  744: 
  745:     var playerA =
  746:         new TestPlayer(
  747:             50.0);
  748: 
  749:     var playerB =
  750:         new TestPlayer(
  751:             80.0);
  752: 
  753:     var bindingA =
  754:         new QslConsumerBinding(
  755:             "player",
  756:             "Player",
  757:             playerA);
  758: 
  759:     var bindingB =
  760:         new QslConsumerBinding(
  761:             "player",
  762:             "Player",
  763:             playerB);
  764: 
  765:     qslA.BindConsumer(
  766:         bindingA);
  767: 
  768:     qslB.BindConsumer(
  769:         bindingB);
  770: 
  771:     Assert.True(
  772:         qslA.ReceiveState(
  773:             playerA,
  774:             "Curiosity",
  775:             11.0));
  776: 
  777:     Assert.True(
  778:         qslB.ReceiveState(
  779:             playerB,
  780:             "Curiosity",
  781:             22.0));
  782: 
  783:     var beforeA =
  784:         qslA.Evaluate(
  785:             "player.Curiosity");
  786: 
  787:     var beforeB =
  788:         qslB.Evaluate(
  789:             "player.Curiosity");
  790: 
  791:     Assert.True(
  792:         beforeA.Succeeded);
  793: 
  794:     Assert.True(
  795:         beforeB.Succeeded);
  796: 
  797:     Assert.Equal(
  798:         11.0,
  799:         Convert.ToDouble(
  800:             beforeA.Value),
  801:         10);
  802: 
  803:     Assert.Equal(
  804:         22.0,
  805:         Convert.ToDouble(
  806:             beforeB.Value),
  807:         10);
  808: 
  809:     TestLog.Task(
  810:         "Unbinding Runtime A player.");
  811: 
  812:     Assert.True(
  813:         qslA.UnbindConsumer(
  814:             bindingA));
  815: 
  816:     var afterA =
  817:         qslA.Evaluate(
  818:             "player.Curiosity");
  819: 
  820:     var afterB =
  821:         qslB.Evaluate(
  822:             "player.Curiosity");
  823: 
  824:     TestLog.Task(
  825:         "Verifying Runtime A no longer resolves the unbound consumer.");
  826: 
  827:     Assert.False(
  828:         afterA.Succeeded);
  829: 
  830:     TestLog.Pass(
  831:         "Runtime A consumer binding was removed.");
  832: 
  833:     TestLog.Task(
  834:         "Verifying Runtime B still resolves its independent player alias.");
  835: 
  836:     Assert.True(
  837:         afterB.Succeeded);
  838: 
  839:     Assert.Equal(
  840:         22.0,
  841:         Convert.ToDouble(
  842:             afterB.Value),
  843:         10);
  844: 
  845:     Assert.Same(
  846:         playerB,
  847:         bindingB.Value);
  848: 
  849:     Assert.Equal(
  850:         80.0,
  851:         playerB.Health,
  852:         10);
  853: 
  854:     TestLog.Pass(
  855:         "Runtime B same-name consumer remained bound.");
  856: 
  857:     TestLog.Task(
  858:         "Verifying Runtime A unbind retired attached state for the exact object.");
  859: 
  860:     /*
  861:      * Rebinding the exact object must not resurrect
  862:      * the attached Curiosity state that UnbindConsumer
  863:      * retired.
  864:      */
  865:     qslA.BindConsumer(
  866:         bindingA);
  867: 
  868:     var reboundA =
  869:         qslA.Evaluate(
  870:             "player.Curiosity");
  871: 
  872:     Assert.False(
  873:         reboundA.Succeeded);
  874: 
  875:     /*
  876:      * Runtime B must still retain its own attached state.
  877:      */
  878:     var stillBoundB =
  879:         qslB.Evaluate(
  880:             "player.Curiosity");
  881: 
  882:     Assert.True(
  883:         stillBoundB.Succeeded);
  884: 
  885:     Assert.Equal(
  886:         22.0,
  887:         Convert.ToDouble(
  888:             stillBoundB.Value),
  889:         10);
  890: 
  891:     TestLog.Pass(
  892:         "Unbinding retired only Runtime A attached state.");
  893: 
  894:     TestLog.Pass(
  895:         "Runtime B attached state remained intact.");
  896: 
  897:     TestLog.Pass(
  898:         "QSL consumer-unbind isolation certification completed successfully.");
  899: }

   18:     [Fact]
   19:     public async Task
   20:         ConcurrentTerminalTransitionsProduceExactlyOneWinner()
   21:     {
   22:         TestLog.Section(
   23:             "WORKUNIT TERMINAL-STATE RACE");
   24: 
   25:         TestLog.Test(
   26:             "Concurrent complete, fail, and cancel attempts produce exactly one winner.");
   27: 
   28:         var completedWins =
   29:             0;
   30: 
   31:         var failedWins =
   32:             0;
   33: 
   34:         var cancelledWins =
   35:             0;
   36: 
   37:         for (var iteration = 0;
   38:              iteration < RaceIterations;
   39:              iteration++)
   40:         {
   41:             var pulse =
   42:                 CreateProcessingPulse(
   43:                     $"terminal-race-{iteration:D4}");
   44: 
   45:             var work =
   46:                 CreateProcessingWork(
   47:                     pulse,
   48:                     $"terminal-work-{iteration:D4}");
   49: 
   50:             var completionResult =
   51:                 new TestRuntimeObject(
   52:                     $"completion-result-{iteration:D4}");
   53: 
   54:             var failure =
   55:                 new ExpectedRaceException(
   56:                     $"Expected race failure {iteration:D4}.");
   57: 
   58:             using var start =
   59:                 new ManualResetEventSlim(
   60:                     false);
   61: 
   62:             var completeAttempt =
   63:                 Task.Run(
   64:                     () =>
   65:                     {
   66:                         start.Wait();
   67: 
   68:                         return work.TryComplete(
   69:                             completionResult);
   70:                     });
   71: 
   72:             var failAttempt =
   73:                 Task.Run(
   74:                     () =>
   75:                     {
   76:                         start.Wait();
   77: 
   78:                         return work.TryFail(
   79:                             failure);
   80:                     });
   81: 
   82:             var cancelAttempt =
   83:                 Task.Run(
   84:                     () =>
   85:                     {
   86:                         start.Wait();
   87: 
   88:                         return work.TryCancel();
   89:                     });
   90: 
   91:             start.Set();
   92: 
   93:             var transitions =
   94:                 await Task.WhenAll(
   95:                         completeAttempt,
   96:                         failAttempt,
   97:                         cancelAttempt)
   98:                     .ConfigureAwait(false);
   99: 
  100:             Assert.Equal(
  101:                 1,
  102:                 transitions.Count(
  103:                     transition =>
  104:                         transition));
  105: 
  106:             Assert.True(
  107:                 work.IsTerminal);
  108: 
  109:             switch (work.Status)
  110:             {
  111:                 case WorkUnitStatus.Completed:
  112:                     completedWins++;
  113: 
  114:                     Assert.True(
  115:                         transitions[0]);
  116: 
  117:                     Assert.Same(
  118:                         completionResult,
  119:                         work.Result);
  120: 
  121:                     Assert.Null(
  122:                         work.Exception);
  123: 
  124:                     break;
  125: 
  126:                 case WorkUnitStatus.Failed:
  127:                     failedWins++;
  128: 
  129:                     Assert.True(
  130:                         transitions[1]);
  131: 
  132:                     Assert.Null(
  133:                         work.Result);
  134: 
  135:                     Assert.Same(
  136:                         failure,
  137:                         work.Exception);
  138: 
  139:                     break;
  140: 
  141:                 case WorkUnitStatus.Cancelled:
  142:                     cancelledWins++;
  143: 
  144:                     Assert.True(
  145:                         transitions[2]);
  146: 
  147:                     Assert.Null(
  148:                         work.Result);
  149: 
  150:                     Assert.Null(
  151:                         work.Exception);
  152: 
  153:                     break;
  154: 
  155:                 default:
  156:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  157:                         "The WorkUnit did not retain a valid " +
  158:                         "terminal status after the race.");
  159:             }
  160: 
  161:             Assert.False(
  162:                 work.TryComplete(
  163:                     new TestRuntimeObject(
  164:                         "must-not-replace-result")));
  165: 
  166:             Assert.False(
  167:                 work.TryFail(
  168:                     new ExpectedRaceException(
  169:                         "must-not-replace-failure")));
  170: 
  171:             Assert.False(
  172:                 work.TryCancel());
  173:         }
  174: 
  175:         TestLog.State(
  176:             $"Iterations = {RaceIterations}");
  177: 
  178:         TestLog.State(
  179:             $"Completed winners = {completedWins}");
  180: 
  181:         TestLog.State(
  182:             $"Failed winners = {failedWins}");
  183: 
  184:         TestLog.State(
  185:             $"Cancelled winners = {cancelledWins}");
  186: 
  187:         TestLog.State(
  188:             "Total winners = " +
  189:             (completedWins +
  190:              failedWins +
  191:              cancelledWins));
  192: 
  193:         Assert.Equal(
  194:             RaceIterations,
  195:             completedWins +
  196:             failedWins +
  197:             cancelledWins);
  198: 
  199:         TestLog.Pass(
  200:             "Every terminal-state race produced exactly one authoritative winner.");
  201: 
  202:         TestLog.Pass(
  203:             "Winning WorkUnit state remained internally consistent.");
  204: 
  205:         TestLog.Pass(
  206:             "All later terminal transitions were rejected.");
  207:     }

  402:     [InlineData(false)]
  403:     [InlineData(true)]
  404:     public void
  405:         MixedTerminalOutcomePrecedenceIsIndependentOfRegistrationOrder(
  406:             bool reverseRegistrationOrder)
  407:     {
  408:         TestLog.Section(
  409:             "PULSE MIXED-OUTCOME PRECEDENCE");
  410: 
  411:         TestLog.Test(
  412:             "Failure precedence is independent of WorkUnit registration order.");
  413: 
  414:         var pulse =
  415:             CreateProcessingPulse(
  416:                 reverseRegistrationOrder
  417:                     ? "mixed-order-reversed"
  418:                     : "mixed-order-forward");
  419: 
  420:         var completed =
  421:             CreateProcessingWork(
  422:                 pulse,
  423:                 "completed-work");
  424: 
  425:         var failed =
  426:             CreateProcessingWork(
  427:                 pulse,
  428:                 "failed-work");
  429: 
  430:         var cancelled =
  431:             CreateProcessingWork(
  432:                 pulse,
  433:                 "cancelled-work");
  434: 
  435:         var completedResult =
  436:             new TestRuntimeObject(
  437:                 "completed-result");
  438: 
  439:         var finalResult =
  440:             new TestRuntimeObject(
  441:                 "must-not-be-used-as-final-result");
  442: 
  443:         var failure =
  444:             new ExpectedRaceException(
  445:                 "Authoritative mixed-outcome failure.");
  446: 
  447:         Assert.True(
  448:             completed.TryComplete(
  449:                 completedResult));
  450: 
  451:         Assert.True(
  452:             failed.TryFail(
  453:                 failure));
  454: 
  455:         Assert.True(
  456:             cancelled.TryCancel());
  457: 
  458:         var coordinator =
  459:             new PulseCoordinator(
  460:                 pulse);
  461: 
  462:         if (reverseRegistrationOrder)
  463:         {
  464:             Assert.True(
  465:                 coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  466:                     cancelled));
  467: 
  468:             Assert.True(
  469:                 coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  470:                     failed));
  471: 
  472:             Assert.True(
  473:                 coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  474:                     completed));
  475:         }
  476:         else
  477:         {
  478:             Assert.True(
  479:                 coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  480:                     completed));
  481: 
  482:             Assert.True(
  483:                 coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  484:                     failed));
  485: 
  486:             Assert.True(
  487:                 coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  488:                     cancelled));
  489:         }
  490: 
  491:         Assert.Equal(
  492:             3,
  493:             coordinator.WorkUnitCount);
  494: 
  495:         Assert.False(
  496:             coordinator.CanResolve);
  497: 
  498:         Assert.True(
  499:             coordinator.CanFinalize);
  500: 
  501:         Assert.True(
  502:             coordinator.TryFinalize(
  503:                 finalResult,
  504:                 out var moment));
  505: 
  506:         Assert.NotNull(
  507:             moment);
  508: 
  509:         Assert.Equal(
  510:             MomentOutcome.Failed,
  511:             moment!.Outcome);
  512: 
  513:         Assert.Equal(
  514:             PulseStatus.Failed,
  515:             pulse.Status);
  516: 
  517:         Assert.Null(
  518:             moment.Result);
  519: 
  520:         Assert.Same(
  521:             failure,
  522:             moment.Exception);
  523: 
  524:         Assert.Equal(
  525:             3,
  526:             moment.WorkUnitIds.Count);
  527: 
  528:         Assert.Contains(
  529:             completed.Id,
  530:             moment.WorkUnitIds);
  531: 
  532:         Assert.Contains(
  533:             failed.Id,
  534:             moment.WorkUnitIds);
  535: 
  536:         Assert.Contains(
  537:             cancelled.Id,
  538:             moment.WorkUnitIds);
  539: 
  540:         TestLog.State(
  541:             reverseRegistrationOrder
  542:                 ? "Registration order = Cancelled, Failed, Completed"
  543:                 : "Registration order = Completed, Failed, Cancelled");
  544: 
  545:         TestLog.State(
  546:             $"Moment outcome = {moment.Outcome}");
  547: 
  548:         TestLog.State(
  549:             $"Pulse status = {pulse.Status}");
  550: 
  551:         TestLog.Pass(
  552:             "Failure remained authoritative regardless of registration order.");
  553:     }

  555:     [Fact]
  556: public async Task
  557:     RepeatedConcurrentTerminalTransitionsRemainRejected()
  558: {
  559:     const int contenderCount =
  560:         64;
  561: 
  562:     TestLog.Section(
  563:         "WORKUNIT TERMINAL REENTRY");
  564: 
  565:     TestLog.Test(
  566:         "Repeated concurrent terminal attempts cannot replace an established outcome.");
  567: 
  568:     var pulse =
  569:         CreateProcessingPulse(
  570:             "terminal-reentry");
  571: 
  572:     var work =
  573:         CreateProcessingWork(
  574:             pulse,
  575:             "terminal-reentry-work");
  576: 
  577:     var authoritativeResult =
  578:         new TestRuntimeObject(
  579:             "authoritative-result");
  580: 
  581:     Assert.True(
  582:         work.TryComplete(
  583:             authoritativeResult));
  584: 
  585:     Assert.Equal(
  586:         WorkUnitStatus.Completed,
  587:         work.Status);
  588: 
  589:     Assert.Same(
  590:         authoritativeResult,
  591:         work.Result);
  592: 
  593:     using var start =
  594:         new ManualResetEventSlim(
  595:             false);
  596: 
  597:     var attempts =
  598:         new Task<bool>[contenderCount];
  599: 
  600:     for (var index = 0;
  601:          index < contenderCount;
  602:          index++)
  603:     {
  604:         var contenderIndex =
  605:             index;
  606: 
  607:         attempts[index] =
  608:             Task.Run(
  609:                 () =>
  610:                 {
  611:                     start.Wait();
  612: 
  613:                     switch (contenderIndex % 3)
  614:                     {
  615:                         case 0:
  616:                             return work.TryComplete(
  617:                                 new TestRuntimeObject(
  618:                                     $"replacement-{contenderIndex:D3}"));
  619: 
  620:                         case 1:
  621:                             return work.TryFail(
  622:                                 new ExpectedRaceException(
  623:                                     $"replacement-{contenderIndex:D3}"));
  624: 
  625:                         default:
  626:                             return work.TryCancel();
  627:                     }
  628:                 });
  629:     }
  630: 
  631:     start.Set();
  632: 
  633:     bool[] results =
  634:         await Task.WhenAll(
  635:                 attempts)
  636:             .ConfigureAwait(false);
  637: 
  638:     Assert.Equal(
  639:         contenderCount,
  640:         results.Length);
  641: 
  642:     for (var index = 0;
  643:          index < results.Length;
  644:          index++)
  645:     {
  646:         Assert.False(
  647:             results[index]);
  648:     }
  649: 
  650:     Assert.Equal(
  651:         WorkUnitStatus.Completed,
  652:         work.Status);
  653: 
  654:     Assert.True(
  655:         work.IsTerminal);
  656: 
  657:     Assert.Same(
  658:         authoritativeResult,
  659:         work.Result);
  660: 
  661:     Assert.Null(
  662:         work.Exception);
  663: 
  664:     TestLog.State(
  665:         $"Rejected terminal reentry attempts = {results.Length}");
  666: 
  667:     TestLog.Pass(
  668:         "Concurrent terminal reentry could not replace the established result.");
  669: }

  671: [Theory]
  672: [InlineData(0, 1, 2)]
  673: [InlineData(0, 2, 1)]
  674: [InlineData(1, 0, 2)]
  675: [InlineData(1, 2, 0)]
  676: [InlineData(2, 0, 1)]
  677: [InlineData(2, 1, 0)]
  678: public void
  679:     MixedWorkUnitOutcomePrecedenceIsIndependentOfCompletionOrder(
  680:         int first,
  681:         int second,
  682:         int third)
  683: {
  684:     TestLog.Section(
  685:         "PULSE MIXED-OUTCOME COMPLETION ORDER");
  686: 
  687:     TestLog.Test(
  688:         "Failure precedence is independent of WorkUnit completion order.");
  689: 
  690:     var pulse =
  691:         CreateProcessingPulse(
  692:             $"completion-order-{first}-{second}-{third}");
  693: 
  694:     var completed =
  695:         CreateProcessingWork(
  696:             pulse,
  697:             "completed-work");
  698: 
  699:     var failed =
  700:         CreateProcessingWork(
  701:             pulse,
  702:             "failed-work");
  703: 
  704:     var cancelled =
  705:         CreateProcessingWork(
  706:             pulse,
  707:             "cancelled-work");
  708: 
  709:     var completedResult =
  710:         new TestRuntimeObject(
  711:             "completed-result");
  712: 
  713:     var finalResult =
  714:         new TestRuntimeObject(
  715:             "must-not-be-used-as-final-result");
  716: 
  717:     var failure =
  718:         new ExpectedRaceException(
  719:             "Authoritative completion-order failure.");
  720: 
  721:     var coordinator =
  722:         new PulseCoordinator(
  723:             pulse);
  724: 
  725:     /*
  726:      * Registration order remains fixed.
  727:      *
  728:      * Only terminal completion order changes.
  729:      *
  730:      * This isolates the contract being certified:
  731:      *
  732:      *     completion order must not affect
  733:      *     mixed-outcome precedence.
  734:      */
  735:     Assert.True(
  736:         coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  737:             completed));
  738: 
  739:     Assert.True(
  740:         coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  741:             failed));
  742: 
  743:     Assert.True(
  744:         coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  745:             cancelled));
  746: 
  747:     Assert.Equal(
  748:         3,
  749:         coordinator.WorkUnitCount);
  750: 
  751:     var order =
  752:         new[]
  753:         {
  754:             first,
  755:             second,
  756:             third
  757:         };
  758: 
  759:     for (var index = 0;
  760:          index < order.Length;
  761:          index++)
  762:     {
  763:         switch (order[index])
  764:         {
  765:             case 0:
  766:                 Assert.True(
  767:                     completed.TryComplete(
  768:                         completedResult));
  769: 
  770:                 TestLog.State(
  771:                     $"Terminal position {index + 1}: Completed");
  772: 
  773:                 break;
  774: 
  775:             case 1:
  776:                 Assert.True(
  777:                     failed.TryFail(
  778:                         failure));
  779: 
  780:                 TestLog.State(
  781:                     $"Terminal position {index + 1}: Failed");
  782: 
  783:                 break;
  784: 
  785:             case 2:
  786:                 Assert.True(
  787:                     cancelled.TryCancel());
  788: 
  789:                 TestLog.State(
  790:                     $"Terminal position {index + 1}: Cancelled");
  791: 
  792:                 break;
  793: 
  794:             default:
  795:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  796:                     "Unknown completion-order index.");
  797:         }
  798: 
  799:         /*
  800:          * Until every required WorkUnit is terminal,
  801:          * the Pulse must not finalize.
  802:          */
  803:         if (index < order.Length - 1)
  804:         {
  805:             Assert.False(
  806:                 coordinator.CanFinalize);
  807: 
  808:             Assert.False(
  809:                 coordinator.TryFinalize(
  810:                     finalResult,
  811:                     out var prematureMoment));
  812: 
  813:             Assert.Null(
  814:                 prematureMoment);
  815: 
  816:             Assert.Equal(
  817:                 PulseStatus.Processing,
  818:                 pulse.Status);
  819:         }
  820:     }
  821: 
  822:     Assert.Equal(
  823:         WorkUnitStatus.Completed,
  824:         completed.Status);
  825: 
  826:     Assert.Equal(
  827:         WorkUnitStatus.Failed,
  828:         failed.Status);
  829: 
  830:     Assert.Equal(
  831:         WorkUnitStatus.Cancelled,
  832:         cancelled.Status);
  833: 
  834:     Assert.True(
  835:         coordinator.CanFinalize);
  836: 
  837:     Assert.False(
  838:         coordinator.CanResolve);
  839: 
  840:     Assert.True(
  841:         coordinator.TryFinalize(
  842:             finalResult,
  843:             out var moment));
  844: 
  845:     Assert.NotNull(
  846:         moment);
  847: 
  848:     /*
  849:      * Failure must remain authoritative regardless
  850:      * of which WorkUnit reached its terminal state
  851:      * first, second, or third.
  852:      */
  853:     Assert.Equal(
  854:         MomentOutcome.Failed,
  855:         moment!.Outcome);
  856: 
  857:     Assert.Equal(
  858:         PulseStatus.Failed,
  859:         pulse.Status);
  860: 
  861:     Assert.True(
  862:         pulse.IsTerminal);
  863: 
  864:     Assert.Null(
  865:         moment.Result);
  866: 
  867:     Assert.Same(
  868:         failure,
  869:         moment.Exception);
  870: 
  871:     Assert.Equal(
  872:         pulse.Id,
  873:         moment.PulseId);
  874: 
  875:     Assert.Equal(
  876:         3,
  877:         moment.WorkUnitIds.Count);
  878: 
  879:     Assert.Contains(
  880:         completed.Id,
  881:         moment.WorkUnitIds);
  882: 
  883:     Assert.Contains(
  884:         failed.Id,
  885:         moment.WorkUnitIds);
  886: 
  887:     Assert.Contains(
  888:         cancelled.Id,
  889:         moment.WorkUnitIds);
  890: 
  891:     /*
  892:      * Verify subordinate successful work has not
  893:      * contaminated the authoritative failed Moment.
  894:      */
  895:     Assert.Same(
  896:         completedResult,
  897:         completed.Result);
  898: 
  899:     Assert.Null(
  900:         completed.Exception);
  901: 
  902:     Assert.Null(
  903:         failed.Result);
  904: 
  905:     Assert.Same(
  906:         failure,
  907:         failed.Exception);
  908: 
  909:     Assert.Null(
  910:         cancelled.Result);
  911: 
  912:     Assert.Null(
  913:         cancelled.Exception);
  914: 
  915:     /*
  916:      * Finalization must remain single-shot.
  917:      */
  918:     Assert.False(
  919:         coordinator.TryFinalize(
  920:             new object(),
  921:             out var duplicateMoment));
  922: 
  923:     Assert.Null(
  924:         duplicateMoment);
  925: 
  926:     TestLog.State(
  927:         $"Completion order = " +
  928:         $"{DescribeOutcome(first)} -> " +
  929:         $"{DescribeOutcome(second)} -> " +
  930:         $"{DescribeOutcome(third)}");
  931: 
  932:     TestLog.State(
  933:         $"Moment outcome = {moment.Outcome}");
  934: 
  935:     TestLog.State(
  936:         $"Pulse status = {pulse.Status}");
  937: 
  938:     TestLog.Pass(
  939:         "Failure remained authoritative regardless of completion order.");
  940: }
  941: 
  942:     private static Pulse CreateProcessingPulse(
  943:         object? request)
  944:     {
  945:         var pulse =
  946:             new Pulse(
  947:                 request);
  948: 
  949:         Assert.True(
  950:             pulse.TryBeginDecomposition());
  951: 
  952:         Assert.True(
  953:             pulse.TryMarkPending());
  954: 
  955:         Assert.True(
  956:             pulse.TryMarkReady());
  957: 
  958:         Assert.True(
  959:             pulse.TryBeginProcessing());
  960: 
  961:         return pulse;
  962:     }
  963: 
  964:     private static WorkUnit CreateProcessingWork(
  965:         Pulse pulse,
  966:         object? payload)
  967:     {
  968:         var work =
  969:             new WorkUnit(
  970:                 pulse.Id,
  971:                 payload);
  972: 
  973:         Assert.True(
  974:             work.TryMarkPending());
  975: 
  976:         Assert.True(
  977:             work.TryBeginProcessing());
  978: 
  979:         return work;
  980:     }
  981: 
  982:     private sealed class TestRuntimeObject
  983:     {
  984:         public TestRuntimeObject(
  985:             string name)
  986:         {
  987:             Name =
  988:                 name;
  989:         }
  990: 
  991:         public string Name { get; }
  992:     }
  993:     
  994:     private static string DescribeOutcome(
  995:         int outcome)
  996:     {
  997:         return outcome switch
  998:         {
  999:             0 => "Completed",
 1000:             1 => "Failed",
 1001:             2 => "Cancelled",
 1002: 
 1003:             _ =>
 1004:                 throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
 1005:                     nameof(outcome))
 1006:         };
 1007:     }

############################################################
FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Abstractions\Base\NeighborDistance.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: 
    3: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Topology
    4: {
    5:     /// <summary>
    6:     /// Defines the canonical Wilds rules for relational distance.
    7:     ///
    8:     /// Distance is abstract and does not imply a physical
    9:     /// unit of measurement.
   10:     /// </summary>
   11:     public static class NeighborDistance
   12:     {
   13:         public static bool IsValid(
   14:             double distance)
   15:         {
   16:             return
   17:                 !double.IsNaN(distance) &&
   18:                 !double.IsInfinity(distance) &&
   19:                 distance >= 0d;
   20:         }
   21: 
   22:         public static double Validate(
   23:             double distance,
   24:             string parameterName)
   25:         {
   26:             if (!IsValid(distance))
   27:             {
   28:                 throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
   29:                     parameterName,
   30:                     distance,
   31:                     "Neighbor distance must be finite and non-negative.");
   32:             }
   33: 
   34:             return distance;
   35:         }
   36: 
   37:         public static bool IsAdjacent(
   38:             double distance)
   39:         {
   40:             return
   41:                 Validate(
   42:                     distance,
   43:                     nameof(distance)) == 1d;
   44:         }
   45:     }
   46: }

FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Abstractions\Pooling\ObjectLease.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Threading;
    3: 
    4: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions
    5: {
    6:     /// <summary>
    7:     /// Represents temporary ownership of an object rented from a pool.
    8:     /// Disposing the lease returns the object to its originating pool.
    9:     /// </summary>
   10:     public sealed class ObjectLease<T> : IDisposable
   11:         where T : class
   12:     {
   13:         private IObjectPool<T>? _pool;
   14:         private T? _instance;
   15: 
   16:         internal ObjectLease(
   17:             IObjectPool<T> pool,
   18:             T instance)
   19:         {
   20:             _pool = pool ??
   21:                     throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(pool));
   22: 
   23:             _instance = instance ??
   24:                         throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(instance));
   25:         }
   26: 
   27:         public T Instance
   28:         {
   29:             get
   30:             {
   31:                 return _instance ??
   32:                        throw new ObjectDisposedException(
   33:                            nameof(ObjectLease<T>));
   34:             }
   35:         }
   36: 
   37:         public void Dispose()
   38:         {
   39:             var instance =
   40:                 Interlocked.Exchange(
   41:                     ref _instance,
   42:                     null);
   43: 
   44:             var pool =
   45:                 Interlocked.Exchange(
   46:                     ref _pool,
   47:                     null);
   48: 
   49:             if (instance == null || pool == null)
   50:                 return;
   51: 
   52:             pool.Return(instance);
   53:         }
   54:     }
   55: }

############################################################
FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Abstractions\Pooling\ObjectPool.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Concurrent;
    3: using System.Threading;
    4: using System.Threading.Tasks;
    5: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    6: 
    7: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Pooling
    8: {
    9:     /// <summary>
   10:     /// Thread-safe object pool with bounded retention
   11:     /// and bounded concurrent leasing.
   12:     /// </summary>
   13:     public class ObjectPool<T> :
   14:         IObjectPool<T>,
   15:         IDisposable
   16:         where T : class
   17:     {
   18:         private readonly ConcurrentQueue<T> _available =
   19:             new ConcurrentQueue<T>();
   20: 
   21:         private readonly Func<T> _factory;
   22: 
   23:         private readonly SemaphoreSlim _concurrencyGate;
   24: 
   25:         private int _availableCount;
   26:         private int _createdCount;
   27:         private int _activeCount;
   28:         private int _disposed;
   29: 
   30:         public ObjectPool(
   31:             Func<T> factory,
   32:             int maximumRetained,
   33:             int maximumConcurrent)
   34:         {
   35:             _factory = factory ??
   36:                        throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(factory));
   37: 
   38:             if (maximumRetained < 0)
   39:             {
   40:                 throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
   41:                     nameof(maximumRetained));
   42:             }
   43: 
   44:             if (maximumConcurrent <= 0)
   45:             {
   46:                 throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
   47:                     nameof(maximumConcurrent));
   48:             }
   49: 
   50:             MaximumRetained = maximumRetained;
   51:             MaximumConcurrent = maximumConcurrent;
   52: 
   53:             _concurrencyGate = new SemaphoreSlim(
   54:                 maximumConcurrent,
   55:                 maximumConcurrent);
   56:         }
   57: 
   58:         public int AvailableCount =>
   59:             Volatile.Read(ref _availableCount);
   60: 
   61:         public int CreatedCount =>
   62:             Volatile.Read(ref _createdCount);
   63: 
   64:         public int ActiveCount =>
   65:             Volatile.Read(ref _activeCount);
   66: 
   67:         public int MaximumRetained { get; }
   68: 
   69:         public int MaximumConcurrent { get; }
   70: 
   71:         public ObjectLease<T> Rent()
   72:         {
   73:             ThrowIfDisposed();
   74: 
   75:             _concurrencyGate.Wait();
   76: 
   77:             try
   78:             {
   79:                 // The pool may have been disposed while waiting.
   80:                 ThrowIfDisposed();
   81: 
   82:                 return CreateLease();
   83:             }
   84:             catch
   85:             {
   86:                 _concurrencyGate.Release();
   87: 
   88:                 throw;
   89:             }
   90:         }
   91: 
   92:         public async ValueTask<ObjectLease<T>> RentAsync(
   93:             CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
   94:         {
   95:             ThrowIfDisposed();
   96: 
   97:             await _concurrencyGate
   98:                 .WaitAsync(cancellationToken)
   99:                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
  100: 
  101:             try
  102:             {
  103:                 // The pool may have been disposed while waiting.
  104:                 ThrowIfDisposed();
  105: 
  106:                 return CreateLease();
  107:             }
  108:             catch
  109:             {
  110:                 _concurrencyGate.Release();
  111: 
  112:                 throw;
  113:             }
  114:         }
  115: 
  116:         public bool Return(T instance)
  117:         {
  118:             if (instance == null)
  119:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(instance));
  120: 
  121:             var remainingActive =
  122:                 Interlocked.Decrement(ref _activeCount);
  123: 
  124:             if (remainingActive < 0)
  125:             {
  126:                 Interlocked.Increment(ref _activeCount);
  127: 
  128:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  129:                     "An object was returned without an active lease.");
  130:             }
  131: 
  132:             try
  133:             {
  134:                 if (Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) != 0)
  135:                 {
  136:                     DisposeInstance(instance);
  137: 
  138:                     return false;
  139:                 }
  140: 
  141:                 try
  142:                 {
  143:                     if (instance is
  144:                         IResettablePoolObject
  145:                         resettable)
  146:                     {
  147:                         if (!resettable.TryReset())
  148:                         {
  149:                             DisposeInstance(instance);
  150: 
  151:                             return false;
  152:                         }
  153:                     }
  154:                 }
  155:                 catch
  156:                 {
  157:                     DisposeInstance(instance);
  158: 
  159:                     throw;
  160:                 }
  161: 
  162:                 var retained =
  163:                     TryRetain(instance);
  164: 
  165:                 if (!retained)
  166:                     DisposeInstance(instance);
  167: 
  168:                 return retained;
  169:             }
  170:             finally
  171:             {
  172:                 _concurrencyGate.Release();
  173:             }
  174:         }
  175: 
  176:         public void Dispose()
  177:         {
  178:             if (Interlocked.Exchange(
  179:                     ref _disposed,
  180:                     1) != 0)
  181:             {
  182:                 return;
  183:             }
  184: 
  185:             while (_available.TryDequeue(out var instance))
  186:             {
  187:                 Interlocked.Decrement(
  188:                     ref _availableCount);
  189: 
  190:                 DisposeInstance(instance);
  191:             }
  192: 
  193:             // Intentionally do not dispose the semaphore here.
  194:             // Active leases and waiting renters may still need
  195:             // to interact with it while observing pool disposal.
  196:         }
  197: 
  198:         private ObjectLease<T>
  199:             CreateLease()
  200:         {
  201:             T instance;
  202: 
  203:             if (_available.TryDequeue(out var pooled))
  204:             {
  205:                 Interlocked.Decrement(
  206:                     ref _availableCount);
  207: 
  208:                 instance = pooled;
  209:             }
  210:             else
  211:             {
  212:                 instance = _factory();
  213: 
  214:                 if (instance == null)
  215:                 {
  216:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  217:                         "The object pool factory returned null.");
  218:                 }
  219: 
  220:                 Interlocked.Increment(
  221:                     ref _createdCount);
  222:             }
  223: 
  224:             Interlocked.Increment(
  225:                 ref _activeCount);
  226: 
  227:             return new ObjectLease<T>(
  228:                 this,
  229:                 instance);
  230:         }
  231: 
  232:         private bool TryRetain(T instance)
  233:         {
  234:             while (true)
  235:             {
  236:                 if (Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) != 0)
  237:                     return false;
  238: 
  239:                 var available =
  240:                     Volatile.Read(ref _availableCount);
  241: 
  242:                 if (available >= MaximumRetained)
  243:                     return false;
  244: 
  245:                 if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(
  246:                         ref _availableCount,
  247:                         available + 1,
  248:                         available) != available)
  249:                 {
  250:                     continue;
  251:                 }
  252: 
  253:                 if (Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) != 0)
  254:                 {
  255:                     Interlocked.Decrement(
  256:                         ref _availableCount);
  257: 
  258:                     return false;
  259:                 }
  260: 
  261:                 _available.Enqueue(instance);
  262: 
  263:                 return true;
  264:             }
  265:         }
  266: 
  267:         private static void DisposeInstance(
  268:             T instance)
  269:         {
  270:             if (instance is IDisposable disposable)
  271:                 disposable.Dispose();
  272:         }
  273: 
  274:         private void ThrowIfDisposed()
  275:         {
  276:             if (Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) != 0)
  277:             {
  278:                 throw new ObjectDisposedException(
  279:                     nameof(ObjectPool<T>));
  280:             }
  281:         }
  282:     }
  283: }

    3:     /// <summary>
    4:     /// Describes the lifecycle of one internal piece of work
    5:     /// required to resolve a pulse.
    6:     /// </summary>
    7:     public enum WorkUnitStatus
    8:     {
    9:         Created = 0,
   10:         Pending,
   11:         Processing,
   12:         Completed,
   13:         Failed,
   14:         Cancelled
   15:     }
   16: }

    1: using System;

    8: 
    9:         public static bool Enabled { get; set; } = true;
   10: 
   11:         public static void Info(string message)

   13:             Write("INFO", message);
   14:         }
   15: 
   16:         public static void Process(string message)
   17:         {
   18:             Write("PROCESS", message);
   19:         }
   20: 
   21:         public static void State(string message)
   22:         {
   23:             Write("STATE", message);
   24:         }
   25: 
   26:         public static void Warning(string message)
   27:         {
   28:             Write("WARN", message);
   29:         }
   30: 
   31:         public static void Error(string message)
   32:         {
   33:             Write("ERROR", message);
   34:         }
   35: 
   36:         private static void Write(
   37:             string category,
   38:             string message)
   39:         {
   40:             if (!Enabled)
   41:                 return;
   42: 
   43:             var formatted =
   44:                 $"[Wilds:{category}] {message}";
   45: 
   46:             if (Writer != null)
   47:             {
   48:                 Writer(formatted);
   49:                 return;
   50:             }
   51: 
   52:             Console.WriteLine(formatted);
   53:         }
   54:     }

FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Engines\WildsEngine.cs
