   55:                 $"Iterations: {Iterations}{Environment.NewLine}" +
   56:                 $"Direct duration: {DirectDuration.TotalMilliseconds:F3} ms{Environment.NewLine}" +
   57:                 $"Pooled duration: {PooledDuration.TotalMilliseconds:F3} ms{Environment.NewLine}" +
   58:                 allocations +
   59:                 $"Pooled processors created: {PooledInstancesCreated}";
   60:         }
   61:     }

FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Processing\Coordinator\PulseCoordinator.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using System.Linq;
    4: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    5: using WildsEngine.Core.Units;
    6: 
    7: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Processing.Coordinator
    8: {
    9:     /// <summary>
   10:     /// Coordinates all required WorkUnits for one Pulse.
   11:     ///
   12:     /// The coordinator prevents early completion and records
   13:     /// successful, failed, and cancelled Pulse outcomes.
   14:     /// </summary>
   15:     public sealed class PulseCoordinator :
   16:         IPulseCoordinator
   17:     {
   18:         private readonly object _sync =
   19:             new object();
   20: 
   21:         private readonly List<IWorkUnit> _workUnits =
   22:             new List<IWorkUnit>();
   23: 
   24:         private readonly HashSet<Guid> _workUnitIds =
   25:             new HashSet<Guid>();
   26: 
   27:         public PulseCoordinator(
   28:             IPulse pulse)
   29:         {
   30:             Pulse = pulse ??
   31:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   32:                     nameof(pulse));
   33:         }
   34: 
   35:         public IPulse Pulse { get; }
   36: 
   37:         public int WorkUnitCount
   38:         {
   39:             get
   40:             {
   41:                 lock (_sync)
   42:                 {
   43:                     return _workUnits.Count;
   44:                 }
   45:             }
   46:         }
   47: 
   48:         public IReadOnlyList<IWorkUnit> WorkUnits
   49:         {
   50:             get
   51:             {
   52:                 lock (_sync)
   53:                 {
   54:                     return _workUnits.ToArray();
   55:                 }
   56:             }
   57:         }
   58: 
   59:         public bool CanResolve
   60:         {
   61:             get
   62:             {
   63:                 lock (_sync)
   64:                 {
   65:                     return CanResolveCore();
   66:                 }
   67:             }
   68:         }
   69: 
   70:         public bool CanFinalize
   71:         {
   72:             get
   73:             {
   74:                 lock (_sync)
   75:                 {
   76:                     return CanFinalizeCore();
   77:                 }
   78:             }
   79:         }
   80: 
   81:         public bool AddWorkUnit(
   82:             IWorkUnit workUnit)
   83:         {
   84:             if (workUnit == null)
   85:             {
   86:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   87:                     nameof(workUnit));
   88:             }
   89: 
   90:             if (workUnit.PulseId != Pulse.Id)
   91:             {
   92:                 return false;
   93:             }
   94: 
   95:             lock (_sync)
   96:             {
   97:                 if (Pulse.IsTerminal)
   98:                 {
   99:                     return false;
  100:                 }
  101: 
  102:                 if (!_workUnitIds.Add(
  103:                         workUnit.Id))
  104:                 {
  105:                     return false;
  106:                 }
  107: 
  108:                 _workUnits.Add(
  109:                     workUnit);
  110: 
  111:                 return true;
  112:             }
  113:         }
  114: 
  115:         public bool TryResolve(
  116:             object? result,
  117:             out IMoment? moment)
  118:         {
  119:             lock (_sync)
  120:             {
  121:                 moment = null;
  122: 
  123:                 if (!CanResolveCore())
  124:                 {
  125:                     return false;
  126:                 }
  127: 
  128:                 return TryCreateCompletedMoment(
  129:                     result,
  130:                     out moment);
  131:             }
  132:         }
  133: 
  134:         public bool TryFinalize(
  135:             object? result,
  136:             out IMoment? moment)
  137:         {
  138:             lock (_sync)
  139:             {
  140:                 moment = null;
  141: 
  142:                 if (!CanFinalizeCore())
  143:                 {
  144:                     return false;
  145:                 }
  146: 
  147:                 var failedWork =
  148:                     GetFirstFailedWorkUnit();
  149: 
  150:                 if (failedWork != null)
  151:                 {
  152:                     return TryCreateFailedMoment(
  153:                         failedWork,
  154:                         out moment);
  155:                 }
  156: 
  157:                 if (ContainsCancelledWorkUnit())
  158:                 {
  159:                     return TryCreateCancelledMoment(
  160:                         out moment);
  161:                 }
  162: 
  163:                 return TryCreateCompletedMoment(
  164:                     result,
  165:                     out moment);
  166:             }
  167:         }
  168: 
  169:         private bool TryCreateCompletedMoment(
  170:             object? result,
  171:             out IMoment? moment)
  172:         {
  173:             moment = null;
  174: 
  175:             if (!CanResolveCore())
  176:             {
  177:                 return false;
  178:             }
  179: 
  180:             if (!Pulse.TryComplete())
  181:             {
  182:                 return false;
  183:             }
  184: 
  185:             moment =
  186:                 new Moment(
  187:                     Pulse.Id,
  188:                     MomentOutcome.Completed,
  189:                     result,
  190:                     null,
  191:                     GetWorkUnitIds());
  192: 
  193:             return true;
  194:         }
  195: 
  196:         private bool TryCreateFailedMoment(
  197:             IWorkUnit failedWork,
  198:             out IMoment? moment)
  199:         {
  200:             moment = null;
  201: 
  202:             var exception =
  203:                 failedWork.Exception;
  204: 
  205:             if (exception == null)
  206:             {
  207:                 return false;
  208:             }
  209: 
  210:             if (!Pulse.TryFail())
  211:             {
  212:                 return false;
  213:             }
  214: 
  215:             moment =
  216:                 new Moment(
  217:                     Pulse.Id,
  218:                     MomentOutcome.Failed,
  219:                     null,
  220:                     exception,
  221:                     GetWorkUnitIds());
  222: 
  223:             return true;
  224:         }
  225: 
  226:         private bool TryCreateCancelledMoment(
  227:             out IMoment? moment)
  228:         {
  229:             moment = null;
  230: 
  231:             if (!Pulse.TryCancel())
  232:             {
  233:                 return false;
  234:             }
  235: 
  236:             moment =
  237:                 new Moment(
  238:                     Pulse.Id,
  239:                     MomentOutcome.Cancelled,
  240:                     null,
  241:                     null,
  242:                     GetWorkUnitIds());
  243: 
  244:             return true;
  245:         }
  246: 
  247:         private bool CanResolveCore()
  248:         {
  249:             if (Pulse.Status !=
  250:                 PulseStatus.Processing)
  251:             {
  252:                 return false;
  253:             }
  254: 
  255:             if (_workUnits.Count == 0)
  256:             {
  257:                 return false;
  258:             }
  259: 
  260:             for (
  261:                 var index = 0;
  262:                 index < _workUnits.Count;
  263:                 index++)
  264:             {
  265:                 if (_workUnits[index].Status !=
  266:                     WorkUnitStatus.Completed)
  267:                 {
  268:                     return false;
  269:                 }
  270:             }
  271: 
  272:             return true;
  273:         }
  274: 
  275:         private bool CanFinalizeCore()
  276:         {
  277:             if (Pulse.Status !=
  278:                 PulseStatus.Processing)
  279:             {
  280:                 return false;
  281:             }
  282: 
  283:             if (_workUnits.Count == 0)
  284:             {
  285:                 return false;
  286:             }
  287: 
  288:             for (
  289:                 var index = 0;
  290:                 index < _workUnits.Count;
  291:                 index++)
  292:             {
  293:                 if (!_workUnits[index].IsTerminal)
  294:                 {
  295:                     return false;
  296:                 }
  297:             }
  298: 
  299:             return true;
  300:         }
  301: 
  302:         private IWorkUnit? GetFirstFailedWorkUnit()
  303:         {
  304:             for (
  305:                 var index = 0;
  306:                 index < _workUnits.Count;
  307:                 index++)
  308:             {
  309:                 var workUnit =
  310:                     _workUnits[index];
  311: 
  312:                 if (workUnit.Status ==
  313:                     WorkUnitStatus.Failed)
  314:                 {
  315:                     return workUnit;
  316:                 }
  317:             }
  318: 
  319:             return null;
  320:         }
  321: 
  322:         private bool ContainsCancelledWorkUnit()
  323:         {
  324:             for (
  325:                 var index = 0;
  326:                 index < _workUnits.Count;
  327:                 index++)
  328:             {
  329:                 if (_workUnits[index].Status ==
  330:                     WorkUnitStatus.Cancelled)
  331:                 {
  332:                     return true;
  333:                 }
  334:             }
  335: 
  336:             return false;
  337:         }
  338: 
  339:         private Guid[] GetWorkUnitIds()
  340:         {
  341:             return _workUnits
  342:                 .Select(
  343:                     workUnit =>
  344:                         workUnit.Id)
  345:                 .ToArray();
  346:         }
  347:     }
  348: }

############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;

    4: using WildsEngine.Core.Topology;
    5: 
    6: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Processing
    7: {
    8:     public sealed class AddNeighborInstruction :

   13: 
   14:         public AddNeighborInstruction(

    1: using System;
    2: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    3: 
    4: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Processing.Processor
    5: {
    6:     /// <summary>
    7:     /// Processes task work using a task registry.
    8:     /// Provides the task lifecycle boundary used by
    9:     /// pooled task processors.
   10:     /// </summary>
   11:     public class TaskProcessor :
   12:         ProcessorBase,
   13:         ITaskProcessor
   14:     {
   15:         public TaskProcessor(
   16:             IComponent component,
   17:             string layer,
   18:             ITaskRegistry registry)
   19:             : base(
   20:                 component,
   21:                 layer)
   22:         {
   23:             Registry = registry ??
   24:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   25:                     nameof(registry));
   26:         }
   27: 
   28:         public ITaskRegistry Registry { get; }
   29: 
   30:         /// <summary>
   31:         /// Parks a task for processing.
   32:         /// </summary>
   33:         public bool RegisterTask(
   34:             ITask task)
   35:         {
   36:             if (task == null)
   37:             {
   38:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   39:                     nameof(task));
   40:             }
   41: 
   42:             return Registry.Register(
   43:                 task);
   44:         }
   45: 
   46:         /// <summary>
   47:         /// Determines whether a task is currently parked.
   48:         /// </summary>
   49:         public bool ContainsTask(
   50:             Guid id)
   51:         {
   52:             return Registry.Contains(
   53:                 id);
   54:         }
   55: 
   56:         /// <summary>
   57:         /// Retrieves a parked task by identity.
   58:         /// </summary>
   59:         public ITask? GetTask(
   60:             Guid id)
   61:         {
   62:             return Registry.Get(
   63:                 id);
   64:         }
   65: 
   66:         /// <summary>
   67:         /// Attempts to retrieve a parked task by identity.
   68:         /// </summary>
   69:         public bool TryGetTask(
   70:             Guid id,
   71:             out ITask? task)
   72:         {
   73:             return Registry.TryGet(
   74:                 id,
   75:                 out task);
   76:         }
   77: 
   78:         /// <summary>
   79:         /// Removes a parked task after processing completes.
   80:         /// </summary>
   81:         public bool RemoveTask(
   82:             Guid id)
   83:         {
   84:             return Registry.Remove(
   85:                 id);
   86:         }
   87: 
   88:         /// <summary>
   89:         /// Clears transient processor state before this
   90:         /// processor is returned to its pool.
   91:         ///
   92:         /// Registry contents intentionally survive processor
   93:         /// reuse because task lifetime is independent from
   94:         /// processor lifetime.
   95:         /// </summary>
   96:         protected override bool OnReset()
   97:         {
   98:             return true;
   99:         }
  100:     }
  101: }

   50: 
   51:         public sealed override IComponent Component =>
   52:             _component;
   53: 
   54:         public IContext Context { get; }
   55: 
   56:         public abstract bool Process(
   57:             IStateInstruction instruction);
   58: 
   59:         /// <summary>
   60:         /// Processes Neighbor-topology instructions that are
   61:         /// common to all Wilds states.
   62:         ///
   63:         /// Concrete states should invoke this before handling
   64:         /// state-specific instruction types.
   65:         /// </summary>
   66:         protected bool TryProcessNeighborInstruction(
   67:             IStateInstruction instruction)
   68:         {
   69:             if (instruction == null)
   70:             {
   71:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   72:                     nameof(instruction));
   73:             }
   74: 
   75:             if (instruction is
   76:                 AddNeighborInstruction addNeighbor)
   77:             {
   78:                 return Component.Neighbors.Add(
   79:                     addNeighbor.Neighbor,
   80:                     addNeighbor.Membership,
   81:                     addNeighbor.Distance);
   82:             }
   83: 
   84:             if (instruction is
   85:                 RemoveNeighborInstruction removeNeighbor)
   86:             {
   87:                 return Component.Neighbors.Remove(
   88:                     removeNeighbor.NeighborId,
   89:                     removeNeighbor.Membership);
   90:             }
   91: 
   92:             if (instruction is
   93:                 SetNeighborDistanceInstruction setDistance)
   94:             {
   95:                 return Component.Neighbors.SetDistance(
   96:                     setDistance.NeighborId,
   97:                     setDistance.Membership,
   98:                     setDistance.Distance);
   99:             }
  100: 
  101:             return false;
  102:         }
  103:     }
  104: }

    2: using System.Collections.Generic;

    5: {
    6:     public sealed class NeighborClusterer : INeighborClusterer
    7:     {
    8:         public IReadOnlyList<INeighborCluster> FindClusters(IReadOnlyList<IBaseObject> objects,string membership)
    9:         {
   10:             if(objects==null)throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(objects));if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(membership))throw new ArgumentException("Membership cannot be empty.",nameof(membership));membership=membership.Trim();
   11:             var known=new Dictionary<Guid,IBaseObject>();for(var i=0;i<objects.Count;i++){var o=objects[i]??throw new ArgumentException("Objects cannot contain null.",nameof(objects));known[o.Id]=o;}var visited=new HashSet<Guid>();var clusters=new List<INeighborCluster>();
   12:             foreach(var pair in known){if(visited.Contains(pair.Key))continue;var members=new List<IBaseObject>();var queue=new Queue<IBaseObject>();queue.Enqueue(pair.Value);visited.Add(pair.Key);while(queue.Count>0){var current=queue.Dequeue();members.Add(current);foreach(var candidate in known.Values){if(visited.Contains(candidate.Id))continue;if(Connected(current,candidate,membership)){visited.Add(candidate.Id);queue.Enqueue(candidate);}}}members.Sort((a,b)=>a.Id.CompareTo(b.Id));clusters.Add(new NeighborCluster(membership,members.ToArray()));}

   14:         }

    6:     public sealed class NeighborTraversal : INeighborTraversal
    7:     {
    8:         public IReadOnlyList<IBaseObject> Traverse(IBaseObject origin,string membership,double maximumDistance)
    9:         {
   10:             if(origin==null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(origin)); membership=Normalize(membership); NeighborDistance.Validate(maximumDistance,nameof(maximumDistance));
   11:             var result=new List<IBaseObject>(); var best=new Dictionary<Guid,double>(); var queue=new List<Entry>(); best[origin.Id]=0d; queue.Add(new Entry(origin,0d));
   12:             while(queue.Count>0){var bestIndex=0;for(var i=1;i<queue.Count;i++)if(Compare(queue[i],queue[bestIndex])<0)bestIndex=i;var entry=queue[bestIndex];queue.RemoveAt(bestIndex);double known;if(!best.TryGetValue(entry.Object.Id,out known)||entry.Distance!=known)continue;if(entry.Object.Id!=origin.Id)result.Add(entry.Object);var rels=entry.Object.Neighbors.Relationships;for(var i=0;i<rels.Count;i++){var r=rels[i];if(!string.Equals(r.Membership,membership,StringComparison.Ordinal))continue;var next=entry.Distance+r.Distance;if(next>maximumDistance)continue;double old;if(best.TryGetValue(r.Neighbor.Id,out old)&&old<=next)continue;best[r.Neighbor.Id]=next;queue.Add(new Entry(r.Neighbor,next));}}

   14:         }
   15:         public bool IsReachable(IBaseObject origin,IBaseObject target,string membership,double maximumDistance){if(target==null)throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(target));if(origin!=null&&origin.Id==target.Id)return true;var nodes=Traverse(origin,membership,maximumDistance);for(var i=0;i<nodes.Count;i++)if(nodes[i].Id==target.Id)return true;return false;}

   78:                     pulseId);
   79: 
   80:             ValidateOutcome(
   81:                 outcome,
   82:                 exception);
   83: 
   84:             Outcome = outcome;
   85:             Result = result;
   86:             Exception = exception;
   87: 
   88:             _workUnitIds =
   89:                 CopyWorkUnitIds(
   90:                     workUnitIds);
   91:         }
   92:

  102:             _workUnitIds;

  104:         private static Guid ValidatePulseId(
  105:             Guid pulseId)
  106:         {
  107:             if (pulseId == Guid.Empty)
  108:             {
  109:                 throw new ArgumentException(
  110:                     "Moments require a non-empty Pulse ID.",
  111:                     nameof(pulseId));
  112:             }
  113: 
  114:             return pulseId;
  115:         }
  116: 
  117:         private static void ValidateOutcome(
  118:             MomentOutcome outcome,
  119:             Exception? exception)
  120:         {
  121:             if (outcome ==
  122:                 MomentOutcome.Failed &&
  123:                 exception == null)
  124:             {
  125:                 throw new ArgumentException(
  126:                     "Failed Moments require an exception.",
  127:                     nameof(exception));
  128:             }
  129: 
  130:             if (outcome !=
  131:                 MomentOutcome.Failed &&
  132:                 exception != null)
  133:             {
  134:                 throw new ArgumentException(
  135:                     "Only failed Moments may carry an exception.",
  136:                     nameof(exception));
  137:             }
  138:         }
  139: 
  140:         private static IReadOnlyList<Guid>
  141:             CopyWorkUnitIds(
  142:                 IEnumerable<Guid>? workUnitIds)
  143:         {
  144:             if (workUnitIds == null)
  145:             {
  146:                 return Array.Empty<Guid>();
  147:             }
  148: 
  149:             var copy =
  150:                 workUnitIds
  151:                     .Where(
  152:                         id => id != Guid.Empty)
  153:                     .Distinct()
  154:                     .ToArray();
  155: 
  156:             return copy.Length == 0
  157:                 ? Array.Empty<Guid>()
  158:                 : copy;
  159:         }
  160:     }

    1: using System;
    2: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    3: 
    4: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Units
    5: {
    6:     /// <summary>
    7:     /// Represents one complete consumer request.
    8:     ///
    9:     /// The pulse identity is the canonical correlation
   10:     /// identity for every work unit, instruction, task,
   11:     /// and eventual moment produced while resolving the
   12:     /// request.
   13:     /// </summary>
   14:     public sealed class Pulse :
   15:         BaseUnit,
   16:         IPulse
   17:     {
   18:         private readonly object _sync =
   19:             new object();
   20: 
   21:         private PulseStatus _status;
   22: 
   23:         public Pulse(
   24:             object? request)
   25:             : base()
   26:         {
   27:             Request = request;
   28: 
   29:             _status =
   30:                 PulseStatus.Created;
   31:         }
   32: 
   33:         public Pulse(
   34:             Guid id,
   35:             object? request)
   36:             : base(
   37:                 id)
   38:         {
   39:             Request = request;
   40: 
   41:             _status =
   42:                 PulseStatus.Created;
   43:         }
   44: 
   45:         public object? Request { get; }
   46: 
   47:         public PulseStatus Status
   48:         {
   49:             get
   50:             {
   51:                 lock (_sync)
   52:                 {
   53:                     return _status;
   54:                 }
   55:             }
   56:         }
   57: 
   58:         public bool IsTerminal
   59:         {
   60:             get
   61:             {
   62:                 lock (_sync)
   63:                 {
   64:                     return IsTerminalStatus(
   65:                         _status);
   66:                 }
   67:             }
   68:         }
   69: 
   70:         public bool TryBeginDecomposition()
   71:         {
   72:             return TryTransition(
   73:                 PulseStatus.Created,
   74:                 PulseStatus.Decomposing);
   75:         }
   76: 
   77:         public bool TryMarkPending()
   78:         {
   79:             return TryTransition(
   80:                 PulseStatus.Decomposing,
   81:                 PulseStatus.Pending);
   82:         }
   83: 
   84:         public bool TryMarkReady()
   85:         {
   86:             return TryTransition(
   87:                 PulseStatus.Pending,
   88:                 PulseStatus.Ready);
   89:         }
   90: 
   91:         public bool TryBeginProcessing()
   92:         {
   93:             return TryTransition(
   94:                 PulseStatus.Ready,
   95:                 PulseStatus.Processing);
   96:         }
   97: 
   98:         public bool TryComplete()
   99:         {
  100:             return TryTransition(
  101:                 PulseStatus.Processing,
  102:                 PulseStatus.Completed);
  103:         }
  104: 
  105:         public bool TryFail()
  106:         {
  107:             return TryTerminalTransition(
  108:                 PulseStatus.Failed);
  109:         }
  110: 
  111:         public bool TryCancel()
  112:         {
  113:             return TryTerminalTransition(
  114:                 PulseStatus.Cancelled);
  115:         }
  116: 
  117:         private bool TryTransition(
  118:             PulseStatus expected,
  119:             PulseStatus next)
  120:         {
  121:             lock (_sync)
  122:             {
  123:                 if (_status != expected)
  124:                 {
  125:                     return false;
  126:                 }
  127: 
  128:                 _status = next;
  129: 
  130:                 return true;
  131:             }
  132:         }
  133: 
  134:         private bool TryTerminalTransition(
  135:             PulseStatus terminalStatus)
  136:         {
  137:             lock (_sync)
  138:             {
  139:                 if (IsTerminalStatus(
  140:                         _status))
  141:                 {
  142:                     return false;
  143:                 }
  144: 
  145:                 _status = terminalStatus;
  146: 
  147:                 return true;
  148:             }
  149:         }
  150: 
  151:         private static bool IsTerminalStatus(
  152:             PulseStatus status)
  153:         {
  154:             return status ==
  155:                    PulseStatus.Completed ||
  156:                    status ==
  157:                    PulseStatus.Failed ||
  158:                    status ==
  159:                    PulseStatus.Cancelled;
  160:         }
  161:     }
  162: }

   74:             get
   75:             {
   76:                 lock (_sync)
   77:                 {
   78:                     return _result;
   79:                 }
   80:             }
   81:         }
   82: 
   83:         public Exception? Exception
   84:         {
   85:             get
   86:             {
   87:                 lock (_sync)
   88:                 {
   89:                     return _exception;
   90:                 }
   91:             }
   92:         }
   93: 
   94:         public bool IsTerminal
   95:         {
   96:             get
   97:             {
   98:                 lock (_sync)
   99:                 {
  100:                     return IsTerminalStatus(
  101:                         _status);
  102:                 }
  103:             }
  104:         }
  105: 
  106:         public bool TryMarkPending()
  107:         {
  108:             return TryTransition(
  109:                 WorkUnitStatus.Created,
  110:                 WorkUnitStatus.Pending);
  111:         }
  112: 
  113:         public bool TryBeginProcessing()
  114:         {
  115:             return TryTransition(
  116:                 WorkUnitStatus.Pending,
  117:                 WorkUnitStatus.Processing);
  118:         }
  119: 
  120:         public bool TryComplete(
  121:             object? result)
  122:         {
  123:             lock (_sync)
  124:             {
  125:                 if (_status !=
  126:                     WorkUnitStatus.Processing)
  127:                 {
  128:                     return false;
  129:                 }
  130: 
  131:                 _result = result;
  132:                 _exception = null;
  133: 
  134:                 _status =
  135:                     WorkUnitStatus.Completed;
  136: 
  137:                 return true;
  138:             }
  139:         }
  140: 
  141:         public bool TryFail(
  142:             Exception exception)
  143:         {
  144:             if (exception == null)
  145:             {
  146:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
  147:                     nameof(exception));
  148:             }
  149: 
  150:             lock (_sync)
  151:             {
  152:                 if (IsTerminalStatus(
  153:                         _status))
  154:                 {
  155:                     return false;
  156:                 }
  157: 
  158:                 _exception = exception;
  159: 
  160:                 _status =
  161:                     WorkUnitStatus.Failed;
  162: 
  163:                 return true;
  164:             }
  165:         }
  166: 
  167:         public bool TryCancel()
  168:         {
  169:             lock (_sync)
  170:             {
  171:                 if (IsTerminalStatus(
  172:                         _status))
  173:                 {
  174:                     return false;
  175:                 }
  176: 
  177:                 _status =
  178:                     WorkUnitStatus.Cancelled;
  179: 
  180:                 return true;
  181:             }
  182:         }
  183: 
  184:         private bool TryTransition(
  185:             WorkUnitStatus expected,
  186:             WorkUnitStatus next)
  187:         {
  188:             lock (_sync)
  189:             {
  190:                 if (_status != expected)
  191:                 {
  192:                     return false;
  193:                 }
  194: 
  195:                 _status = next;
  196: 
  197:                 return true;
  198:             }
  199:         }
  200: 
  201:         private static Guid ValidatePulseId(
  202:             Guid pulseId)
  203:         {
  204:             if (pulseId == Guid.Empty)
  205:             {
  206:                 throw new ArgumentException(
  207:                     "Work units require a non-empty pulse ID.",
  208:                     nameof(pulseId));
  209:             }
  210: 
  211:             return pulseId;
  212:         }
  213: 
  214:         private static bool IsTerminalStatus(
  215:             WorkUnitStatus status)
  216:         {
  217:             return status ==
  218:                    WorkUnitStatus.Completed ||
  219:                    status ==
  220:                    WorkUnitStatus.Failed ||
  221:                    status ==
  222:                    WorkUnitStatus.Cancelled;
  223:         }
  224:     }
  225: }

FILE: WildsEngine.Qsl\WildsQslExecutionException.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using QSL.Core;
    3: 
    4: namespace WildsEngine.Qsl
    5: {
    6:     /// <summary>
    7:     /// Represents an unsuccessful QSL processing result
    8:     /// encountered while resolving a Wilds WorkUnit.
    9:     ///
   10:     /// Throwing this exception allows WildsEngine to record
   11:     /// the QSL failure as a failed WorkUnit, failed Pulse,
   12:     /// and failed Moment.
   13:     /// </summary>
   14:     public sealed class WildsQslExecutionException :
   15:         Exception
   16:     {
   17:         public WildsQslExecutionException(
   18:             QslProcessingResult result)
   19:             : base(
   20:                 CreateMessage(
   21:                     result),
   22:                 result != null
   23:                     ? result.Exception
   24:                     : null)
   25:         {
   26:             Result = result ??
   27:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   28:                     nameof(result));
   29:         }
   30: 
   31:         public QslProcessingResult Result { get; }
   32: 
   33:         private static string CreateMessage(
   34:             QslProcessingResult result)
   35:         {
   36:             if (result == null)
   37:             {
   38:                 return "QSL processing failed without a result.";
   39:             }
   40: 
   41:             if (result.HasException &&
   42:                 result.Exception != null)
   43:             {
   44:                 return
   45:                     "QSL processing raised an exception: " +
   46:                     result.Exception.Message;
   47:             }
   48: 
   49:             if (result.ParseFailed)
   50:             {
   51:                 return
   52:                     "QSL parsing failed with " +
   53:                     result.ParserDiagnostics.Count +
   54:                     " diagnostic(s).";
   55:             }
   56: 
   57:             if (result.EvaluationFailed)
   58:             {
   59:                 return
   60:                     "QSL evaluation failed with " +
   61:                     result.RuntimeDiagnostics.Count +
   62:                     " runtime diagnostic(s).";
   63:             }
   64: 
   65:             return "QSL processing did not succeed.";
   66:         }
   67:     }
   68: }

FILE: WildsEngine.Qsl\WildsQslExecutor.cs

    1: using System;
    2: using System.Threading;
    3: using System.Threading.Tasks;
    4: using QSL.Core;
    5: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    6: 
    7: namespace WildsEngine.Qsl
    8: {
    9:     /// <summary>
   10:     /// Executes QSL requests through the complete
   11:     /// WildsEngine request lifecycle.
   12:     ///
   13:     /// request
   14:     ///     -> Pulse
   15:     ///     -> WorkUnit
   16:     ///     -> QSL preparation
   17:     ///     -> QSL evaluation
   18:     ///     -> Moment
   19:     ///     -> Timeline
   20:     ///     -> Epoch
   21:     ///
   22:     /// Wilds owns the processing and temporal lifecycle.
   23:     /// QSL owns consumer binding, attached state,
   24:     /// language evaluation, diagnostics, and provenance.
   25:     /// </summary>
   26:     public sealed class WildsQslExecutor
   27:     {
   28:         private readonly QslEngine _qsl;
   29: 
   30:         private readonly Core.WildsEngine _wilds;
   31: 
   32:         public WildsQslExecutor(
   33:             QslEngine qsl,
   34:             Core.WildsEngine wilds)
   35:         {
   36:             _qsl =
   37:                 qsl
   38:                 ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(
   39:                     nameof(qsl));
   40: 
   41:             _wilds =
   42:                 wilds
   43:                 ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(
   44:                     nameof(wilds));
   45:         }
   46: 
   47:         /// <summary>
   48:         /// Executes ordinary QSL source through Wilds.
   49:         ///
   50:         /// This overload preserves the existing
   51:         /// source-only integration path.
   52:         /// </summary>
   53:         public ValueTask<IMoment> ExecuteAsync(
   54:             string source,
   55:             CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
   56:         {
   57:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
   58:                     source))
   59:             {
   60:                 throw new ArgumentException(
   61:                     "QSL source cannot be empty.",
   62:                     nameof(source));
   63:             }
   64: 
   65:             return _wilds.ExecuteAsync(
   66:                 source,
   67:                 ExecuteSourceAsync,
   68:                 cancellationToken);
   69:         }
   70: 
   71:         /// <summary>
   72:         /// Executes a complete QSL request containing
   73:         /// source, consumer bindings, and state packages
   74:         /// through Wilds.
   75:         /// </summary>
   76:         public ValueTask<IMoment> ExecuteAsync(
   77:             WildsQslRequest request,
   78:             CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
   79:         {
   80:             if (request == null)
   81:             {
   82:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   83:                     nameof(request));
   84:             }
   85: 
   86:             return _wilds.ExecuteAsync(
   87:                 request,
   88:                 ExecuteRequestAsync,
   89:                 cancellationToken);
   90:         }
   91: 
   92:         private ValueTask<object?> ExecuteSourceAsync(
   93:             object? request,
   94:             CancellationToken cancellationToken)
   95:         {
   96:             cancellationToken
   97:                 .ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
   98: 
   99:             var source =
  100:                 request as string;
  101: 
  102:             if (source == null)
  103:             {
  104:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  105:                     "WildsQslExecutor expected QSL source.");
  106:             }
  107: 
  108:             return EvaluateAsync(
  109:                 source);
  110:         }
  111: 
  112:         private ValueTask<object?> ExecuteRequestAsync(
  113:             object? request,
  114:             CancellationToken cancellationToken)
  115:         {
  116:             cancellationToken
  117:                 .ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
  118: 
  119:             var qslRequest =
  120:                 request as WildsQslRequest;
  121: 
  122:             if (qslRequest == null)
  123:             {
  124:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  125:                     "WildsQslExecutor expected a " +
  126:                     "WildsQslRequest.");
  127:             }
  128: 
  129:             for (
  130:                 var index = 0;
  131:                 index < qslRequest.Consumers.Count;
  132:                 index++)
  133:             {
  134:                 _qsl.BindConsumer(
  135:                     qslRequest.Consumers[index]);
  136:             }
  137: 
  138:             for (
  139:                 var index = 0;
  140:                 index < qslRequest.StatePackages.Count;
  141:                 index++)
  142:             {
  143:                 _qsl.ReceiveState(
  144:                     qslRequest.StatePackages[index]);
  145:             }
  146: 
  147:             cancellationToken
  148:                 .ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
  149: 
  150:             return EvaluateAsync(
  151:                 qslRequest.Source);
  152:         }
  153: 
  154:         private ValueTask<object?> EvaluateAsync(
  155:             string source)
  156:         {
  157:             var result =
  158:                 _qsl.Evaluate(
  159:                     source);
  160: 
  161:             if (!result.Succeeded)
  162:             {
  163:                 throw new WildsQslExecutionException(
  164:                     result);
  165:             }
  166: 
  167:             return new ValueTask<object?>(
  168:                 result.Value);
  169:         }
  170:     }
  171: }

FILE: WildsEngine.Qsl\WildsQslRequest.cs

    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using QSL.Core.Runtime.Context;
    4: using QSL.Core.Runtime.Packages;
    5: 
    6: namespace WildsEngine.Qsl
    7: {
    8:     /// <summary>
    9:     /// Represents one complete QSL request submitted
   10:     /// through the Wilds processing lifecycle.
   11:     ///
   12:     /// Wilds treats this request as opaque runtime data.
   13:     /// The Wilds/QSL integration layer prepares QSL from
   14:     /// the supplied consumer bindings, state packages,
   15:     /// and source.
   16:     /// </summary>
   17:     public sealed class WildsQslRequest
   18:     {
   19:         private readonly QslConsumerBinding[] _consumers;
   20: 
   21:         private readonly QslStatePackage[] _statePackages;
   22: 
   23:         public WildsQslRequest(
   24:             string source,
   25:             IEnumerable<QslConsumerBinding>? consumers = null,
   26:             IEnumerable<QslStatePackage>? statePackages = null)
   27:         {
   28:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
   29:                     source))
   30:             {
   31:                 throw new ArgumentException(
   32:                     "QSL source cannot be empty.",
   33:                     nameof(source));
   34:             }
   35: 
   36:             Source =
   37:                 source;
   38: 
   39:             _consumers =
   40:                 Copy(
   41:                     consumers,
   42:                     nameof(consumers));
   43: 
   44:             _statePackages =
   45:                 Copy(
   46:                     statePackages,
   47:                     nameof(statePackages));
   48:         }
   49: 
   50:         public string Source { get; }
   51: 
   52:         public IReadOnlyList<QslConsumerBinding> Consumers =>
   53:             _consumers;
   54: 
   55:         public IReadOnlyList<QslStatePackage> StatePackages =>
   56:             _statePackages;
   57: 
   58:         private static T[] Copy<T>(
   59:             IEnumerable<T>? values,
   60:             string parameterName)
   61:             where T : class
   62:         {
   63:             if (values == null)
   64:             {
   65:                 return Array.Empty<T>();
   66:             }
   67: 
   68:             var items =
   69:                 new List<T>();
   70: 
   71:             foreach (var value in values)
   72:             {
   73:                 if (value == null)
   74:                 {
   75:                     throw new ArgumentException(
   76:                         "Request collections cannot contain null.",
   77:                         parameterName);
   78:                 }
   79: 
   80:                 items.Add(
   81:                     value);
   82:             }
   83: 
   84:             return items.ToArray();
   85:         }
   86:     }
   87: }
